🌟 What we do & why we do it

Founded in 2021 in Osnabrück, Germany, doinstruct is on a mission to empower the backbone of our society - the frontline workforce - by making workplaces safer, more compliant, and more efficient. We don’t just improve training; we redefine how industries onboard and upskill their teams.

The problem? Outdated, inefficient training methods that fail to meet the needs of the deskless workforce - the 80% of global workers overlooked by traditional learning solutions. We saw the gap and built a seamless, mobile-first platform that makes onboarding, training, and compliance effortless, multilingual, and accessible - anytime, anywhere.

At doinstruct, we don’t accept the status quo. We innovate, we challenge, we build. Our vision is bold: Operational excellence for frontline teams starts here. We cut through the noise of clunky, ineffective training with an engaging, user-friendly experience available in 35+ languages - no downloads, no passwords - just instant access to the skills that drive industries forward.

🚀 Join us if you’re ready to build something extraordinary. We’re growing fast and looking for ambitious minds who thrive in a fast-paced, high-impact environment. If you’re passionate about solving big problems, shaping the future of workplace learning, and working alongside a driven team that moves fast and thinks big, doinstruct is where you belong.

___

The role

This is a hands-on role, requiring native-level German and working English proficiency.

doinstruct builds software that helps organizations train and enable their frontline teams, the people in factories, logistics, and service environments who are hardest to reach with conventional L&D. Our customers are manufacturers, industrial operators, and traditional enterprises.

As a key part of our marketing team, you’ll get to flex your strategic, research, and creative skills writing and creating content with two specific goals: Educate our audience (Thought leadership) and convert them (Acquisition). You own both end-to-end.

You will create high-value content in the form of blog articles, case studies, landing page copy, and white papers, collaborating closely with internal subject matter experts. For shoots and videos, you’ll use your storytelling superpowers to develop concepts and manage external production partners.

AI is an expected part of your workflow. You leverage the speed and efficiency technology affords with the taste only humans possess to create credible content worth reading.

If you have a journalistic curiosity, understand B2B audiences, and know how to build a content engine from the ground up - let’s talk!

🎯 What you'll own

  • Translate frontline realities, industry insights, trends, analysis, and product communication into content that resonates with buyers who don't live in generic SaaS marketing.

  • Plan and produce content across formats (website, blog, video, social) that performs in both traditional search and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, and adjust based on what you’ve measured.

  • Use AI tools as your default production layer: drafting, repurposing, ideation, research, so you can ship more, faster, without sacrificing quality.

  • Produce German-first content (that’s also translated in English), and work closely with the wider GTM team on broader copy requirements like campaigns and sales decks.

  • Brand tone of voice, ensuring consistency and differentiation

🙋 Who you are

  • You've produced content professionally and have a portfolio or examples.

  • You have a journalistic mindset - able to interview subject matter experts to extract insights, hooks, and stories.

  • You're fluent in German, comfortable writing and speaking it professionally. You’re also comfortable collaborating, presenting, and working at a professional proficiency in English.

  • You’ve already restructured how you work around AI - whether that's tracking AI visibility with something like Profound or Peec AI, producing multilingual content with tools like ElevenLabs or HeyGen, or researching with Perplexity instead of defaulting to Google. (If your content workflow looks basically the same as it did two years ago, this probably isn’t for you.)

  • Bonus, not a requirement: you've worked with or around frontline, industrial, or blue-collar audiences and understand operator priorities.

🤩 What's different here

You're not maintaining an existing content machine; you're bringing a new brand strategy to life; experimenting; and building a content function. That means real ambiguity, but also a chance to have outsized impact on a rapidly scaling business.

🚀 Why doinstruct

  • 400+ customers, Series A funded, below 2% churn. The product is a genuine must-have, which gives you real stories to tell.

  • We're moving AI-first as a company and will actively help you get deeper into AI tooling, because that's the direction we're going.

  • You're joining a GTM org that's still forming its shape, so what you build sticks.

📈 What success looks like

3 months You've got a content production rhythm running across formats, you understand our frontline buyer personas firsthand, and you’re identifying opportunities.

6 months Content you've produced is showing up in AI answer engines for queries that matter to us, and you can point to the pipeline it's driving. You’ve established strong partnerships with stakeholders both internally and externally.

12 months There's a repeatable content engine that treats AI answer engines as a first-class channel alongside traditional search. Content is having a measurable impact on revenue.

At doinstruct, you'll have the chance to use your skills and help shape our growing start-up. We value a friendly work environment, open communication, and support your personal and professional growth every step of the way.

Even if you don't tick all of the boxes, but you are motivated and want to work with us, you are very welcome to apply.

jobs.title: Internship - Founders' Office
jobs.description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

mission

As the Founders' Office Intern at telli, you'll work right alongside the founding team across finance, legal, ops, and special projects. You'll have a front-row seat to how an early-stage AI company operates and a very hands-on role in keeping things running and moving fast.

what you’ll do:

  • help us build the operational backbone behind telli's growth

  • take on special projects, driving initiatives forward by coordinating stakeholders and keeping everything on track

  • support with finance operations by maintaining reports, chasing invoices, and managing payment flow

  • help the growth team close new customers by managing legal and compliance processes

  • support with our hiring pipeline, from screening candidates to scheduling interviews

  • help plan and execute internal and external events and keep the office running smoothly

  • work closely with Ennie and Philipp

what makes you a great fit:

  • you are hands-on and not afraid of doing unglamorous work

  • you're tech- & automation savvy and can learn new tools fast

  • you love solving problems and figuring things out on your own

  • you’re a strong communicator in both English and German

  • you’ve have initial (internship) experience and/or worked on side hustles or projects

  • you're done or at the end of university and could imagine starting full-time after the internship

you may not make a good fit if:

  • you have never touched automation/AI tools or don’t have basic technical understanding

  • you only want to do high-level “strategic” work

  • you aren’t comfortable juggling multiple tasks at once

  • you don’t enjoy working directly with customers or in dynamic environments

  • you’re only looking for a typical 9–5 internship

Compensation: €3K – €5K per month

Help Us Change the Way the World Works

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows, helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

About the Role

You will take Langdock from first conversation to signed contract. Our customers are IT leaders, security teams, and C-Level executives at mid to large companies worldwide. This role is pivotal in driving our expansion across diverse customer segments, from innovative scale-ups and SMBs to established Global Fortune 500 clients.

You'll operate as a trusted technology and AI advisor, combining full ownership of the sales cycle with the technical depth to build real credibility with today's technical buyers - the IT leads, architects, and engineers who now sit at the table alongside business executives in every AI decision. The product sells well, but enterprise deals require someone who can navigate architectural complexity, build trust with both business and technical stakeholders, and close.

What You Will Do

  • Full-Cycle Sales Mastery: Own the entire sales lifecycle from lead qualification to closing, running technical discovery, solution scoping, and executive presentations that tie Langdock's platform to measurable business outcomes - with a seamless handover to customer success.

  • Technical Credibility: Lead early-stage conversations on APIs, integrations, and system architecture directly with IT and engineering stakeholders, translating what Langdock can do at the platform level into business value for economic buyers - without leaning on a Solutions Engineer to carry the technical thread.

  • Customer Success Advocacy: Build a deep understanding of customers' business models, decision-making processes, and technology landscapes, and continuously analyze customer needs to enhance their success with our solutions.

  • Strategic Revenue Development: Collaborate with partnerships, marketing, and customer success to design effective go-to-market strategies, test new markets and customer segments, and explore new revenue sources for future growth.

  • Market Insight: Deep understanding of our Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) and the ability to align solutions with their needs - and provide customer feedback to Product and Leadership to influence the roadmap.

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • You are proficient in AI technologies, with a preference for those who have previously sold AI solutions. In the best case, you have worked as a Sales Engineer or in similar positions.

  • You have experience selling technical solutions to medium and large companies, with the ability to translate complex platform concepts into business value for non-technical executives. You're comfortable managing complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles by developing and executing account strategies that carry significant quota.

  • You know how to build deep, strategic relationships with senior stakeholders, including C-suite executives, while staying credible with the technical evaluators in the room.

  • You're curious and customer-centric, with a talent for understanding customers' challenges and coordinating solution design tailored to their needs.

  • You're comfortable operating in a high-growth environment.

  • You are a kind person who cares about the people around you.

The Environment

We work from our office in Berlin, Greifswalder Strasse 212. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other.

Days start at 8:30. Lunch & dinner are together. We run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves. Health is not separate from work here, it is part of how we work well.

The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter.

Compensation

Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. All roles include equity.

We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process.

Next steps

We move fast. Most processes complete within two weeks.

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Hieronder vind je wat je nodig hebt om op te starten als rioolarbeider voor deze job in de regio Sint-Truiden:

  • Je raakt iedere ochtend vlot tot een ophaalpunt in de regio Sint-Truiden.

  • Iemand die veiligheid en orde op de werf serieus neemt: je volgt afspraken, gebruikt materiaal correct en spreekt risico’s tijdig aan.
  • Iemand die flexibel is in werkritme en planning, met bereidheid om vroeg te starten en in overleg extra uren te doen wanneer de werfplanning dat vraagt.

  • Iemand die graag slimmer wordt via opleiding en begeleiding on the job.

jobs.title: Management Assistant h/f/x
jobs.description:
About the role   You will provide administrative and logistical support to our association management teams  to deliver high-quality services and value to our clients. In coordinating and communicating with our volunteer groups and committees, you will also support our associations’ mission and activities.

Duties and Responsibilities  

  • bull;    Schedule meetings, prepare agendas, reports, and presentations for board, committee and working party meetings. Coordinate with all attendees.
  • bull;    Facilitate meetings, capturing action items and decisions. Manage post-meeting activities such as distributing minutes, tracking all action items and following up on outstanding items.
  • bull;    Provide administrative support, including scheduling, travel arrangements, and expense management.
  • bull;    Support with managing administration for corporate partnership deals and sponsorship agreements.
  • bull;    Track and manage the administration of grants and awards for a health care association.
  • bull;    Maintain governance documents, policies, and other relevant materials in a centralised repository.
  • bull;    Assist with the planning and execution of association events, programs, and projects.
  • bull;    Liaise with volunteer groups and committees and provide them with guidance, resources, and feedback.
  • bull;    Handle inquiries from members, partners, and the public and direct them to the appropriate person or department.
  • bull;    Organise and maintain files, records, and databases.
 

Your profile   Eligible to work in the EU. At least three years’ experience in an administrative or support role, preferably in a non-profit or association setting. Fluent in English (verbal and written level C1), Knowledge of another language is an asset. Proficient in the Microsoft Office package, Google Suite, and other web-based tools. Ability to work independently and collaboratively with a diverse team. Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritise and multitask. You are flexible, agile and committed especially in busy periods. Knowledge of and interest in the association's field and mission. Willingness to travel abroad for certain meetings and events. Available to join the team rapidly.

jobs.title: Business Development Officer
jobs.description:
Vous êtes à la recherche d'un job de Business Development Officer à Louvain-la-Neuve ? Vous aimez créer le premier contact avec les prospects et contribuer au développement commercial d'une entreprise reconnue ? Alors postulez maintenant !

En tant que Business Development Officer, vous aurez les tâches suivantes :

  • Vous contactez activement des prospects par téléphone, e-mail et LinkedIn afin de développer de nouvelles opportunités commerciales.
  • Vous qualifiez les leads et identifiez les besoins des interlocuteurs afin de générer des rendez-vous pertinents pour les équipes commerciales.
  • Vous assurez le suivi des échanges et veillez à maintenir une expérience positive pour chaque prospect.
  • Vous mettez à jour le CRM et garantissez la qualité des informations encodées.
  • Vous collaborez étroitement avec les équipes Sales et Marketing afin d'optimiser les actions de prospection et les résultats obtenus.

Voici le profil de Business Development Officer que nous recherchons :

  • Vous disposez idéalement d'une première expérience en prospection commerciale, même acquise lors d'un stage.
  • Vous maîtrisez parfaitement le français et disposez d'un bon niveau d'anglais.
  • Vous appréciez le contact client et adoptez une approche commerciale orientée conseil et relation de confiance.
  • Vous êtes persévérant, dynamique et motivé par l'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux.
  • Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques ; une connaissance de Salesforce constitue un atout.

jobs.title: Solution Architect – Client Solutions (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine Herausforderungen

  • Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden und unseren Entwicklungsteams und verbringst einen wesentlichen Teil deiner Zeit im direkten Austausch mit Kunden.
  • Du hörst genau hin, verstehst die Kundenprobleme und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in technische Fragestellungen, die unsere Entwickler konkret bearbeiten können.
  • Auf Basis deines tiefen technischen Hintergrunds entwickelst du Lösungsarchitekturen, die sowohl zu den Anforderungen des Kunden als auch zu unserer eigenen Systemlandschaft passen.
  • Dabei denkst du in Systemen: Du verstehst unsere Architektur, die technische Umgebung unserer Kunden, Datenflüsse, Schnittstellen und Abhängigkeiten und kannst diese Welten sinnvoll zusammenbringen.
  • Bei APIs und Integrationen kannst du nicht nur Anforderungen formulieren, sondern auch auf technischer Ebene mit unseren Entwicklern über Lösungswege und deren Auswirkungen diskutieren.
  • Du begleitest Projekte von der ersten Anforderung bis zur Umsetzung und stellst sicher, dass aus einer guten technischen Idee auch eine funktionierende Lösung wird.
  • Als Bindeglied zwischen Kunden, Projektteams und Engineering sorgst du für Klarheit: Was ist das eigentliche Problem? Was brauchen wir technisch? Was ist sinnvoll umsetzbar?

jobs.title: IT Security & Compliance Lead | HealthTech (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
IT Security & Compliance Lead – HealthTech (w/m/d)

Berlin Mitte – Hybrid, €70.000 – €100.000 Jahresgehalt, 28 Tage Urlaub

WICHTIG: Wer ausschließlich als Freelancer arbeiten will, ist hier falsch.

Du willst nicht nur Richtlinien schreiben, du willst die komplette Sicherheitsarchitektur in der Cloud bauen und verantworten. Du willst nicht nur Berichte abliefern, du willst Audits von ISO 27001 und BSI‑C5 eigenständig bestehen.

Hier geht es nicht um reine Dokumentation, hier geht es um Hands‑On‑Arbeit mit Terraform, AWS und GCP. Hier geht es nicht um einen starren 9‑to‑5‑Job, hier geht es um eine 32‑Stunden‑Option, Equity und direkten Einfluss auf die Gründer.

Unser Kunde

Ein Berliner HealthTech‑Startup mit rund zehn Mitarbeitenden, das KI‑gestützte Software zur Automatisierung psychotherapeutischer Dokumentation entwickelt. Die Plattform entlastet Therapeuten von administrativen Aufgaben und verbessert die Patientenversorgung. Das Unternehmen positioniert sich als innovativer Anbieter im Schnittfeld von Künstlicher Intelligenz, Gesundheits‑ und Software‑Technologie.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

Hohe Verantwortung – End‑to‑End‑Ownership über Security & Compliance.

Technische Hands‑On‑Arbeit – Cloud‑Security und IaC mit Terraform.

Stabiles Vollzeit‑Umfeld mit 32‑Stunden‑Option.

Equity‑Beteiligung über VESOP.

Direkter Einfluss – täglicher Kontakt zu Gründern und CTO.

Aufgaben

  • Own security & compliance end‑to‑end: Cloud, Produkt und interne IT.
  • Harden und betreibe AWS/GCP‑Umgebungen: IAM, Netzwerk, Verschlüsselung, Logging, Monitoring, Detection.
  • Embed DevSecOps in den SDLC: Threat Modeling, Vulnerability Management, Secure Code Reviews.
  • Leite ISO 27001‑ und BSI‑C5‑Zertifizierungen inkl. Audits, Evidenz‑ und Risikomanagement.
  • Koordiniere Pen‑Tests, Security‑Reviews und Vendor Assessments.
  • Definiere und pflege interne IT‑Baselines: Identity, MDM, Device‑Policies, On‑/Off‑boarding.
  • Biete pragmatische Security‑Guidance und push back bei Architektur‑Entscheidungen.

Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Hands‑On‑Erfahrung in Cloud‑Security (AWS oder GCP) inkl. Terraform.
  • Vollständige Audit‑Ownership von ISO 27001 / BSI‑C5 inklusive erfolgreicher Zertifizierung.
  • Erfahrung mit DevSecOps, Secure SDLC, Threat Modeling und Vulnerability Management.
  • Fließende Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse (C1).
  • Bachelor‑Abschluss oder gleichwertige Qualifikation.
  • Nachweisbare Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering‑Teams in kleinen, async‑first Umgebungen.

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Freelancer – keine langfristige Anstellung.
  • Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel (< 2 Jahre) sind ein Dealbreaker.
  • Policy‑Only‑Background – keine technische Hands‑On‑Erfahrung.
  • Fehlende Audit‑Erfahrung (ISO 27001/BSI‑C5) – kein Platz für reine Dokumentationsrollen.
  • Keine Bereitschaft, in Berlin vor Ort zu arbeiten.

Benefits

  • 4,5‑Tag‑Woche bei 28 Tagen Urlaub
  • Firmenwagen zur privaten Nutzung
  • JobRad‑Leasing
  • EGYM Wellpass
  • Geförderte betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Team‑Events und ein inklusives Arbeitsklima
  • Attraktives Gehalt bis zu 100 k €
  • Virtuelle Beteiligung (VESOP)

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Vollständige Ownership über Security & Compliance in einem wachsenden HealthTech‑Startup.
  • Breites Hands‑On‑Spektrum von Cloud‑Hardening bis Audit‑Leitung – steile Lernkurve garantiert.
  • Direkter, täglicher Austausch mit Gründer:innen & CTO ohne Hierarchien.
  • Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.

Bereit?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt als IT Security & Compliance Lead – HealthTech (w/m/d). Egal ob dein Titel Security Lead, Head of Security oder Security & Compliance Manager heißt: Entscheidend ist, dass du mindestens 5 Jahre Hands‑On‑Erfahrung in Cloud‑Security hast und die komplette ISO 27001/BSI‑C5 Zertifizierung eigenverantwortlich leitest.

Noch Fragen?

jobs.title: Head of People Group Supply
jobs.description:

Ericsson AB

In a rapidly evolving landscape shaped by digitalization, AI, and new ways of working, you will champion change and position People as a strategic driver of business value.

jobs.title: Line Manager ASIC IP
jobs.description:
Company description:

Ericsson AB

Job description:   Join our Team  

About the Opportunity







We are recruiting a Line Manager for the Silicon Network IP Development section in Lund, reporting to the Head of Networks & Compute Acceleration Engineering. The team is a key contributor to Ericsson's Radio and RAN Compute product development, driving the development of connectivity and digital hardware solutions that enable next-generation products and services. The team's expertise spans micro-architecture, design, implementation, verification, debug, and integration of advanced communication technologies and plays an important role in shaping the future evolution of Ericsson's networking solutions. As leader of the Lund team, you are expected to coach, mentor, challenge, and develop individuals and cross-functional teams while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, continuous learning, continuous improvement, and a strong sense of belonging. You will define and execute team strategies aligned with business priorities, secure the long-term development of critical competencies, and create an environment where people can grow, perform, and thrive. You will work closely with architects, technical leaders, project organizations, and stakeholders across Ericsson's global R&D organization. A key part of the role is establishing strong collaboration with peer line managers and engineering teams across sites to drive successful execution, strengthen engineering excellence, and ensure the organization has the capabilities required to meet current and future business needs.  What you will do



•    Drive competence development and long-term workforce planning.•    Build an engaging, inclusive, and high-performing work environment that promotes collaboration, continuous learning, and a strong sense of belonging.•    Enable development and delivery of silicon networking solutions for Ericsson's Radio and RAN Compute products.•    Collaborate with architects and technical leaders to define and evolve future solutions.•    Ensure teams understand and follow established development processes, engineering practices, and quality standards throughout the complete IP lifecycle.•    Support development activities throughout the product lifecycle, from early concepts and architecture to deployment and maintenance when required.•    Enable strong collaboration across development sites, organizations, and technology domains.•    Work closely with peer line managers across sites to support staffing, competence development, and successful execution.•    Be accountable for workforce planning, budget management, and capability investments to support successful delivery and long-term organizational growth.•    Contribute to technology strategy, capability planning, and future evolution across Silicon development.   To be successful in the role you must have



•    Proven leadership experience with a genuine passion for developing people, teams, and organizational capabilities.•    Experience from R&D organizations. Experience in networking, Ethernet, digital hardware, ASIC, FPGA, SoC, or related technologies is considered a strong advantage.•    Strong understanding of product development processes, engineering excellence, and agile ways of working.•    Experience in workforce planning, competence development, and resource management.•    Experience managing budgets, balancing business priorities, and driving organizational performance.•    A strategic mindset combined with the ability to drive execution and deliver results in a complex environment.•    An analytical, structured, and solution-oriented approach.•    A continuous improvement mindset with the ability to lead change and transformation.

jobs.title: Toonzaalverkoper | Badkamers | 39 uur
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Maatwerkcoach Productie - site Eeklo en uitwerk (vervanging)
jobs.description:
Bij Mirto doen we aan eerlijk ondernemen met een gezonde commerciële visie en aandacht voor mens en milieu. Professioneel met een menselijke aanpak. Mirto vzw is gevestigd op twee sites: in Gent en in Eeklo, waar we samen zo’n 300 medewerkers met een afstand tot de reguliere arbeidsmarkt tewerkstellen.

Om ons team te versterken zijn wij op zoek naar een maatwerkcoach / werkbegeleider om met een team van maatwerkers verschillende verpakkingsopdrachten te realiseren. We zijn fier op ons werk en ziet er alles over hier: https://mirto.be/klantencases/

Als maatwerkcoach speel je een dubbele rol: enerzijds in de ontwikkeling van onze maatwerkers, anderzijds in het realiseren van de opdracht van de klant. Hoe dan concreet?

  • Je organiseert de werkpost en verdeelt het werk onder jouw teamleden op basis van de (aan te leren) competenties van onze maatwerkers: jij beslist wie waar staat en zit. Liggen dat doen we niet.
  • Je mindset: laarzen-aan-en-gaan! Je staat samen met de maatwerkers in het werkveld: je bent een meewerkende coach, maar niet zonder het overzicht over de voortgang te verliezen. 15 000 stappen, laat maar komen.
  • Je checkt continu het resultaat van jouw team en hebt oog voor kwaliteit, veiligheid en efficiëntie.
  • Je laat jouw team groeien via feedbackgesprekken, coaching op de werkvloer, het geven van opleidingen, … en verliest jouw eigen ontwikkeling niet uit het oog.
  • Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze maatwerkers. Een moeilijke dag voor een maatwerker of een conflict in het team? Dan los jij dit op waar het kan en verwijs je door wanneer het moet.
  • Je neemt eigenaarschap om klantenopdrachten goed te volbrengen en overlegt dagelijks met jouw collega's, klantentolken en leidinggevende.
  • Je bent flexibel en houdt van variatie in opdrachten en in werklocaties. Zo kan je zowel werken in Mirto Eeklo, als op verplaatsing bij specifieke klanten in Gent Zeehaven.

Vanuit jouw betrokkenheid voel je je verbonden met de waarden, missie en visie van Mirto en ga je als maatwerkcoach op een respectvolle manier om met mens en materiaal.

  • Je hebt goesting en power om voltijds aan de slag te zijn.
  • Je hebt een rijbewijs B om met een team van Mirtolisten op uitwerk te gaan. Want sommige productieopdrachten voeren we uit bij de klant ter plaatse.
  • Ervaring in een organiserende of leidinggevende functie is een groot pluspunt, net zoals ervaring in de verpakkingssector, orderpicking of productie.
  • Je bent positief en sociaal ingesteld en je gelooft in de sterktes van onze medewerkers.
  • Je denkt oplossingsgericht en werkt nauwkeurig en ordelijk.
  • Je houdt het hoofd koel wanneer iets niet volgens plan verloopt, je bent flexibel en past je gemakkelijk aan bij veranderingen.
  • Je hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel naar je collega’s als naar de maatwerkers.

jobs.title: Nachtverpleegkundige SP Locomotorische revalidatie Beveren (tijdelijk)
jobs.description:
Voor de gespecialiseerde dienst Locomotorische revalidatie op campus Beveren zoeken we een nachtverpleegkundige.
Deze dienst staat in voor de behandeling en revalidatie van patiënten met locomotorische en neurologische aandoeningen. De meest voorkomende pathologieën zijn onder andere CVA, ziekte van Parkinson, rugoperaties, heup- en knieprotheses.

- Je biedt kwaliteitsvolle totaalzorg aan: lichaamsverzorging, medicatiezorg, voeding en verpleegtechnische zorgen. Je hebt daarbij zowel aandacht voor de lichamelijke als psychische en sociale zorgen.
- Als verpleegkundige ontwikkel je een zorgplan voor elke patiënt en pas je dit aan aan de evolutie van de patiënt.
- Gedurende het revalidatieproces treed je op als coach en vertrouwenspersoon van de patiënt.
- Als verpleegkundige op de afdeling SP revalidatie, voel je dat de positiviteit de boventoon voert. Je helpt mensen met het optimaliseren van de zelfredzaamheid. Elke dag is anders, maar het uitgangspunt is 'mensen bevorderen in hun zelfstandigheid'.
- Daarnaast zorg je voor een goede informatiedoorstrooming naar alle betrokken medewerkers (verpleegkundigen, arts, kinesist, logopedist, ergotherapeut,...) om de revalidatie van de patiënten zo goed mogelijk te laten verlopen.

Voor de overige taakinhouden verwijzen we naar de functieomschrijving ' Verpleegkundige Verantwoordelijk voor de Algemene Zorg '. Interne kandidaten kunnen dit terugvinden op NIKOdoc, externe kandidaten kunnen dit bekomen bij de dienst Personeel & Organisatie.

Opmerking: Locatie en uurregeling kunnen wijzigen in functie van de dienstnoodwendigheden.

- Je bent verpleegkundige (bachelor of HBO5).
- Je hebt kennis van of interesse in de afdelingsgebonden verpleegproblemen en basisinzicht in de onderliggende pathologieën.
- Je hebt een goede observatiezin en een klinische blik.
- Je kan zelfstandig en oplossingsgericht werken.
- Je kan samenwerken met verschillende disciplines.
- Je bent enthousiast, gemotiveerd en wil het beste uit jezelf halen.
- Je hebt een luisterend oor en bent sterk in communicatie.

jobs.title: ORDERPICKER DAG

jobs.title: Een ondernemerschapsmedewerker (60%) bij Startpunt Ondernemen
jobs.description:
Hier gebeurt het. Met meer dan 2000 medewerkers en meer dan 22.000 studenten is Thomas More de grootste hogeschool van Vlaanderen, een warme, internationale en bruisende community met optimale leerkansen voor elk talent. Om onze visie 'met lef toonaangevend' verder te realiseren zijn wij op zoek naar mensen met Lef, Enthousiasme, Focus en Vertrouwen. Geïnspireerd door deze vier waarden bieden wij je een uitdagende job binnen een dynamische onderwijsomgeving waarin vernieuwing en samenwerking cruciaal zijn, en waarin je als TM-ambassadeur bijdraagt aan een aangename werkomgeving voor iedereen.

Inhoud van de opdracht:

1. Je bent hét aanspreekpunt voor ondernemerschap in Mechelen-Antwerpen

Je bent hét gezicht en eerste aanspreekpunt van Startpunt Ondernemen op de campussen in Mechelen en Antwerpen. Je gaat proactief de campussen en opleidingen op, legt contacten met studenten, docenten en opleidingsverantwoordelijken en bouwt een sterk netwerk uit binnen Thomas More. Zo zorg je ervoor dat studenten en collega’s weten wat Startpunt Ondernemen voor hen kan betekenen en creëer je een groot en vlot bereik rond ondernemerschap.

Je maakt ondernemerschap zichtbaar en brengt studenten en collega’s hierrond in beweging. Je organiseert bijvoorbeeld campustours en andere ondernemende activiteiten en introduceert initiatieven van Startpunt Ondernemen binnen en/of samen met opleidingen. Je werkt daarbij samen met opleidingen en andere interne en externe partners, zodat ideeën ook daadwerkelijk landen en gerealiseerd worden.

Je houdt daarbij steeds de tweeledige opdracht van Startpunt Ondernemen scherp voor ogen. Enerzijds ondersteun je student-ondernemerschap vanuit Manestarters. Anderzijds draag je bij aan het bredere MORE Professional-verhaal van Thomas More, waarin ondernemende competenties centraal staan.

Je bent daarbij niet enkel een doorgeefluik van het bestaande aanbod. Je krijgt de ruimte om vanuit je lokale kennis en netwerk zelf opportuniteiten te detecteren en initiatieven te ontwikkelen die aansluiten bij wat leeft binnen de campussen en opleidingen. Je neemt daarin eigenaarschap en bouwt actief mee aan de verdere verankering van ondernemerschap binnen Mechelen-Antwerpen.

2. Je trekt Manestarters in Mechelen

Manestarters is het ecosysteem van Thomas More voor studenten die ondernemend zijn of een eigen onderneming hebben. Kortom, student-ondernemerschap stimuleren. Als projectleider ben je verantwoordelijk voor de verdere uitbouw ervan in Mechelen. Je coördineert het team binnen dit ecosysteem en rolt daarnaast samen met de teamleden van Startpunt Ondernemen het gedeelte voor Thomas More inhoudelijk uit. Tegelijk bouw je een sterk netwerk uit van ondernemers, organisaties, opleidingen en andere partners die studenten hierin kunnen versterken.

Je zorgt ervoor dat Manestarters zichtbaar is op de campus, dat studenten de weg vinden naar het aanbod en dat nieuwe ideeën en samenwerkingen daadwerkelijk van de grond komen. Je volgt de doelstellingen van het project op en werkt mee aan het behalen van de vooropgestelde resultaten. Je maakt hierbij steeds de reflex om deze te koppelen aan de strategische doelen van Thomas More en Startpunt Ondernemen.

3. Je maakt deel uit van de ondernemerschapswerking van Thomas More: Startpunt Ondernemen

Je bent een volwaardig teamlid van Startpunt Ondernemen en draagt actief bij aan de gezamenlijke werking. Je werkt mee aan werving en promotie, coacht studenten en ondersteunt bij activiteiten die ondernemerschap zichtbaar en beleefbaar maken op de campus, zoals de MORE ICE Awards, NVDOS, Dag van de Ondernemer, Creators Night, gastsessies en andere initiatieven.

Afhankelijk van de activiteit neem je een trekkersrol op in de voorbereiding, organisatie en uitvoering, of ondersteun je een collega die de lead neemt.

Daarnaast geef of organiseer je mee workshops en vormingen rond ondernemerschapsthema’s zoals pitchen, storytelling, Business Model Canvas, ondernemende competenties en innovatie.

Je bent sterk studentgericht: je trekt eropuit, gaat actief in gesprek met studenten en weet hen te enthousiasmeren om ondernemend aan de slag te gaan.

jobs.title: Group Controller
jobs.description:
Mercell is the leading SaaS platform for public procurement in Europe.

We deliver digital solutions for public tenders and procurement across Europe and have built a large, subscription-based business with a strong Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) foundation. Headquartered in Oslo, Mercell is backed by Thoma Bravo, one of the world's leading software and technology investors.

At Mercell, we're on a mission to transform public procurement by making it more accessible and effortless for everyone involved. We envision a world where public buyers and suppliers work seamlessly together to make “a great deal easier” and help shape the future.

Our culture is built on continuous growth, trust and collaboration. We offer an international environment where talented people can thrive alongside ambitious colleagues who are passionate about creating value for our customers and shareholders.


Your Mission 

As Group Controller, you will join our Group Finance team in a broad, hands-on role spanning financial controlling, FP&A and finance operations. Your work will cover areas such as cost controlling, reporting, forecasting, cash management and working capital.

You will work closely with colleagues across Finance and the business, taking ownership and contributing where needed. This is an opportunity to build on your accounting or audit experience, broaden your operational understanding and grow across several areas of finance.


Core Responsibilities  

  • Contribute to financial reporting, analysis and controls, ensuring reliable numbers and useful insights.

  • Support cost controlling, budgeting and forecasting in certain areas in close dialogue with the business.

  • Support with cash management, cash forecasting and working capital to support day-to-day financial operations.

  • Contribute to effective operations around transfer pricing and inter-company financing; internal cost allocation, internal funding and other financial management on legal entity level

  • Improve processes and ways of working, combining attention to detail with a practical, hands-on approach.


Required Qualifications  

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Accounting, Finance or similar.

  • Strong experience (ideally a minimum of 3-5 years) in accounting, auditing or financial or business controlling, with a solid understanding of financial reporting and analysis. Big4 background is an advantage.

  • An interest in moving closer to the business and developing broader experience in financial reporting and operations.

  • Good Excel skills and confidence working with financial systems and data. Experience with Oracle Netsuite is an advantage.

  • Good communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate across teams.


Preferred Qualifications  

  • You are curious, structured and enjoy getting things done. You take responsibility for the quality of your work, ask questions and are keen to understand how the numbers connect to everyday operations.

  • You enjoy variety and working in a small team where colleagues support each other. You bring a sound technical foundation and a willingness to learn; experience across every part of the role is not expected. Cash management and other operational finance activities offer opportunities to develop as you grow in the role.

  • You are proactive and thrive in a fast- paced environment where we set ambitious goals and continuously improve how we work

  • You have high professional standards.

 

Start date: As soon as possible

Duration: Full time

Workplace type: Hybrid - working onsite at the office min. 3 days and from home, balancing flexibility with collaboration

Location: Oslo, Norway

Application Deadline: 11 October 2026. However, do not wait to submit your application - we will read applications and talk to potential candidates as we receive them 

 

What we offer 

Mercell offers an exciting opportunity to help shape the future of a leading European SaaS company backed by one of the world's foremost technology investors.

You will join an ambitious, international organisation where you can develop and improve financial controlling and finance operations, while broadening your experience across Finance.

We offer a dynamic working environment, excellent opportunities for professional and personal growth, modern offices and a competitive compensation package.

As a fast growing technology company, we are committed to taking care of our employees through initiatives such as hybrid work to support work-life balance, health and insurance plans (may differ per country/office), pension plans, paid parental leave, social happenings and competitive salary packages. Please see https://career.mercell.com/pages/perks-benefits to get more insights on what to expect of perks, benefits and culture when joining Mercell.


Has this sparked your interest?

Then we can't wait to have you join our mission and looking forward to receiving your application!


-Mercell is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

-Mercell handles all personal data in line with GDPR and our Privacy Policy.

-Mercell does not provide relocation support. We are seeking candidates who are already based in, or have existing work authorization for, the country where the role is located.

-Mercell may carry out background checks on applicants to verify information that appears on CVs and other documentation. This background check is carried out by an external party and is not carried out without the consent of the applicant. Current applicants will receive further information about this.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Mercell, we’re transforming how businesses manage procurement and public tendering processes. As a leading provider of digital solutions for procurement, we help organizations across Europe streamline, automate, and optimize their sourcing operations. Our cloud-based platform connects buyers and suppliers, driving transparency, efficiency, and compliance in public and private sector procurement. The Problem We Solve: Procurement is often plagued by inefficiencies, manual workflows, and a lack of transparency, making it time-consuming and prone to errors. This not only impacts operational performance but can also prevent businesses from making strategic, cost-effective decisions. At Mercell, we are solving these challenges by providing an integrated solution that simplifies the tendering process, ensures compliance with regulatory standards, and empowers businesses with data-driven insights. Why We Do It: We believe that efficient procurement is at the heart of sustainable business growth. By digitizing and optimizing the procurement process, we help organizations save time, reduce costs, and make smarter decisions, all while fostering a more competitive and transparent marketplace. Our goal is to empower organizations to focus on their core business, leaving procurement complexity to us. At Mercell, we’re driven by innovation and a passion to continuously improve the procurement landscape.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Backend (BI Platform)
jobs.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

From real-time logistics to resilient infrastructure and marketplace optimisation, we design, build and operate technology that powers Deliveroo's growth at scale.

We're looking for a Software Engineer, Backend to join our London team. This role is based in our London office with a hybrid setup, typically 3 days in the office.

Get to know our Engineering team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

 

About the Team

The Core BI team builds and operates the services, integrations and automation that power business intelligence across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. Our platforms help analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers and business teams discover trusted data and make informed decisions at scale.

We combine software engineering, platform ownership, and a strong user focus to make BI tooling reliable, secure, scalable and self-service. The team supports the current BI ecosystem while helping shape a more integrated experience across the DoorDash group.

 

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on the Core BI team, you will build and operate the backend services, APIs and infrastructure our BI platforms run on. This is a hands-on software and platform engineering role: services and integrations, identity and access automation, observability, reliability and developer experience. BI is the domain you serve (primarily Looker and Sigma, and the systems around them), but the problems are backend and platform problems.

You will own problems from discovery through design, implementation, deployment, and operational support. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Product Managers and business teams to turn recurring user needs into durable, self-service capabilities. If you're energized by solving technical problems with data and comfortable being deeply embedded across several domains, this role is for you!

 

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Design, build, test, deploy and operate the backend services, APIs and automation that the BI platforms across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt depend on

  • Automate the platform lifecycle end to end (provisioning, metadata, permissions, migrations, archival and validation) so administration stops being manual work

  • Build the integrations between BI platforms and the wider ecosystem: warehouses, identity providers, orchestration, CI/CD and internal developer tooling

  • Improve the availability, observability, performance, scalability and security of the systems you own, and carry them in production

  • Use AI tooling as part of how you engineer, and where it fits, build LLM-backed capabilities held to the same reliability and governance bar as anything else we ship

  • Raise the engineering bar on the team, from service design and code review to testing, CI/CD and documentation, and improve the developer experience for everyone building on the platform

We're excited about you because…

  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend, platform or infrastructure systems

  • Readable, maintainable, well-tested code in Python, plus comfort with SQL and a working understanding of data modelling and warehousing concepts

  • Experience building and owning APIs, integrations or automation in production, with sound judgement on service boundaries, authentication, data contracts and failure modes

  • Hands-on with CI/CD, containers and Kubernetes, observability, debugging and incident response, and you expect to operate what you build

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (LLMs, agentic workflows, AI-assisted development) as part of how you engineer, and judgement about where they help and where they do not

  • End-to-end ownership of ambiguous problems, clear communication with technical and non-technical teams, and comfort self-organising in a fast-paced, distributed environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience owning or integrating with BI platforms such as Looker, Sigma or comparable tools, and familiarity with semantic layers such as LookML or dbt

  • Experience automating identity and access through Okta, SCIM or role-based access controls, or building multi-tenant platforms across brands and regions

  • Experience shipping LLM-backed features to real users (retrieval, grounding and evaluation), or with MCP, agent frameworks or tool-calling in production

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Explore our Engineering Interview Guide here to help you feel confident at each stage.

Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

Strategy, Design & Scaling

  • Optimise hub performance: Evolve the format and structural workflow of our physical Rider Onboarding Hubs to maximise operational efficiency before, during, and after daily sessions.

Field Operations & Fleet Enablement

  • Manage local supply constraints: Target and eliminate rider deficits in hard-to-source zones, collaborating with the Supply team to build accurate demand forecasting models.

  • Execute seasonal campaigns: Lead tactical supply planning and execution for peak trading seasons to stay ahead of consumer and partner growth.

Essential

  • Sector experience: Proven operational experience within technology, start-ups, food delivery logistics, or direct experience working as a Deliveroo Rider.

  • Stakeholder management: Strong empathetic listening and communication skills, with the capability to influence internal product teams and manage candidate groups.

  • Mobility and licensing: A valid UKI driving licence and access to your own vehicle for locations underserved by public transport, along with the flexibility to travel early and late.

Nice to Have

  • Technical tools: Familiarity with G Suite, Slack, Looker, and Salesforce tooling.

  • Language skills: Professional proficiency in Portuguese or Arabic.

Note: This is a 6-month Fixed Term Contract (FTC) with the possibility of extension. All field-based travel, accommodation, and personal vehicle mileage expenses will be fully covered by the company.

jobs.title: Customer Support Executive
jobs.description:
About The Alliance

When it comes to building world-class professional communities, The Alliance is leading the way. From Product Marketing and Sales Enablement to Product-Led Growth, AI, Customer Success, and CMOs, we're home to some of the most engaged and influential communities in the industry.

With 160,000+ professionals across our communities and a constant stream of content, courses, events, and memberships, we help our members learn, connect, and grow. Our executive events are a key part of that mission—bringing together senior leaders to share insights, tackle industry challenges, and build meaningful relationships.

Every year, we engage attendees, speakers, partners, and members from some of the world's leading organisations and fastest-growing start-ups, including TikTok, Microsoft, Peloton, and Uber.

 

The Role

We are on look out for a detail-driven, proactive Customer Support Executive to join our vibrant Customer Success team. In this role, you will serve as the primary point of contact across our support channels, elevating the overall member experience by resolving queries and ensuring our users maximize the value of our platform.
Beyond day-to-day support, you will spearhead forward-looking initiatives designed to preemptively address customer needs, such as optimizing our AI support agent, analyzing key pain points, and building expertise in customer operations within a fast-growing, collaborative environment.

Responsibilities

  • Customer Support Champion: Be the first line of contact for our members via email and our ticketing system, providing timely, friendly, and helpful responses every day.

  • Escalation Pro: Spot the difference between a quick fix and something that needs a deeper dive, escalating where appropriate to keep things moving smoothly.

  • Priority Pro: Keep a clear head and a clean inbox, staying organised across multiple tickets, deadlines, and internal priorities.

  • AI Agent Champion: Support the ongoing maintenance, development, and continuous improvement of our AI agent, helping to refine its responses, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure it continues to deliver a great experience for our members when we’re not around.

  • Internal Collaborator: Work closely with Customer Success, Education, Product and other departments to resolve member issues quickly and efficiently.

  • Process Improver: Contribute to FAQs, support documentation, and internal feedback loops to make us even better, every day.

  • Platform Power User: Use Intercom to manage tickets and feed back customer experience improvements to the wider team.

Compensation: £32,000-34,000 base Salary (depending on experience)

Location: this role can be Remote from wherever in the UK or hybrid in our London office.

This role is for you if you:

  • Have excellent written communication skills and a calm, customer-first approach.

  • Have experience with Intercom, Zendesk or similar support platforms (ideally including experience working with AI agents)

  • Are forward thinking, detail-oriented and take pride in getting the small things right.

  • Know when to escalate, and when to troubleshoot.

  • Strong communicator - from our customers to your colleagues, you’ll be working very closely with lots of people.

  • Team player - success doesn’t happen in a vacuum, we need everyone in the org to be rallied around the same goals and helping each other out to achieve them.

  • Creative problem-solver - we know that processes can always be improved. We’re looking for someone who can think on their feet, solve problems, and identify opportunities.

  • Tech-savvy - we lean on lots of different apps and while we’ll obviously onboard you on each, we’re looking for a quick learner who can show us a thing or two. We’re especially interested in your experience with Customer Support AI and Knowledge Database management.

 

Benefits: We believe exceptional people deserve exceptional support.

Time Off:

  • 34 days' annual leave, including UK Bank Holidays.

  • Your birthday is off every year.

 

Health & Wellbeing:

  • Enhanced family policies.

  • Private Medical Insurance.

  • Life Insurance (4x salary).

  • On-demand therapy, coaching, and mental fitness support through Oliva.

jobs.description:

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving.   • 5+ years in B2C lifecycle, CRM, or growth marketing at consumer or PLG scale

  • 3+ years of deep, hands-on expertise with a modern lifecycle marketing platform like Braze, Iterable, or Customer.io

  • Fluency in Liquid templating and email HTML/CSS, segmentation logic, and event-driven campaign architecture, experience with CDPs, event pipelines (e.g., RudderStack) and SQL for self-serve analysis makes you even stronger here

  • Experience building adaptive, evolving lifecycle systems, not just static journeys

  • Hands-on experience applying AI and automation to content creation, personalization, segmentation, and decisioning logic

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and designing systems that improve over time

  • Content craftsmanship to ensure content going out always builds on Lovable’s brand

What you’ll do

  • Operate lifecycle marketing for the self-serve base across activation, engagement, retention, and reactivation.

  • Lifecycle PoC for product launches, experiments, and GTM moments

  • Design intelligent, rules-based or algorithmic lifecycle programs that dynamically decide who to message, when to reach them, which channel to use (email, inbox, push, and emerging CRM channels), and what content to send, based on behavior and context

  • Work AI-first across your entire workflow, applying AI and automation to content generation, personalization, segmentation, decisioning, and analysis

  • Build experimentation and data-driven optimization into every lifecycle program, measuring true incremental impact rather than surface-level engagement

  • Partner closely with Data, Product, and GTM teams so lifecycle messaging feels native, timely, and valuable

What Success Looks like

  • Increased lift from lifecycle marketing you’re working on vs baseline

  • Builders experience Lovable’s lifecycle messaging as remarkably relevant, well-timed, and valuable - not noisy or generic

  • Already building with AI. You use AI day to day, you're comfortable building agents, and you'll use Lovable to ship the tools this role runs on.

  • Technical spiking. You go deep in at least one of: data analytics, data engineering, or tracking and measurement. You don't need all three at that level, but you need to be strong in one, comfortable in the rest, and delivering the work yourself.

  • Run paid search and paid social end to end. Own the channels across Google, Microsoft, Meta, and emerging AI surfaces like ChatGPT. You set the account structure, the bids, the budgets, and the targets.

  • Stay in the details. You'll be in the accounts, running tests on audiences, bids, and creative, and building most of this yourself. This is a role for someone who wants their hands on the work.

jobs.title: Territory Sales Partner
jobs.description:
Build Your Own Sales Business with Omada.ai

Omada.ai is the AI-powered marketing platform built for small businesses. We handle social media, email marketing, ads, and reputation management — so local business owners can stop being reluctant marketers and get back to doing what they love.

We’re venture-backed by HubSpot Ventures and Crosslink Capital, growing fast, and looking for independent, ambitious sales partners across the UK who want to earn serious money introducing local businesses to Omada.

The Opportunity

This isn’t a job — it’s a partnership. As an Omada Territory Sales Partner, you run your own independent sales operation. You choose your hours, your territory, your approach. We provide the product, the resources, and a compensation structure that means you’re never working for free.

  • Guaranteed Weekly Draw: £500/week guaranteed minimum — as long as you’re hitting your trial targets. This isn’t commission-only.

  • Commission: £250–£350 per closed account (tier-dependent) with uncapped earnings. Top partners earn £4,000–£8,000+ per month.

  • Structure: Self-employed (sole trader or limited company). You invoice us. You manage your own tax.

  • Location: Your local city. Must be based in the United Kingdom.

  • Schedule: Entirely your own. Work when it suits you — mornings, evenings, weekends. Your business, your call.

How the Draw Works

We believe in setting our partners up for success. That’s why every Territory Partner receives a guaranteed weekly draw of £500 — as long as you’re generating results.

  • Weeks 1–4: Generate at least 3 free trial signups per week → receive £500 guaranteed that week

  • Week 5 onward: Generate at least 4 free trial signups per week → receive £500 guaranteed that week

  • In any week where your commissions from closed accounts exceed £500, you earn the full commission instead

  • The draw is ongoing — not just for your first month. Hit your numbers, get paid. Every week.

This means you’re never working for nothing while your pipeline builds. Trials convert to paying customers, commissions grow, and the draw becomes your floor — not your ceiling.

What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll be visiting local businesses — salons, restaurants, gyms, coffee shops, pet groomers, dental practices — and showing them how Omada.ai can handle their marketing while they focus on running their business.

A typical approach might look like this:

  • Identify businesses in your area that could benefit from better marketing

  • Walk in and start a conversation — "Hi, I work with Omada.ai. Who handles your social media?"

  • Show a quick demo on your phone

  • Offer a 14-day free trial — no risk for them

  • Follow up — when they convert, you earn your commission

We provide a resource kit with demo scripts, objection-handling guides, and territory mapping tools. How you use them is entirely up to you.

Who Thrives as a Territory Partner

  • Self-starters who don’t need someone managing their diary

  • People comfortable walking into a business and starting a conversation

  • Entrepreneurial types who want to build something, not just clock hours

  • Anyone with sales, field marketing, or B2B experience (helpful but not required)

  • People who want uncapped income tied to their effort, not a salary cap

What You’ll Need

  • UK-based with the right to work in the United Kingdom

  • Registered (or willing to register) as self-employed with HMRC

  • Smartphone with internet access

  • Reliable transport or a walkable territory with high business density

  • The drive to build your own business

No degree required. No prior sales experience required. If you can hold a conversation and you’re willing to put in the work, we’ll provide the resources to help you succeed.

The Career Path

Omada Sales Territory Partners aren’t capped. Top performers progress through a clear leadership pathway with increasing commission rates, territory ownership, and team-building opportunities:

  • Territory Partner — You’re in the field, closing deals, building your reputation.

  • City Captain — Exclusive city territory, higher commissions, and the opportunity to mentor new partners.

  • State Director — Leading a regional team with override commissions on your team’s closes.

  • Regional Director — Multi-region leadership with premium compensation.

  • Country Manager — Running Omada’s field operation for an entire market.

About Omada.ai

We’re an AI-powered marketing platform built specifically for small businesses. We handle social media, email marketing, ads, and reputation management — so business owners can stop worrying about marketing and focus on what they do best.

We’re backed by HubSpot Ventures and Crosslink Capital, growing across the UK, and building a network of Territory Partners who want to win.

Ready to start? Apply now

Self-employed contractor opportunity. Equal opportunity partner programme.

Compensation: £4K – £8K per month • Offers Commission

This isn’t a job — it’s a partnership. As an Omada Territory Sales Partner, you run your own independent sales operation. You choose your hours, your territory, your approach. We provide the product, the resources, and a compensation structure that means you’re never working for free.

  • Week 5 onward: Generate at least 4 free trial signups per week → receive £500 guaranteed that week

jobs.title: Lerdala skola söker lärare F-3
jobs.description:
I rollen blir du en del av Sektor barn och utbildning. Hos oss står barnens och ungdomarnas utveckling i fokus. Vi arbetar med utbildning från förskola till gymnasieskola och vi strävar efter en pedagogisk helhetssyn från 1 till 20 år. Du ser digitala verktyg som en naturlig del i av din arbetsvardag. Vi är säkra på att du nyttjar digitaliseringen för att tillgängliggöra undervisningen och att du är nyfiken på hur detta kan gagna barns och elevers lärande. Du har tillgång till digitala verktyg i undervisningen och har ett nära samarbete i ett kollegialt lärande.

Lerdala skola är den lilla skolan med stort hjärta! Vi har ca 120 elever i årskurs F-6 och arbetar utifrån inställningen att alla barn är allas barn och låter alla elever mötas i åldersblandade grupper regelbundet för att skapa trygghet och samhörighet över hela skolan.

1 plats(er).

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
I tjänsten ingår att planera, genomföra samt följa upp och utvärdera undervisning utifrån gällande styrdokument, både enskilt och tillsammans med andra. Du arbetar utifrån en helhetssyn där skola och fritids är viktiga delar som tillsammans bidrar till elevers utveckling. Mentorskap ingår samt sedvanliga arbetsuppgifter för lärare.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Du som söker är legitimerad lärare med bred behörighet. Då skolan är liten är förmågan att samarbeta och vara flexibel i arbetsuppgifter avgörande för att du ska lyckas och trivas, därför bör du också värdesätta och bidra till ett gott arbetsklimat. Du har en god insikt i och kunskap om skolans styrdokument och kan på ett effektivt sätt använda dem i ditt dagliga arbete. Vidare har du en god didaktisk och pedagogisk förmåga och kan därför leda och organisera ditt arbete för att skapa studiero och en god lärandemiljö för våra elever under hela deras skoldag.

Den som inte visat utdrag ur belastningsregistret får inte anställas, anlitas eller tas emot i verksamheten enligt gällande lagkrav.

Jämställda och jämlika verksamheter är väldigt viktigt för oss. Olika bakgrunder och tillhörigheter ser vi som en tillgång. Våra arbetsplatser ska också vara fria från diskriminerande strukturer.

Skövde är en öppen och växande stad, med många mötesplatser. Var du än är har du nära till natur och friluftsliv, kultur och aktiviteter för alla åldrar. I Skövde är vi vana vid en hög nivå på alla plan. Här finns bland annat Högskolan i Skövde, Försvarsmakten och Skaraborgs sjukhus. Vi har många framgångsrika företag och startups samt internationella innovationsarenor för industri och dataspelsutveckling. Skövde är staden som inte nöjer sig med något annat än att ligga i framkant.

Välkommen att vara med och spela med oss du också!

jobs.title: Arbetsledare för arbetsträning och aktiviteter, Huddinge kommun
jobs.description:
Värderar du närhet, att växa och skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för alla som bor och verkar i Huddinge kommun? Då erbjuder vi mängder av karriärmöjligheter i en välfungerande och växande kommun med både natur och storstadspuls runt hörnet. Hos oss känner du dig trygg, delaktig och stolt när vi med kraft gör skillnad, varje dag. I Huddinge kommun arbetar vi för att skapa ett hållbart samhälle, där natur, teknik och god service samspelar. Huddinge är en stor Stockholmskommun med cirka 6 400 medarbetare och fler än 110 000 invånare.

Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta den kontaktpersonen som finns angiven i annonsen.

Huddinge kommun arbetar för att vara en trygg, rättssäker och professionell verksamhet. Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kan vi därför komma att genomföra bakgrundskontroller och begära registerutdrag i slutskedet av vissa rekryteringar. Om du blir aktuell för detta får du tydlig information och möjlighet att lämna ditt samtycke innan kontrollen genomförs.

Gymnasie- och arbetsmarknadsförvaltningen ansvarar för arbetsmarknadsinsatser, ekonomiskt bistånd, mottagande av nyanlända och kvotflyktingar samt gymnasieskola, vuxenutbildning och feriepraktik.



1 plats(er).


Arbetsledare för praktiska arbetsträningsplatser för vuxna och ungdomar

Vill du kombinera ditt hantverkskunnande inom textil med ett meningsfullt samhällsuppdrag?
Som arbetsledare ansvarar du för att skapa utvecklande och verklighetsnära arbetsuppgifter för personer som genomför arbetsträning och aktiviteter på uppdrag av Huddinge kommuns förvaltningar och externa samarbetspartners. Genom uppdragen bidrar du till att kommunens verksamheter får stöd samtidigt som deltagarna får möjlighet att utveckla sin arbetsförmåga, stärka sitt självförtroende och ta steg närmare arbete eller studier.

I det dagliga arbetet arbetar du nära deltagarna i vår textilverkstad och ute i olika miljöer inom Huddinge kommun. Din kompetens inom textilt hantverk är central och används både för att driva verksamheten framåt och för att handleda, inspirera och utveckla deltagarna.
Våra deltagare är mellan 16 och 67 år och kan ha varit borta från arbetsmarknaden under en längre tid eller sakna tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet. Därför söker vi dig som ser möjligheter i varje individ och som motiveras av att få människor att växa genom arbete, gemenskap och ansvar.

Här får du ett varierat, kreativt och meningsfullt arbete där du varje dag ser resultatet av ditt engagemang. Du blir en del av en verksamhet som gör konkret skillnad för både invånare och kommunens verksamheter.
Arbetsplatsen är ljus och trivsam och ligger med goda kommunikationer, cirka 15 minuter från Huddinge centrum.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som har:

    Utbildning och kunskap av en hantverksbaserad arbetsträning
    Vi tror att du kanske är lärare inom praktiska ämnen, hantverkspedagog, arbetar i arbetslag med inriktning för ungdomar och vuxna, eller har annan utbildning/erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer som lämplig.
    Erfarenhet från socialt och -eller pedagogiskt arbete.
    Digitala kunskaper för dokumentationsarbete, uppföljning och det dagliga digitala arbetet
    Manuellt B-Körkort

Meriterande är erfarenhet av arbetsledning med arbetsgrupper med anpassningsbehov, samt att du har erfarenhet av att driva en verksamhet.

För att lyckas tror vi att du är:
     Lösningsorienterad-det är viktigt att du med eget ansvar har en god organisations- och planeringsförmåga
    Flexibel- enheten har ett teambaserat arbetssätt, så det ställs krav att kunna arbeta utifrån teamets och enhetens behov.
    Närvarande och tydlig i ditt ledarskap, med förmåga att bygga tillit och struktur
    Kommunikativ- din kommunikation med uppdragsgivare och externa parter sker med tydlighet, enkel
