jobs.title: Pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent søges til Naturly – 37 timer
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for unge – også når dagen ikke går helt efter planen?

Naturly søger en pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent til en fast stilling på 37 timer ugentligt på vores børne- og ungehjem.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan skabe ro, struktur, relation og udvikling omkring unge, som har brug for voksne, der både kan stå fast og være nysgerrige på det, der ligger bag en adfærd.

Hvem er vi?

Naturly er et mindre, privat børne- og ungehjem med 5 pladser efter Barnets Lov § 43 samt 1 fleksibel plads efter Servicelovens § 107.

Vores målgruppe er unge i alderen 12–22 år, som blandt andet kan have ADHD/opmærksomhedsforstyrrelser, angst, stressbelastning, tilknytningsvanskeligheder og erfaringer med omsorgssvigt.

Vi arbejder med KRAP som pædagogisk metode samt en mentaliserende og strukturpædagogisk tilgang.

Hos os skal faglighed ikke kun stå i en metodebeskrivelse. Den skal kunne ses i hverdagen, i relationen til den unge, i vores refleksioner og i vores dokumentation.

Vi søger dig, der

er uddannet pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent, og som har lyst til at arbejde tæt sammen med unge, kolleger og ledelse.

Du må gerne have erfaring fra døgnområdet eller med vores målgruppe, men det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, stabil, ansvarlig og fagligt reflekterende.

Du skal kunne bevare roen, når en ung har svært ved det, være nysgerrig på det, der ligger bag adfærden, og samtidig være tydelig omkring de rammer, der skaber tryghed og forudsigelighed.

Vi prioriterer din faglige udvikling

På Naturly skal man ikke stå alene med de faglige udfordringer. Vi prioriterer tid til refleksion, sparring og udvikling af vores fælles praksis.

Hos os får du blandt andet:

• Løbende supervision
• Faglig sparring med kolleger og ledelse
• Faste faglige drøftelser
• Mulighed for relevante kurser og kompetenceudvikling
• En arbejdsplads med korte beslutningsveje og tæt kontakt til ledelsen
• Mulighed for at være med til at præge og udvikle vores faglige praksis
• Et tværfagligt kollegialt fællesskab med fokus på en fælles faglig retning

Arbejdet foregår i døgnregi, og vagterne vil derfor også omfatte aften, weekend og døgnvagter.

Det vigtigste for os er ikke, om der står pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent på dit eksamensbevis. Det vigtigste er, hvad du bringer med dig ind ad døren – fagligt og menneskeligt.

Stillingen: Fastansættelse, 37 timer ugentligt.
Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt eller efter aftale.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

Har du lyst til at høre mere om stillingen eller Naturly, hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Naturly – et lille sted med plads til udvikling.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in AI-Supported Long-Term Hydropower Scheduling
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? Do you have a background in electrical power engineering, operations research, or a related field, and are you interested in energy systems and markets? As a PhD candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, both in and outside academia. 

The Department of Electric Energy (IEL) at NTNU is seeking a highly motivated candidate for a full-time (100%) PhD position for 3 years as part of the Norwegian Centre on AI for Decisions. You will join the research group Electricity Markets and Energy System Planning (EMESP) at IEL, where we foster an open, inclusive, and collaborative working environment.

Our work environment is defined by its friendly and supportive atmosphere, with regular gatherings such as professional meetings within the research group, weekly colloquia, shared lunches, and “Friday coffee” sessions to end the week. These formal and informal events offer opportunities to share ideas, celebrate milestones, and build relationships. PhD candidates also organize social activities open to everyone interested, fostering a welcoming and inclusive community.

Your immediate Line Manager will be the Head of Department.


About the project

The position will be part of AID, the Norwegian Centre on AI for Decisions, an interdisciplinary national AI centre led by NTNU and SINTEF. AID brings together academic institutions, research organizations, and more than 50 professional organizations. Its primary objective is to advance AI for decision-making through fundamental research and real-world use cases, ensuring that AI-enhanced human decisions and autonomous systems are effective, safe, and trustworthy in sectors critical to society.

This PhD project will contribute to AID by developing trustworthy AI-supported methods for long-term hydropower scheduling. Hydropower plays a central role in the Nordic power system, and deciding when to use or store water is becoming increasingly important as the energy system faces more uncertainty from weather, renewable generation, market developments, and future electricity demand. These decisions depend on uncertain inflows, future electricity prices, reservoir levels, cascade constraints, and the nonlinear relationship between water release and electricity production. Improving such decisions is essential for efficient renewable energy use, energy security, and the reliable operation of hydro-dominated power systems.

The project will focus on how AI can support advanced optimization models for hydropower and energy-system planning. In particular, the research will investigate how the future value of stored water can be represented more accurately when hydropower production is nonlinear and when short-term operational conditions influence long-term reservoir decisions. In line with AID’s research areas, the project will emphasize trust, knowledge embedding, generalization under uncertainty, and human-interpretable decision support.

The PhD candidate will develop and validate a hybrid methodology that combines established stochastic optimization with AI-based learning. The aim is not only to develop new algorithms, but also to understand how AI can be used safely and reliably in decision-support tools for the energy sector. The enhanced framework will be tested on Nordic hydropower use cases, including long-term and medium-term hydropower scheduling, multi-reservoir cascade operation, hydropower participation in energy and reserve markets, and planning under high renewable variability. In this way, the project responds to the growing need for safe and trustworthy AI tools in demanding, decision-critical systems.

The PhD candidate will be hosted in the Electricity Markets and Energy Systems Planning (EMESP) group at the Department of Electric Energy, NTNU. The main supervisor will be Professor Hossein Farahmand, with co-supervision from experts in stochastic hydropower optimization and AI for decision-making, including Professor Arild Helseth, Associate Professor Jayaprakash Rajasekharan, Professor Sebastien Gros, and Research Manager Signe Riemer-Sørensen, depending on the final methodological focus of the PhD project.


Duties of the position
  • Carry out research of high quality within the framework described above
  • Participate in activities of the EMESP research group 
  • Complete academic training consisting of coursework corresponding to a minimum 30 ECTS
  • Contribute to publications in relevant journals and to popular science dissemination
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions 

Career-enhancing work, which is in addition to the research project and doctoral education, may be offered to a candidate who demonstrates clear motivation and ability for such work, and if the Department determines there is a need. Examples of career-enhancing work include, but are not limited to, contributing to teaching, laboratory and exercise teaching, supervision, and examination work within the employee's areas of competence. 

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in either electrical power engineering, computer science, control engineering, chemistry, managerial economics with strong quantitative skills, or physics or mathematics with a specialization in operations research. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. Master's students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and no later than autumn 2026.
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you may be considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education, i.e., by having relevant work experience and/or published/publishable scientific papers.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the Faculty's Doctoral Programme.
  • Experience with optimization modelling and numerical optimization tools, such as JuMP, Pyomo, Gurobi, CPLEX, HiGHS, or similar frameworks and solvers, will be considered an important qualification.
  • You must have English language skills, both written and spoken, corresponding to the scale B2 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). Applicants who are not native English speakers are encouraged to document their English language proficiency. This can be done through an approved English language test. One of the following test scores could be documented for this purpose: 
    • TOEFL internet-based test (iBT) - Score equivalent to the B2 level: 79 - 101. 
    • IELTS - Score equivalent to the B2 level: 5.5 - 6.0 
    • Cambridge English - Score equivalent to the B2 level: 160 - 179.

Further assessment of both written and oral English language skills, as well as the ability to communicate fluently, will be conducted throughout the selection process and during any interviews for all applicants.

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Work and/or research experience in electricity markets, hydropower scheduling, energy system modeling, and operations research or optimization.
  • Very good programming and modeling skills, preferably in Julia, Python, or a similar programming language.
  • Knowledge and/or experience with Machine Learning, Reinforcement Learning, AI-based time-series forecasting
  • English language skills, both written and spoken, corresponding to the scale C1 in the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). See which scores are equivalent to the C1 level here.

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), the candidate is expected to: 

  • demonstrate strong motivation, curiosity, and a learning-oriented mindset
  • work independently, take initiative, and maintain good structure and discipline in their work
  • communicate effectively and collaborate well with supervisors and peers
  • show resilience and work constructively when facing challenges or setbacks
  • demonstrate integrity and a strong sense of responsibility in their research conduct

Emphasis will be placed on personal and interpersonal qualities.


We offer

Evaluate and remove/add what is relevant for the position.

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years, with the possibility of an additional 3 to 12 months of employment related to career-enhancing activities. 

The option for career-enhancing work may be offered to a candidate who has clear motivation and ability for such work, and if the Department deems it necessary. This will be clarified with the candidate during and after any interview. 

If you cannot document skills in Norwegian, Swedish, or Danish at level A2 upon employment, NTNU offers the opportunity to take Norwegian courses corresponding to at least 15 credits. NTNU will facilitate this. 

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Electric Power Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • A cover letter where the applicant explains personal motivation, briefly summarizes scientific work, and describes how their background is a good fit (400 words/1 page).
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project, and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages, including references). This proposal shall neither be deemed final nor binding for the project.
  • CV.
  • If you have testimonials of work experience, submit them.
  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees. If you have not yet completed your Master's thesis, you must provide confirmation of your estimated submission date for the Master's thesis, or confirmation that your Master's thesis has been submitted.
    • Applicants from universities outside Norway are asked to provide a diploma supplement or similar document that details the study program and grading system. 
  • A copy of the Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you are encouraged to include a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be provided before assuming the position. 
  • If you have publications or other relevant research work, submit them.
  • You are encouraged to include documentation of English language proficiency if you are not a native speaker of English. 
  • Name and contact information of three referees.


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.


Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Hossein Farahmand by email at hossein.farahmand@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact the Head of Office, Bodil Wold, by email at bodil.wold@ntnu.no. 

Application deadline: 19.10.2026

-----------------

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality.

jobs.title: Drive the Technology Behind Our Digital Growth
jobs.description:
Are you a senior developer who enjoys balancing hands-on development with technical leadership? Do you thrive in environments where technology has a direct impact on customer experience, business growth and digital innovation?

 

NutraQ is an international, technology-driven company operating across 15 European markets and the US. As our business continues to grow, we are strengthening our eCommerce team and establishing a new key role: Tech Lead eCommerce.

 

This is a unique opportunity to take technical and professional lead within the eCommerce team and shape the development of our platforms. You will play a central role in shaping our technical direction, guiding a distributed development team and ensuring our ecosystem continues to support growth, scalability and great customer experiences.

 

Alongside Head of eCommerce and UX, you will drive the development and continuous improvement of our platform, translating business needs into robust technical solutions that drive conversion and customer satisfaction.

You will report to the Head of eCommerce and be part of a professional and experienced tech-team of developers and UX designers. Together with the team you will be a key contributor to NutraQ's continued investment in technology and digital development.

 

What you will be responsible for

  • Ensure high-quality delivery by coaching and supporting in-house tech team and external developers, promoting knowledge sharing and building strong technical capabilities across the team.
  • Provide technical guidance on architecture, technology choices and implementation.
  • Actively contribute to hands-on development, including coding and implementation, while promoting coding standards, technical best practices and high-quality solutions.
  • Drive engineering efficiency and team output by integrating modern AI tools, automated processes, and optimized workflows into daily practices.
  • Drive improvements across our web ecosystem, including CMS, performance, integrations, customer journeys and functionality.

What you bring

We believe the right candidate combines strong technical capabilities with a pragmatic mindset and the ability to create direction and engagement among developers.

 

You likely bring:

  • Strong experience in web development, ideally within D2C e-commerce or subscription-based businesses.
  • Strong full-stack skills across modern frontend frameworks, backend systems, APIs and CMS platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with technology used for modern web applications. We use React, Next and .NET as of now.
  • Experience across the full development lifecycle, from architecture and technical direction to implementation and optimisation
  • Experience mentoring, coaching or technically guiding developers.
  • Experience working with CMS platforms and modern web technologies.
  • Excellent communication skills in English; Scandinavian languages are a plus.
  • Exceptional drive and proactive approach.
  • Curiosity and a strong interest in keeping up with technological developments.

Why join NutraQ?

At NutraQ, technology is a critical driver of business success. As Tech Lead eCommerce, you will have the opportunity to influence both technology and business outcomes in a highly visible role.

 

We offer:

  • A newly established key position with significant influence on technical direction and future platform development.
  • The opportunity to combine technical lead with hands-on development.
  • Being part of a highly experienced and stable international development environment.
  • A dynamic and entrepreneurial culture with short decision-making paths and high trust.
  • The opportunity to work with modern technology, eCommerce and AI in an international company with ambitious growth plans.
  • Competitive employee benefits.
  • Modern offices at Skøyen in Oslo.
  • A unique and strong culture where our people focus on having fun, collaboration and development.

If this sounds like the right next step for you, we look forward to receiving your application.

Please contact Christina Waale Salomaa (+47 909 769 86 / cws@greatpeople.no) or Elisabeth Hagen (+47 924 12 119 / eh@greatpeople.no) for a conversation about this exciting opportunity.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NutraQ group is a leading international company within the health and beauty industry, owned by Orkla. We develop, produce and distribute a broad range of products directly to consumers through a digital non-binding subscription business model, with a turnover around 1,4 billion NOK.

 

Founded in 2002, by two Norwegian entrepreneurs, the company is today part of Orkla; one of the most influential investment companies in Norway.

With more than 230 employees, broad international presence across 15 European markets and the US, NutraQ holds a strong commercial standing with high standards and a culture that embraces entrepreneurship, integrity and diversity. The NutraQ headquarter is located in central Oslo, at Skøyen.

jobs.title: Materiaalikoordinaattori
jobs.description:
Oletko sinä tiimimme seuraava huippuosaaja?

Haemme nyt sisustusmateriaalien materiaalikoordinaattoria liittymään Architectural Accommodation osastolle, joka toimii osana Hotel Design -yksikköä!

Tule mukaan suunnittelemaan ja toteuttamaan maailman edistyksellisimpiä risteilyaluksia ja jätä kädenjälkesi laivanrakennuksen historiaan! Meyer Turku tarjoaa sinulle kannustavan työpaikan, jossa voit kehittyä ja tavoitella omannakoistasi tyouraa.

Hotel Design yksikkömme vastaa laivan kaikkien yleisten tilojen ulkoasusta ja suunnittelusta. Tähän kuuluvat hytit, hyttialueet, julkiset tilat (kuten teatterit, ravintolat ja miehistön julkiset tilat), hotellin palvelutekniset tilat ja arkkitehtoniset ulkoalueet. Yksikön vastuulla on toteuttaa asiakkaamme toimittaman arkkitehtimateriaalin design, sääntöjen, määräysten ja sovitun tason sallimissa puitteissa. Vastaamme myös eri järjestelmien reitityksen, sijainnin ja sijoittelun suunnittelusta sekä rungon suunnitteluun tarvittavien aukkojen koordinoinnista.

Architectural Accommodation osasto vastaa arkkitehtonisista systeemeistä ja sisustusalueiden perussuunnittelun koordinoimisesta. Lisäksi ryhmällä on ADA-, luovutusdokumentaatio-, IHM-, 3D- ja Sustainability spesialistit.

Osana Architectural Accommodation osastoa Material Coordination tiimimme vastaa matkustajille ja miehistölle näkyvien tilojen perussuunnittelusta ja tiettyjen materiaalien hankinnasta – sinun roolisi osana tiimiäsi on varmistaa, että tehtävään liittyvät hankintakokonaisuudet pysyvät hallinnassa moniprojektiympäristössä. Tiloja ovat esimerkiksi mm. hyttialueitten käytävät, sairaala ja ohjaamo.

Tehtävänkuvaus:

Tehtävääsi kuuluu materiaalikoordinaattorille nimetyn kokonaisuuden hallinta. Toimimme moniprojektiympäristössä eli osallistut tehtäväkokonaisuuden vastuullisena samanaikaisesti usean eri laivaprojektin vaiheisiin alusta loppuun. Toteutamme arkkitehtoniset ratkaisut laivanrakennuksen sääntöjen ja määräysten mukaan.

Tehtäväsi on koordinoida telakan rakentamien alueiden sisustusmateriaalien ja kalusteiden hankintoja osana tiimiä. Hankittavia materiaaleja ovat esimerkiksi katto- ja seinämateriaalit, kaiteet, verhot, WC-materiaalit. Valmistelet tekniset määritelmät ja rajaukset hankintoja varten, laadit kyselyaineiston liitteineen ja vastaat tarve- ja toimitusaikatauluista. Hankinnat tapahtuvat yhteistyössä ostajan kanssa.

Tehtävässä olet vastuussa budjetoinnista ja hankintakokonaisuuksiin liittyvien kulujen seurannasta ja hallinnasta. Ennakointi sekä kehitys- ja säästötoimenpiteet kuuluvat vastuullesi.

Tehtävään kuuluu vahva kommunikaatio eri toimijoiden kanssa. Osallistut neuvotteluihin kokonaisuuksien asiantuntijana. Materiaalin ekologisuuden ja soveltuvuuden selvittäminen käyttötarkoitukseen on vastuullasi ja hyväksytät ratkaisut ja toteutuksen tarvittaessa asiakkaallamme sekä tuotannossa.

Materiaaliosaamisen lisäksi tehtävä vaatii ymmärrystä teknisistä vaatimuksista ja ratkaisuista.

Työtehtäväsi ryhmässä muokkautuu ja kehittyy kokemuksesi mukaisesti. Nyt haemme henkilöä kasvamaan vastuulliseen tehtävään.

Mitä odotamme sinulta:

Haemme tiimiimme aktiivista henkilöä, joka kykenee toimimaan tehokkaana ja positiivisena linkkinä niin oman ryhmän, kuin muiden osastojen, asiakkaan, arkkitehtien ja aluerakentajan välillä. Hallitset hyvin aikataulutuksen ja pystyt toimimaan samanaikaisesti usean eri tahon kanssa itsenäisesti.

Sinulla on kyky toimia hektisessä moniprojektiympäristössä, joka taas edellyttää kykyä suunnitella oma ajankäyttö projektien tarpeiden mukaan.

Taitoa ja näkemystä toimia asiakasrajapinnassa, joka on neuvotteluja ja päivittäistä kanssakäymistä telakan projektiosaston, perussuunnittelu- ja sisustusvarustelun osastojen kanssa. Työ sisältää myös materiaalitoimittajien kanssa neuvotteluja ja tiedonvaihtoa läpi projektien. Telakan organisaatiossa edustetaan systeemin parasta osaamista.

Eduksi katsotaan laivateollisuudessa yleisesti käytettyjen sisustusmateriaalien ja toimittajien tuntemus, kustannustieto sekä laivapuolen sääntöjen ja vaatimusten tuntemus.

Seuraavien ohjelmistojen hallintaa: Excel ja muut Office ohjelmat, SAP, Kronodoc /Wave, AutoCad / jonkin 3D ohjelma

Olet oma-aloitteinen, tartut reippaasti toimeen ja haluat olla mukana luomassa positiivista ja kannustavaa ilmapiiriä. Eduksi on, että sinulla on kokemusta projektikoordinoinnista ja tehtävään sopiva koulutus. Lisäksi tarvitset hyvää suullista ja kirjallista englannin kielen taitoa.

Kokemus laivanrakennuksesta katsotaan eduksi, mutta meillä kasvat laivanrakentajaksi kokeneiden osaajien opastuksessa.

Huomioithan, että edellytämme valitulta henkilöltä hyväksyttyä huumausainetestiä sekä terveystarkastuksessa todettua sopivuutta työsuhteen tehtäviin.

Miksi tulla meille töihin?

Pääset työskentelemään laivanrakennuksen huipulla. Maailman edistyksellisimmät risteilyalukset suunnitellaan ja rakennetaan Meyer Turun telakalla. Meidät tunnetaan huipputeknologisesta osaamisestamme, monialaisesta tuotannostamme sekä innovatiivisista ratkaisuistamme, jotka vievät koko laivanrakennusalaa eteenpäin. Tilauskantamme ulottuu pitkälle tulevaisuuteen. Vuonna 2024 liikevaihtomme oli 1,82 miljardia euroa ja työntekijöitä oli noin 2 200.

Olet osa huipputekijöiden porukkaa. Meillä on osaamista, jota ei löydy mistään muualta. Telakallamme on yli 450 ammattia, ja olemme kaikki laivanrakentajia – jokaisen työpanosta tarvitaan yhteisen päämäärän saavuttamiseen.

Saat myötätuulta urallesi. Kannustamme työntekijöitämme kehittymään, oppimaan uutta ja tarttumaan tilaisuuksiin. Mahdollistamme pitkät työurat: uusia, mielenkiintoisia työtehtäviä löytyy usein oman organisaatiomme sisältä.

Työsuhde-edut ovat kohdallaan. Telakan oma työterveysasema tarjoaa monipuolisia palveluja, apua ja tukea koko työurasi ajan. Vapaa-ajalla voit käydä Meyer Turun kuntosalilla, osallistua monipuolisten harrastusryhmiemme toimintaan tai käyttää liikunta- ja kulttuurietuja muihin harrastuksiisi.

Your role and the team

In this role, you will act as the bridge between business and technology, working closely with marine engineering experts, the Group AI team, and external partners. Initially, the role is highly hands-on, combining strategic ownership with practical experimentation, prototyping, and solution development. As our AI capabilities grow, the role may evolve into leading a broader Marine AI development function.

- Turning business and engineering challenges into practical AI solutions

Our ideal candidate is a technically capable and business-minded professional who understands the potential of modern AI technologies, can translate Marine business challenges into concrete development initiatives, and drives those initiatives from concept to implementation.

jobs.title: Nu söker vi en timvikarie till vårat team!
jobs.description:
Personlig assistent till man i rullstol - Bollebygd

Vi söker nu en engagerad och omtänksam personlig assistent till en man i rullstol. Som assistent kommer du att vara en viktig del av kundens vardag och ge stöd inom olika områden.

I denna roll kommer du att assistera kunden med personlig hygien, måltider, övriga dagliga aktiviteter samt vara behjälplig med att svara i telefonen och hantera kommunikation med externa parter. Kunden är aktiv och gillar att gå på bio, teater och åka på utflykter. Du kommer vara kundens förlängda armar och ben, och din närvaro kommer göra en verklig skillnad i hans liv.  Kunden har en egen bil som assistent kör när man ska på aktiviteter så körkort är ett krav för tjänsten.

Erfarenhet/Kvalifikationer:

    Tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta som personlig assistent eller inom vården är meriterande men inte ett krav.
    Förmåga att kommunicera tydligt och respektfullt.
    Empatisk och tålamodig samt har förmåga att lyssna och vara stödjande.
    Förmåga att vara flexibel och anpassa sig till kundens behov och önskemål.
    Hantera lyft

Personliga egenskaper:

Vi söker dig som är empatisk, lyhörd och har förmågan att skapa en trygg och tillitsfull relation med kunden. Du är noggrann och pålitlig samt har förmågan att arbeta självständigt och ta egna initiativ när det behövs. Det är viktigt att du är följsam och respektfull gentemot kundens integritet och önskemål. Du har inga problem med axlar eller rygg då en del tunga lyft förekommer i arbetet.

Körkort och bil krävs då det inte går att ta sig till kunden med kollektivtrafik.

Vad vi erbjuder dig som anställd:

    En meningsfull och givande arbetsuppgift där du kan göra verklig skillnad i en persons liv.
    Möjlighet att utveckla din förmåga att kommunicera, arbeta med empati och skapa relationer.
    Ett positivt och stöttande arbetsklimat där din insats uppskattas och värderas högt.

Vi söker nu en timvikarie som kan hoppa in vid sjukdom eller när andra assistenter vill vara lediga. Arbetspassen är dygn (07.30-08.00) med sovande jour.


Om du känner att du har den empati, engagemang och vilja som krävs för att vara en bra personlig assistent, och vill vara en del av att skapa en meningsfull vardag för en annan person, tveka inte att söka till denna position. Vi ser fram emot att få träffa dig och välkomna dig till vårt team!

Monument Assistans är alternativet för personer med personlig assistans som söker skräddarsydda lösningar. Vi har hög kompetens och bred erfarenhet av personlig assistans. För att vi ska kunna hjälpa våra kunder på allra bästa sätt så arbetar vi med hög tillgänglighet och ett nära och personligt samarbete.

Vi vet att vår personal är nyckeln till att bedriva en bra personlig assistans. Därför är det centralt för oss att du som medarbetare är både känner stolthet och glädje över att arbeta hos oss. Vi på Monument Assistans vill därför ge dig möjligheten att utvecklas i din yrkesroll. Vi uppskattar nyfikna och engagerade medarbetare.

Vi erbjuder dig goda lönevillkor, ett nära ledarskap och friskvårdsersättning. Vi ger dig en arbetsmiljö där det är högt i tak och där du har goda möjligheter att påverka din egen arbetssituation. Vi tar gärna fram individuella fortbildningslösningar beroende på i vilken typ av uppdrag du arbetar i. Hos oss får du möjligheten att växa!

jobs.title: Vi söker lärare till individuella programmet
jobs.description:
Västerviks gymnasium


Barn och utbildningsförvaltningens vision är: Kompetens för livet, lust att lära – rätt att lyckas. Alla barn och elever är nyfikna, kreativa och tänkande. Hos oss har alla en känsla för tolerans och solidaritet. Vi möter barn och elever med höga förväntningar. Vi tror på deras förmåga att lyckas i lärandet för livet. I vårt arbete är mötet med barn och elever, undervisning, medborgarskap och ledarskap centrala delar för att nå vår vision.

Var med i ett spännande och viktigt arbete hos oss! Vi söker nu en behörig lärare till den Anpassade Gymnasieskolan och det individuella programmet för undervisning i ämnesområden.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Ditt arbete som lärare på den Anpassad gymnasieskolan innebär att du enskilt och tillsammans med ditt arbetslag planerar, genomför och utvärderar ditt arbete enligt skolans styrdokument.

I ditt arbete med undervisning på individuella programmet så planerar du elevernas hela skoldag tillsammans med ditt arbetslag där ni arbetar nära varandra och alltid med eleven i fokus.

Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats som kännetecknas av förtroende och öppenhet, gemenskap och samarbete, engagemang och meningsfullhet, samt ansvarstagande och initiativförmåga. På vår arbetsplats är medarbetarskap ett centralt begrepp.

Din kompetens

Vi söker främst dig som är behörig lärare med specialisering mot intellektuell funktionsvariation.

Du genomför en varierad och anpassad undervisning utifrån elevernas behov och nuläge. Erfarenhet av arbete med ungdomar med intellektuell funktionsnedsättning inom Anpassad gymnasieskolan är ett krav. I din roll är du delaktig i att skapa en trygg grund för våra elever som har stort behov av stöd, individanpassad pedagogik och social träning.

Vi söker dig som kan bidra till Västerviks gymnasium genom att du tar ett eget ansvar för din hälsa och välbefinnande, för utvecklingen av resurser och för hanteringen av förändringar som krävs i ditt arbete.

För att lyckas tror vi att du är trygg, stabil och har självinsikt. Vi tror att du har lätt att anpassa dig till ändrade omständigheter och identifierar inte bara problem som uppstår, utan är själv en del av lösningen genom att bidra med idéer, alternativ och flexibilitet. Du uttrycker en positiv attityd och handlar i enlighet med fattade beslut, policys och riktlinjer eftersom du ser det större perspektivet och hela verksamhetens bästa i agerande och beslut. Vi tror att du är utåtriktad och socialt aktiv i yrkesmässiga sammanhang, där du skapar och underhåller relationer. Du lyssnar, kommunicerar och löser konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.

Du tar ansvar för din relation till medarbetare och arbetsgrupp. Vi är varandras arbetsmiljö och du bidrar aktivt till att skapa en trivsam arbetsplats. Du känner ett självklart ansvar för skolans/arbetsgivarens uppdrag och förstår att vi endast kan lyckas tillsammans.

Övrigt

Tjänsten kan komma att tas i anspråk för intern rörlighet.

Behöver du hjälp att hitta bostad försöker vi hjälpa dig med det. Inflyttarservice i Västerviks kommun hjälper till med tips, information och kontakter för arbete, bostad, skolor med mera. Inflyttarservice anordnar också återkommande träffar för nyinflyttade för att ge möjlighet att lära känna nya människor och en snabbare väg in i livet i Västervik.

Läs mer om vad Västerviks kommun kan erbjuda dig som anställd hos oss www.vastervik.se/jobba-hos-oss

jobs.title: Sosial og sjarmerende jente på 4 år søker varme og trygge assistenter
jobs.description:
Jeg er en jente på 4 år som er født med en genfeil. Genfeilen innebærer blant annet psykisk utviklingshemming, nedsatt syn og epilepsi.

Jeg er nå på jakt etter assistenter som kan bidra til å gi meg gode opplevelser i hverdagen. Jeg trenger assistanse til stell/bleieskift og personlig hygiene, forflytning, ernæring/mating, medisinering og aktivisering/lek.

I ukedagene vil du ta meg imot når jeg kommer hjem fra barnehagen, samt bidra til å gi meg en rolig avslutning på dagen. I helgene kan dagene våre bestå av at vi er på trilletur og sammen utforsker lekeplasser i nærområdet, eller andre utflukter. Det kan også hende vi besøker familie og venner, eller bare tilbringer tid hjemme sammen med familien min. Jeg ønsker gjerne at du tar initiativ til aktiviteter vi kan gjøre sammen utenfor hjemmet. Noen dager liker jeg godt at det skjer masse, mens andre dager trenger jeg ro og å trekke meg litt tilbake. Jeg blir veldig glad om du leser bøker for meg, og jeg elsker musikk så du kan veldig gjerne synge for meg og. Jeg blir også veldig glad for en god dose kos. 

Jeg har to søsken så det er viktig at du trives med flere barn rundt deg, da vi er en familie med mye liv og røre. 

Jeg klarer ikke å drikke selv så jeg får vann og medisiner gjennom en knapp på magen.

Ettersom jeg heller ikke kan gå eller krabbe må jeg løftes en del, og det er derfor viktig at du er i god fysisk form. 

Enkle praktiske oppgaver i hjemmet må også påregnes.

Jeg trenger at verden bringes til meg og at jeg har rause assistenter som ser meg for den jeg er, og gir rom for min måte å være i verden på. 

Jeg ser etter deg som:

• Er varm, kjærlig og omsorgsfull

• Er fleksibel og løsningsorientert 

• Er trygg, tålmodig og ansvarsbevisst

• Er initiativrik og leken, og ikke redd for å by på seg selv

• Har et genuint ønske om å jobbe med barn med sammensatte behov

• Ønsker et stabilt og langvarig arbeidsforhold

• Kan kommunisere godt på norsk


Som assistent hos meg vil du:

• Få god opplæring og oppfølging 

• Delta i familiens aktiviteter og hverdagsliv

• Få en selvstendig jobb med tillit og ansvar

• Bli godt ivaretatt og bli en del av et nært og varmt familieliv, samtidig som du gjør en meningsfull og viktig jobb.

• Lønn og andre vilkår ihht. Landsoverenskomsten for BPA


Arbeidstiden vil være en ettermiddag/kveld i uken og ca en helg i mnd. Det er også ønskelig om du kan jobbe noe ekstra i ferier, helligdager og ellers ved behov. 

Førerkort er en fordel, men ikke et krav. 

All nødvendig opplæring vil bli gitt av mamma og pappa.

Det er ønskelig med snarlig oppstart.


Tenker du at du er den jeg leter etter? Da håper jeg vi hører fra deg. 

Aktuelle kandidater vil bli invitert til intervju fortløpende.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE POSITION

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

  • Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million
  • Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics
  • Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases
  • Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements
  • Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level
  • Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments
  • Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance
  • Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

  • Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option
  • Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate
  • The ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact, and to plan your day-to-day work independently
  • The ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing both text and numbers
  • The ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages
  • The technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and applications
  • A passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions

At a personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious, with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism. In addition, you will receive:

  • A central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales and commercial development
  • A strong professional environment with close collaboration across the Group
  • Thorough on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation
  • Good opportunities for both professional and personal development
  • Attractive terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health insurance
  • A good canteen scheme and active staff association
  • An informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and sustainability

ABOUT THE BIRN GROUP

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s largest foundry Groups. We supply highly processed cast iron components to the truck industry and others, as well as industrial hydraulics and machine components. Sustainability, the circular economy and responsibility are integral parts of our DNA. The Group employs around 750 staff, of which around 480 are in Holstebro.

APPLICATIONS

If you have any questions about the position or the BIRN Group, please feel free to contact Group CSO Peter Frost Jepsen on tel. +45 3016 0160 or Group HR Manager Morten Madsen on tel. +45 3016 0115.

Please note that we are processing applications on a continuous basis and will close the position once we have found the right candidate. As mentioned above, the start date can be adjusted to suit the right candidate. Please submit your application via our recruitment system, which you will find at [insert link]. Candidates who proceed to a second interview can expect to complete a personality profile as part of the process.

We would encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity or age, to apply for the position.

Region Värmland works to ensure that everyone in the region enjoys good health and that Värmland remains an attractive and competitive place to live. We are approximately 8,600 employees working across healthcare, dental care, regional development, public transport, culture, and education.

Healthcare is the largest area within Region Värmland. Together with our patients, we strengthen public health and develop healthcare to contribute to a high quality of life for all who live here. Contact

For more information about Region Värmland, opportunities and what we can offer, please contact rekrytering.utland@regionvarmland.se.

Om Region Värmland

Vi är till för att alla som bor här ska må bra och för att vår region ska vara attraktiv och konkurrenskraftig. Vi gör skillnad inom hälso- och sjukvård, tandvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och kultur och bildning. Vi möter människor i livets största stunder och i alla de där vardagsögonblicken där emellan. Vår vision är livskvalitet i världsklass. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss och våra förmåner och följ oss på sociala medier.

Ett utslag i detta register kan komma att påverka din möjlighet till anställning.

Har du skyddad identitet och vill göra en ansökan ber vi dig att kontakta Kompetensförsörjningsenhet HR via Regionens växel 010-831 50 00. Då får du hjälp att lämna in din ansökan utan att den hanteras i Varbi. Tänk på att endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.

jobs.title: Car Registration Specialist
jobs.description:
Car Registration Specialist

Location: Stockholm

About the us

Green SM is a leading electric vehicle (EV) and sustainable mobility solutions provider headquartered in Vietnam. With a commitment to transforming urban transportation, we have successfully expanded into the Global Market and are now preparing to launch operations in the EU Market. Join us in driving the future of sustainable mobility.



Website: Green SM - Electric Mobility Service, 5-Star Quality | Green SM



Position Overview

The Car Registration Specialist is responsible for supporting the end-to-end vehicle registration process to ensure GSM Europe’s EV fleet is legally ready for operation in the local market. This role will coordinate documentation, registration applications, insurance confirmation, license plates, and related administrative procedures to ensure vehicles are ready for deployment on time.

Key Responsibilities

    Support vehicle registration processes for GSM Denmark EV fleet across assigned markets
    Prepare and manage registration documents including CoC, vehicle titles, customs, insurance, and compliance paperwork
    Coordinate with transport authorities, registration offices, and external agencies to ensure legal compliance
    Monitor local EV regulations, registration requirements, tax incentives, and subsidy policies
    Execute and track bulk vehicle registrations to support operational launch timelines
    Follow vehicle status from delivery through license plate issuance and road readiness
    Coordinate with insurance providers and external partners to resolve registration issues and documentation gaps
    Manage license plate distribution, vehicle records, and fleet administration processes including deregistration and ownership transfer
    Collaborate closely with Logistics, Fleet Operations, Insurance, and local teams to ensure timely “Ready-to-Drive” vehicle deployment



Requirements

    Bachelor's degree in business administration, Logistics, Automotive, or related fields.
    2–4 years of experience in vehicle registration, fleet administration, leasing operations, logistics administration, or related fields.
    Understanding local vehicle registration processes and administrative requirements.
    Familiarity with electric vehicles, vehicle imports, or EV-related documentation is an advantage.
    Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple documents and cases at the same time.
    Good coordination skills with authorities, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
    Professional fluency in the local language and English.

Why Join GSM

    Be part of the founding European setup team and grow with us as we expand
    Backed by Vietnam's largest company, with the growth trajectory of a fast-scaling European startup
    Real decision-making authority with tangible, visible impact
    Learn alongside counterparts across other markets
    Help build the future of green transport in Europe

jobs.title: Familieveileder
jobs.description:
Vi søker etter deg som har et stort engasjement for, og et ønske om å hjelpe sårbare barn, unge og familier. Du er god på å bygge relasjoner og skape resultater sammen med barn og familier.

Tiltaksavdelingen har en medarbeider som skal gå av med pensjon, og en som skal redusere stillingen sin. I den forbindelse har vi ledig en fast stilling, samt to vikariat som familieveileder. Vi søker faglig sterke, engasjerte og trygge familieveiledere med stort engasjement for barn, unge og deres familier. Til den ene vikariat stillingen ser vi særlig etter en person som kan jobbe med praktisk veiledning og bistand i hjemmet.

Som familieveileder i tiltaksavdelingen vil du gi veiledning til foreldre, og ha samtaler med barn og ungdom etter vedtak fra de andre avdelingene. Du er en del av laget rundt barnet/ungdommen, og deltar på samarbeidsmøter. Du har også ansvar for evaluering av veiledningstiltak, samt å skrive sluttrapporter. Vi har en traume basert tilnærming, og veiledningsmetoden blir tilpasset til den enkelte families behov. På tiltaksavdelingen har de ansatte ulike sertifiseringer og utdanning, eksempelvis Marte Meo, PMTO, PYC, CPP og familieterapi.

Du blir en del av en tverrfaglig tjeneste som består av blant annet fagkonsulenter, kontaktpersoner, familieveiledere og MST-CAN terapeuter og psykolog, som har fokus på hverandres styrker og på et godt arbeidsmiljø hvor alle kan trives.

I tjenesten jobber vi med kontinuerlig forbedring og utvikling, for å møte behovene til det enkelte barn og familie på en god, rask og effektiv måte. Samtidig skal vi oppleves som vennlig, respektfull, trygg og forutsigbar, og gi reell mulighet til medvirkning.

Tiltaksavdelingen består av avdelingsleder, tre fagkonsulenter og 24 familieveiledere, alle med bred metodisk kompetanse. 

Barnevernstjenesten i Stavanger har ca 210 årsverk fordelt på syv fagavdelinger, samt administrasjonsavdeling og avdeling for fagutvikling. 

Vi ønsker å være tilgjengelige, og noe arbeid på ettermiddags- og kveldstid må påregnes.

Barnevernstjenesten er sentralt plassert i moderne lokaler i Hermetikkgata 5.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Gjennomføre kartlegginger av foreldres omsorgs utøvelse og av barnets utvikling
  • Utøve systematisk veiledning i familier som fremmer positiv utvikling i barnets omsorgssituasjon
  • Gjennomføre familie samtaler og barnesamtaler
  • Samarbeide med andre instanser for å sikre en helhetlig innsats rundt barnet
  • Dokumentere alt arbeid i vårt journalsystem, evaluere systematisk og skrive sluttrapporter etter endt veiledning.
  • Følge intern opplæring og holde seg oppdatert innen lovverk, rutiner,  organisasjonsstruktur og strategisk og faglig retning i barneverntjenesten

Vitneførsel for barneverns – og helsenemnda, samt domstoler må påberegnes.

   Kvalifikasjoner
  • Bachelorgrad som sosionom/barnevernspedagog. Annen relevant utdanning kan vurderes dersom du har lang og relevant erfaring med direkte veiledning/endring og utviklingstiltak til barn og familier
  • Sterkt ønskelig med videreutdanning i familieterapi og/eller relevante metoder og sertifiseringer til bruk i arbeid med barn og familier
  • Erfaring med direkte veiledning til barn og foreldre
  • Ønskelig med erfaring fra barnevern, men ikke et krav
  • Du har god muntlig og skriftlig framstillingsevne, og har god kjennskap til IT-verktøy
  • Dersom du har annet morsmål enn norsk, må du dokumentere at du har språknivå tilsvarende B2. Gjelder ikke for søkere med et skandinavisk språk som morsmål.
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Tilfredsstillende politiattest er en forutsetning for ansettelse

 

For vikar stillingen:

  • Bachelorgrad som sosionom/barnevernspedagog
  • Erfaring med direkte veiledning til barn og foreldre
  • Relevante metoder/sertifiseringer til bruk i arbeid med barn og familier er ønskelig 
  • Du har god muntlig og skriftlig framstillingsevne, og har god kjennskap til IT-verktøy
  • Dersom du har annet morsmål enn norsk, må du dokumentere at du har språknivå tilsvarende B2. Gjelder ikke for søkere med et skandinavisk språk som morsmål.
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Tilfredsstillende politiattest er en forutsetning for ansettelse

jobs.title: Hydraulics Engineer
jobs.description:
Stockholm – Full-time

Wind helped us discover our planet — now it can help us preserve it.

On behalf of AlfaWall Oceanbird, we are now looking for a Hydraulics Engineer to join their fast-growing and highly innovative team in Stockholm.

Oceanbird is driving a revolution within sustainable shipping by developing wing sail technology for the global maritime market. The company is a 50/50 joint venture between Alfa Laval and Wallenius, backed by strong industrial expertise but operating as an independent, forward-leaning organization.

This is a unique opportunity to be part of a company at the forefront of transforming global shipping.

About the role

The hydraulic system is at the very core of Oceanbird’s wing sail technology — essentially acting as its heart and muscles. It consists of a large main hydraulic power unit, a backup system, cylinders and motors enabling the wing’s main actuation functions.

The project is currently in an exciting phase, with the first full-scale system being tested at their test site in Landskrona.

Your responsibilities

In this role, you will:

    

Design hydraulic systems and create hydraulic schematic diagrams

    

Select key components such as valves, pumps, filters and piping

    

Perform hands-on testing, including measurements and analysis of results

    

Ensure system safety and conduct risk assessments

    

Participate in testing and commissioning onboard vessels

    

Define requirements, concepts and solutions for future generations of the system

    

Act as the technical interface towards suppliers

    

Support regulatory processes and documentation

Who we are looking for

To succeed in this role, you likely have:

    

A Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in hydraulics, mechanical or mechatronics engineering

    

Experience or education within hydraulic system design

    

A self-driven and proactive mindset

    

Strong collaboration skills and a team-oriented approach

Meriting experience

It is considered a strong advantage if you have experience in one or more of the following:

    

Practical hydraulic installation work

    

Hydraulic testing, measurement tools and data analysis

    

Hydraulic design tools (preferably HyDraw)

    

Control systems, sensors and electrical installations

    

Modeling and simulation (Matlab/Simulink)

    

Mechanical CAD (preferably CREO)

    

Cross-functional engineering collaboration

    

Marine industry experience and knowledge of DNV regulations

Additional information

The role involves regular travel to the test site in Landskrona, as well as participation in commissioning onboard oceangoing vessels.

Relocation support is available for the right candidate.

Does this sound like you? Then we are looking forward to learning more about your motivation in your application letter. For more information about the position please contact Briljantin Consulting.

This role is located in Stockholm.

We review applications continually so please send in your application as soon as possible.

We don't accept applications sent directly via email.

A businesspartner for growth and maintainance, www.briljantin.se

jobs.title: Apulaispäällikkö, Prisma Iisalmi
jobs.description:
Primary location:
IISALMI

Haemme apulaispäällikköä Iisalmen Prismaan
Kiinnostaako sinua käytännönläheinen apulaispäällikön tehtävä käyttötavarakaupan arjessa? Tässä tehtävässä pääset tukemaan osaston päivittäistä tekemistä, hyvää asiakaskokemusta ja tiimin onnistumista yhdessä päällikön kanssa.

Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen. Aloitus mahdollisimman pian.

Prisma Iisalmi palvelee asiakkaita monipuolisesti arjen ostoksissa ja käyttötavaroissa. Käyttötavaraosastolla onnistuminen syntyy hyvästä asiakaspalvelusta, houkuttelevista esillepanoista, sujuvasta tekemisestä ja hyvästä yhteistyöstä.

Apulaispäällikkönä toimit päällikön tukena käyttötavaraosaston päivittäisessä johtamisessa. Varmistat osaltasi, että asiakaspalvelu, hyllyt, esillepanot ja myynnillinen tekeminen toimivat arjessa sujuvasti. Työhösi kuuluu myös käytännön tekemistä osastolla, tiimin perehdyttämistä, ohjaamista ja valmentamista, palautteen antamista sekä tavoitteiden seuraamista ja toiminnan kehittämistä. Toimit aktiivisena viestijänä tiimin, vuorojen ja päällikön välillä sekä päällikön sijaisena tämän poissa ollessa. Näin viet PeeÄssän arvoja ja Parhaan Elämän Edelläkävijä Savossa -tavoitetta käytäntöön hyvän asiakaskokemuksen ja tiimin onnistumisen kautta.

Tämä tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos sinulla on:
- valmius tehdä töitä eri kellonaikoihin asiakasvirtojen mukaan, myös juhlapyhinä
- toimeenpanokykyä, rohkeutta ja ratkaisukeskeistä otetta
- kokemusta vähittäis- ja käyttötavarakaupasta – S-ryhmän järjestelmien tuntemus katsotaan eduksi
- kiinnostusta myynnilliseen tekemiseen, arjen sujuvoittamiseen ja toiminnan kehittämiseen
- sujuva suomen kielen taito, hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot sekä halua innostaa, ohjata ja tehdä yhteistyötä tiimin kanssa
- aktiivista otetta oman osaamisen ja yksikön toiminnan kehittämiseen
- halua toimia arvojemme #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä mukaisesti sekä viedä asiakaslupauksiamme käytäntöön arjen tekemisessä.

Miksi hakea tätä tehtävää?
- pääset tekemään monipuolista ja käytännönläheistä työtä Iisalmen Prisman käyttötavaraosastolla
- työssä yhdistyvät asiakaspalvelu, myynnillinen tekeminen, esillepanot ja osaston päivittäinen sujuvuus
- saat tehdä merkityksellistä työtä, jossa oma kädenjälkesi näkyy asiakkaiden arjessa ja tiimin onnistumisessa
- saat tueksesi päällikön, tiimin ja selkeät toimintamallit, joiden avulla pääset hyvin kiinni apulaispäällikön tehtävään
- käytössäsi ovat monipuoliset, koko Suomen kattavat henkilöstöedut sekä liikunnan ja hyvinvoinnin Epassi-edut. Voit tutustua PeeÄssän henkilöstöetuihin tarkemmin tästä.

Palkkaus
Tehtävän palkkaus määräytyy Kaupan työehtosopimuksen C-palkkaluokan mukaan. Palkka on aiemmasta työkokemuksesta riippuen 2 233–2 572 €/kk. Lisäksi maksetaan työryhmän kokoon perustuvaa lisää kulloinkin voimassa olevan maksuperusteen mukaisesti. Työryhmän nykyisen koon perusteella lisä on tällä hetkellä 2 %. Tehtävässä maksetaan myös TES:n mukaiset lisät toteutuneiden työtuntien mukaan.

Tämän lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus ansaita vuosittaista tulospalkkaa Osuuskauppa PeeÄssässä kulloinkin voimassa olevan tulospalkkausjärjestelmän mukaisesti.

Työtä kuvataan usein korulauseilla, mutta meidän mielestämme tavallisuudessa ei ole mitään pahaa. Me Osuuskauppa PeeÄssällä sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä - eikä se tarkoita tylsää porukkaa, päinvastoin. Työ on hyvää ja sujuvaa arkea, jossa teemme myös muiden arjesta - ja välillä juhlastakin - vähän parempaa. Ja joskus juhlitaan itsekin. Jos työpaikkailmoitusten kliseet kyllästyttävät, tule meille ihan tavallisiin töihin.

Jos ihan tavallinen työ hyvässä porukassa kuulostaa sinun jutultasi, hae mukaan jo tänään!

Hakuaikaa on 4.10.2026 saakka, mutta laitathan hakemuksesi tulemaan jo hyvissä ajoin. Aloitamme haastattelut hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Prisma Iisalmen palvelu- ja myyntipäällikkö Asta Kalanti, asta.kalanti@sok.fi, puh. 044 719 7305 arkisin klo 8–16.

Osuuskauppa PeeÄssä on yli 134 000 asiakasomistajan omistama palvelualan yritys Pohjois-Savossa. Tavoitteenamme on olla Parhaan Elämän Edelläkävijä Savossa. Meille se tarkoittaa merkityksellistä työtä, reilua työnantajuutta ja arjen sujuvuutta. Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että voimme tuottaa osuustoiminnallista hyötyä ja kehittää sitä jatkuvasti arvojemme mukaisesti: #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä.

jobs.title: Tiler
jobs.description:
The duties of a waterproofer and tiler include a wide range of wet-room and tiling work in both new-build and renovation projects. Work areas include bathrooms, toilets, saunas, utility rooms, kitchens, and other interior and exterior spaces requiring tiling.

The duties include:

- Reviewing construction drawings and work instructions

- Protecting the work area and inspecting the condition of the substrate

- Removing old tiles, waterproofing membranes, and other surface materials when necessary

- Cleaning, sanding, levelling, and straightening wall and floor surfaces

- Checking floor slopes and correcting them when necessary

- Applying primers and preparing surfaces

- Waterproofing wet rooms in accordance with the system manufacturers instructions

- Carefully sealing corners, penetrations, joints, and floor drains

- Measuring, planning, setting out, and installing wall and floor tiles

- Cutting, drilling, and fitting tiles

- Preparing and applying tile adhesive

- Grouting tiled surfaces and applying silicone sealant

- Epoxy grouting and other specialist grouting when required

- Cleaning, finishing, and protecting completed surfaces


The work involves handling various types of tiles, including ceramic tiles, clinker tiles, mosaics, and natural-stone tiles. The employee must be able to use the materials, machinery, tools, and equipment required for waterproofing and tiling work.

The position requires care, precision, high-quality workmanship, and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team. The employee must be able to read construction drawings, take the necessary measurements, follow site schedules, and comply with material manufacturers installation instructions.

Vi ser etter deg med administrativ kompetanse og gode lederegenskaper. Du er en leder som evner å bygge tillit, skape stabilitet og lede medarbeidere. Her får du bruke hele bredden av din kompetanse, og gjøre en reell forskjell i en viktig del av kommunens tjenestetilbud. 

Barnevernet er en spennende arbeidsplass i et komplekst fagfelt. Vi har som mål å sikre at barn og familier får rett hjelp til rett tid og sørge for god barnevernfaglig kvalitet. Arbeidsmiljøet vårt er preget av gode kollegarelasjoner og ønske om læring og faglig utvikling. Vi legger vekt på å utfordre medarbeidere til å reflektere rundt egen praksis, bruke sine ressurser til å lede sitt eget arbeid og samarbeide godt med barn og unge, deres familie, nettverk, kollegaer og samarbeidspartnere. 

Den interkommunale barneverntjenesten for Kristiansund, Averøy og Gjemnes er organisert som en enhet i Kristiansund kommune. Tjenesten er lokalisert i Frei administrasjonsbygg, i Omsundet på Frei. 

Arbeidsområder
  • delegert lederansvar for personal og økonomi 
  • planlegge, lede og følge opp det administrative arbeidet i barneverntjenesten
  • bistå enhetsleder i forvaltning av budsjett og regnskapsoppfølging
  • forvaltning og oppfølging av leieavtaler og oppdragsavtaler
  • bistå enhetsleder med å utøve kommunens systematisk HMS-arbeid
  • samhandling med interne og eksterne samarbeidspartnere
Kvalifikasjonskrav
  • relevant bachelorgrad innen administrasjon, forvaltning, økonomi eller ledelse
  • relevant videreutdanning innen ledelse eller organisasjonsutvikling, eller forplikte seg til å ta lederutdanning innen kort tid etter tilsetting
  • erfaring fra administrativt arbeid innen offentlig forvaltning
  • gode formidlingsevner i norsk, skriftlig og muntlig
  • gode digitale ferdigheter 
  • godkjent politiattest fremskaffes før arbeidsforholdets start
Ønskelige kvalifikasjoner 
  • mastergrad innen ledelse eller annen relevant mastergrad
Vi søker deg som 
  • har god dialogkompetanse og gode relasjonelle ferdigheter
  • håndterer omstilling, er strukturert og selvstendig
  • har god rolle- og oppgaveforståelse
  • trives med ansvar, variasjon og ledelse i en kompleks organisasjon
Vi tilbyr
  • tett samarbeid med enhetens lederteam
  • et solid og aktivt fagmiljø med kvalitet i fokus
  • en utviklende lederstilling med stor grad av selvstendighet og ansvar
  • dekning av flytteutgifter etter vedtatte retningslinjer
  • Kristiansund kommune har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, inkludert ulykkesforsikring på fritiden.
    Med offentlig tjenestepensjon i KLP får du en av Norges tryggeste pensjonsordninger. Den gir deg økonomisk trygghet livet ut, og sikrer deg en forutsigbar inntekt den dagen du blir pensjonist. Les mer her: KLP
Øvrige vilkår

Tror du at du kan ha fortrinnsrett til stillingen? Du kan lese mer om fortrinnsrett på Kristiansund kommune sine hjemmesider ved å trykke på vedlagt lenke: Søkerveiledning - Kristiansund kommune

Ansettelse skjer etter kommunalt avtaleverk og på de vilkår som framgår av lover, reglement og tariffavtaler.

Kommunen har et ansiennitetsbasert lønnssystem. For alle stillinger teller både offentlig og privat tjeneste etter fylte 18 år - dokumenteres med tjenesteattest fra tidligere arbeidsgivere med informasjon om fra/til-dato, stillingsprosent, eller antall timer arbeidet.

Det tas forbehold om endring av tjenestested, ansvars- og arbeidsområde samt eventuelle tilpasninger i stillingens innhold etter kommunens skiftende behov.

Søknad

Søknad sendes elektronisk via vårt rekrutteringssystem. Søkere som blir innkalt til intervju må ta med attesterte kopier av vitnemål og attester. NB! Når du er i en søknadsprosess anbefaler vi deg å følge med på e-post, inkludert søppelpost.

Kristiansund kommune ønsker mangfold, og vi oppfordrer kandidater som oppfyller kvalifikasjonskravene til å søke stilling hos oss, uavhengig av alder, kjønn, funksjonshemming eller nasjonal/ etnisk bakgrunn.

Kommunen praktiserer meroffentlighet ved tilsettinger. Det innebærer at søkere må begrunne særskilt hvis en søknad ønskes unntatt offentlighet. Begrunnelsen vil bli vurdert i forhold til reglene i Offentlighetsloven, og søkeren vil bli kontaktet. Hvis det etter kommunens vurdering ikke foreligger en særskilt grunn, vil søker komme med på offentlig søkerliste.

Til din informasjon vil søkere til stillinger aldri bli bedt om å oppgi BankID i forbindelse med søknadsprosessen. Med andre ord må du aldri gi fra deg BankID informasjon i forbindelse med jobbsøking.


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Jobb og lev godt i Kristiansund – byen ved havet Ytterst mot storhavet ligger Kristiansund – en sjarmerende kystby med sterk identitet og et levende lokalsamfunn. Bybildet preges av ramsalt historie, moderne næringsliv og et mangfoldig kulturliv. Med 25.000 innbyggere og en kompakt, urban bykjerne, får du det beste fra to verdener – byliv og natur tett på hverandre. Her er det friskere i lufta og varmere mellom folk. Du blir fort en del av fellesskapet, enten du engasjerer deg i idrett, musikk, friluftsliv eller en av de mange festivalene og aktivitetene som preger byen. Kristiansund byr på både hav og fjell, og gir deg alle muligheter for et aktivt og variert liv – hele året. Byen er også i vekst: Campus Kristiansund er nå etablert som en ny møteplass for utdanning, innovasjon og næringsliv – og i løpet av 2025 åpner kulturhuset Normoria, som blir et kraftsenter for kunst og kultur på Nordmøre. I tillegg har vi Kulturfabrikken som byr på forestillinger og konserter gjennom hele året. Og selv om vi ligger ytterst ved kysten, er vi aldri langt unna: Fly tar deg til Oslo på 45 minutter, og hurtigbåten bringer deg til Trondheim på drøyt tre timer. Velkommen til Kristiansund – i medvind uansett vær.

jobs.title: Tule sairaanhoitajaksi Iltalaan – meillä hyvä hoito tehdään yhdessä
jobs.description:
Haemme innostunutta ja osaavaa sairaanhoitajaa liittymään iloiseen joukkoomme.

Työpaikkanasi toimii viihtyisä Iltalan hoivakoti Espoon Viherlaaksossa hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella. Meillä on 60-asiakaspaikkaa ja tarjoamme ympärivuorokautista tehostettua palveluasumista kodinomaisessa ympäristössä.

Työkulttuurissamme korostuvat avoimuus ja positiivisuus sekä elämänmakuinen arki. Haluamme tarjota asiakkaillemme turvallisen ja hyvän hoidon rauhallisessa ilmapiirissä huomioimalla heidän fyysiset, psyykkiset, sosiaaliset ja hengelliset perustarpeensa. Tuemme asiakkaidemme omatoimisuutta sekä kunnioitamme heidän yksilöllisyyttään ja itsemääräämisoikeuttaan. Laadukkaan perushoivan lisäksi tarjoamme heille monipuolista aktiviteettia sisällä ja ulkona.

Sairaanhoitajien lisäksi Iltalassa työskentelee fysioterapeutti, lähihoitajia, hoiva-avustajia, keittiötyöntekijöitä, laitoshuoltajia ja pesulatyöntekijä, jolloin voimme tarjota sinulle mahdollisuuden keskittyä hoitotyöhön. Iltalassa panostamme työhyvinvointiin ja työssäjaksamiseen.

Sairaanhoitajanamme työskentelet osana vastaavan sairaanhoitajan luotsaamaa tiimiä. Työpäiväsi koostuvat asiakkaidemme tarvitsemasta perushoivasta, lääkehoidosta ja tarvittaessa myös sairaanhoidollisista tehtävistä huolehtimisesta sekä osaston mielekkään arjen kehittämisestä ja toteuttamisesta. Sairaanhoitaja toimii myös omahoitajana, jonka vastuualueisiin kuuluvat RAI-toimintakykyarvioinneista, asiakassuunnitelmista sekä läheisyhteistyöstä huolehtiminen. Loma-aikoina ja tarvittaessa sijaistat myös osaston vastaavaa sairaanhoitajaa.

**Odotamme sinulta:**

- sairaanhoitajan tutkintoa

- tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa ja tuberkuloosiselvitystä

- rikosrekisterilain 6§:n 2momentissa tarkoitettua rikosrekisteriotetta

- Sujuva ja itsenäinen Suomen kielen kirjallinen & suullinen osaaminen (kielitaitotaso B2)

- valmiutta tiimityöskentelyyn ja kiinnostusta vanhustyöhön


**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- toistaiseksi voimassaolevan 2-vuorotyön iloisessa porukassa

- yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES G24D mukaisen palkkauksen (2850,98 - 3110,42)

- työterveyshuollon

- Liikuntaa, kulttuuria ja hyvinvointia mahdollistavan ePassin

- aamiaisen ja päiväkahvin

- kannustinjärjestelmäämme kuuluvia etuja

- savuttoman työpaikan


Jätä hakemuksesi alla olevan lomakkeen kautta 11.10.2026 mennessä. Liitä mukaan myös ansioluettelosi. Tehtävä voidaan täyttää heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä jo ennen varsinaisen hakuajan päättymistä.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Embedded Solutions
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to join Etteplan!

In this role, you will lead large embedded systems projects for our industrial customers. We help our customers succeed in their R&D, productization and in every phase of their projects from requirements to final delivery. Our diverse range of clients and projects across different industries lets you build broad experience and grow your career. You will work at the center of multidisciplinary teams, balancing technical scope, schedule, and budget while keeping the customer relationship strong throughout the project.

As a Senior Project Manager at Etteplan your work includes:

·leading large, complex embedded systems projects across their full lifecycle

·planning and managing scope, schedule, budget and risk

·building and coordinating multidisciplinary project teams

·acting as the primary point of contact for customer stakeholders

·reporting project status and escalating risks to internal and customer management

·contributing to presales and proposal work for new embedded projects

The position is based in Finland, the location preferably being Espoo or Tampere.



Who are we looking for?

·You have several years of experience managing large embedded system projects, ideally in an industrial or product-development context

·You have strong interpersonal and leadership skills and can guide multidisciplinary technical teams towards a shared goal

·You are familiar with embedded systems development practices and can speak credibly with both engineers and customer executives

·You have a solid grasp of project management methods (agile, stage-gate, or hybrid) and tools

·You are comfortable owning schedule, budget and risk on projects of significant scale

·You have an applicable educational background, such as a degree in engineering or a related technical field

·Good written and spoken Finnish and English skills are required



Interested?

Please send your application through our recruitment system as soon as possible. We review applications already during the application period.

At Etteplan we ensure that your compensation is fair and transparent. Your salary reflects your competencies and contributions, in line with our way of working. For this role, the typical monthly salary is 5400-6600€/month, depending on your background.

We encourage applications from all qualified candidates who have the legal right to work in the EU. Please note that Etteplan does not currently provide visa sponsorship or work permit sponsorship for this role.
