jobs.title: A Two-Day Training Programme with a Pathway to Employment for Professional Chefs!
jobs.description:
AALTOVOIMA - AALLON VOIMALLA TÖIHIN 


Aaltovoima Lapland Chef Academy

17–18 October 2026 | Helsinki | 10:00–17:00

Are you a chef or kitchen professional looking for a new job opportunity, seasonal work or the next step in your career?

Aaltovoima Pohjoinen is organising the Aaltovoima Lapland Chef Academy – a free, two-day intensive training programme where you can develop your professional skills under the guidance of top-level professionals and build a concrete pathway towards seasonal work in Lapland.

This is not an ordinary course. The Academy combines hands-on training, professional development and a direct pathway to employment through Aaltovoima in leading hotels and restaurants across Lapland.


Who is the Academy for?

We are looking for:

 * Trained chefs and kitchen professionals looking for a new job or seasonal work
 * Early-career chefs with basic professional skills and a strong motivation to develop quickly
 * International professionals with sufficient language skills and the right to work in Finland
 * Chefs interested in Laplands hotels, experiential restaurants and international clientel


What does the Academy offer?

Top-level trainers
The training is led by experienced professionals Aki Kantelinen and Johan Kurkela, who will share their practical expertise and experience from professional kitchens.

Two intensive days
The training focuses on hands-on work, the demands of professional kitchens and what it takes to succeed during the busy winter season in Lapland.

Certificate of completion
Participants who successfully complete the Academy will receive an Aaltovoima Lapland Chef Academy Certificate.

A pathway to employment
Aaltovoima will connect participating chefs with suitable job opportunities in hotels and restaurants across Lapland during the upcoming winter season.


Practical information

 * The Academy takes place on 17–18 October 2026
 * Both days run from 10:00 to 17:00
 * The training is free of charge
 * The Academy will be held in the professional test kitchen located upstairs at Brasserie Lionne in Helsinki
 * Hans Välimäki is providing the facilities for the Academy
 * Participants are responsible for arranging and covering their own travel and accommodation costs in Helsinki
 * Participants must bring their own chefs clothing and knives
 * Participants selected for the Academy commit to seeking employment through Aaltovoima during the upcoming winter season


Application

Application deadline: 7 October 2026

Selected applicants will be notified on 9 October 2026.

There is no need to attach a CV to your application. Applicants will enter their information directly into the application system and answer the following questions:

 1. What is the best dish you have ever eaten, and why?
 2. What is your favourite restaurant, and why?
 3. Where do you see yourself in seven years?

We are looking for motivated chefs who are passionate about food, eager to develop their skills and ready to take the next step in their careers.

Apply for the Aaltovoima Lapland Chef Academy and build your pathway towards an exciting winter season in Lapland!


For more information about the Academy, please contact:

jobs.title: Lille selvejende institution søger pædagog
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde et sted, hvor du ikke bare er medarbejder, men en vigtig del af huset?

Så kom til Børnehuset Bellis.

Vi er et lille, hyggeligt og selvejende børnehus i København NV med en grøn legeplads, masser af god stemning og en hverdag, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling og stor mulighed for indflydelse. Her kender vi hinanden, ledelsen er tæt på, og der er plads til, at du kan være dig selv og til, at dine idéer kan blive til virkelighed.

Vi søger en pædagog på 37 timer om ugen til et barselsvikariat med mulighed for fastansættelse. Stillingen ønskes besat 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest derefter. Vi søger også en fast pædagog fra 1. november 2026.

Et lille hus med store muligheder
Som selvejende institution har vi stor mulighed for selv at forme vores hverdag, pædagogik og traditioner. Vi har en aktiv forældrebestyrelse, som har reel indflydelse på børnehusets udvikling.

Det betyder blandt andet:
  • Kort vej fra idé til beslutning.
  • Stor medindflydelse på institutionens hverdag og udvikling.
  • Tæt samarbejde mellem medarbejdere, ledelse og bestyrelse.
  • Sundhedsforsikring til alle ansatte.
  • Større indflydelse på ferieplanlægningen.
  • Mulighed for at præge pædagogikken og skabe nye idéer.
  • En tæt og nærværende ledelse.

Hvem er vi?
Børnehuset Bellis er et hyggeligt hus med en dejlig grøn legeplads. Vi ligger tæt på skolehaverne, gode legepladser og grønne områder, som vi ofte bruger i hverdagen.

Vi har én vuggestuegruppe og to børnehavegrupper, normeret til 52 børn og fordi vi er et lille hus, kender børn og voksne hinanden på tværs.

Vi er optagede af at følge børnenes spor, skabe tryghed og gode rammer for leg, læring, udvikling og dannelse. Vi lægger vægt på en hverdag præget af nærvær, humor, omsorg og et stærkt kollegaskab.

Du skal søge hos os, hvis du:
  • Får energi af at arbejde med en mangfoldig børnegruppe.
  • Er nysgerrig og har lyst til at nytænke og udvikle.
  • Gerne vil arbejde i en selvejende institution med ledelsen tæt på.
  • Har lyst til at være en del af et engageret arbejdsfællesskab med fokus på børnenes trivsel, udvikling og dannelse.
  • Er god til struktur og organisering.
  • Værdsætter et godt og tæt forældresamarbejde.
  • Kan udarbejde handleplaner og omsætte dem til praksis.
  • Er mødestabil og tager ansvar for fællesskabet.

Måske har du flere års erfaring og masser af idéer med i bagagen. Måske er du nyuddannet og kommer med friske øjne, gåpåmod og lyst til at prøve dig selv af.

Begge dele er vi interesserede i.

Det vigtigste for os er, at du har lyst til at være en aktiv del af et lille hus, hvor vi løfter i fællesskab.

Kom gerne på besøg
Du er meget velkommen til at ringe og aftale et besøg – også inden du sender din ansøgning. Vi vil gerne møde dig og vise dig, hvem vi er.

Kontakt leder, Marlene på tlf. 5210 2120.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Are you a Functional Solution Architect with a passion for providing top-notch service to customers, focusing on quality when implementing D365 solutions?

Join our team at TravelOperations and help us design and implement cutting-edge solutions that meet our clients' complex business needs.

Responsibilities

As a Functional Solution Architect at TravelOperations, you will play a key role in influencing and overseeing large-scale international implementation projects.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design and implement enterprise-level solutions, ensuring they align with business objectives and technical requirements.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define functional requirements and develop architecture roadmaps.

  • Lead the integration of multiple systems to create seamless business processes.

  • Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and compliant with industry standards.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentor team members in best practices and emerging technologies.

  • Execute workshops, including in-depth analysis sessions, in collaboration with a team of Business Consultants to refine and validate solution designs.

  • Collaborate with skilled Developers to ensure the solution design is thoroughly tested and meets the technical and functional requirements.

  • Engage in General Architect work, such as exploring emerging technologies, conducting Proof of Concepts, and participating in Product Advisory Board activities with partners like Microsoft or industry-specific leaders such as Amadeus, Sabre, and Travelport.

  • Offer internal guidance and support to colleagues, fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and continuous improvement in architectural best practices.

  • Maintaining daily ownership of customer relationships, acting as a trusted advisor in implementing scalable and secure solutions.

Desired Skills & Requirements

Seeking a candidate with 5+ years of Dynamics 365 Finance experience with a strong finance background. While various profiles may apply, we highly value a strong person-organization fit. Our ideal candidate possesses the following attributes and qualifications:

  • Extensive experience with Dynamics 365 Finance and proficiency in finance.

  • Proven experience as a Functional Solution Architect or in a similar role.

  • Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks and methodologies.

  • Proficiency in system integration, data migration, and cloud technologies.

  • Excellent communication skills to articulate complex solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deliver high-quality solutions within tight deadlines and the capability to lead functional areas within projects.

  • Certification in MB-310 / MB-700.

  • Dynamic, proactive, and possesses a comprehensive solution overview.

  • Exceptional consulting and communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

  • Demonstrated passion for driving positive change for customers and their businesses, coupled with a willingness to travel both professionally and personally.

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work with innovative technologies in a dynamic environment where progressive work culture with a global perspective where your ideas truly matter, and growth opportunities are endless.

  • Work with the latest Microsoft Technologies alongside Dynamics professionals committed to driving customer success.

  • Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere

  • Experience a dynamic workplace where team spirit, joy, and productivity go hand in hand.

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

  • Career growth and professional development opportunities.

Work from either our Copenhagen or Aalborg offices and have the chance to visit our Brisbane location. Join our global team spanning Denmark, Sweden, India, the US, and Australia.

For more details, please contact our People and Culture Team at hr@traveloperations.com or

visit our careers site at www.traveloperations.com.

jobs.title: Compliance Model Validator | Swedbank
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about financial crime risk models?In Swedbank you have the opportunity to:

• Perform independent model validations of models primarily used in the financial crime risk area, including both rule-based and machine learning models.

• Assess model risk from the aspects of model objective, design and construction, assumptions and limitations, data, implementation, model governance, and ongoing performance monitoring.

• Deliver high quality and value adding model validation reports which support effective and efficient model development and enhancements of the model risk management in the 1LoD.

• Proactively challenge the 1LoD in its activities to develop, maintain and monitor its models in a constructive and evidence-based manner, focusing on whether these models adequately mitigate the compliance risks in scope.

• Be part of our compliance continuous maturity journey and take an active role in supporting the bank in strengthening the tools and models to combat financial crime.

What is needed in this role:

• A degree in a quantitative field e.g. computer science, data science, data engineering, statistics, mathematics, or economics.

• Experience in data assembling and analysis of large datasets.

• Experience in SQL, querying and manipulating large databases.

• Experience in rule-based and machine learning models (both supervised and unsupervised learning), including relevant programming skills in Python.

• Experience from working with Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision trees, Random Forest, and Isolation Forest.

• Experience from working in Microsoft Azure.

• Familiarity with the retail banking industry, products and services offered, its compliance and operational risks, and preferably model risk management for AML/CTF/FS models.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple terms to a non-technical audience, and to clearly articulate and defend validation findings, methodologies in discussions with stakeholders and senior management.

• Excellent collaboration skills, enabling effective teamwork and good team spirit.

• Strong self-leadership, including the ability to drive and complete tasks independently and deliver to tight timelines.

jobs.title: Mann i 50-årene søker nye BPA-assistenter til sitt team på Alna
jobs.description:
Er du på utkikk etter en meningsfull jobb? Da vil jeg gjerne høre fra deg!

Jeg er en positiv, sosial og rolig mann i 50-årene som søker nye faste assistenter og tilkallingsvikarer til mitt BPA-team. Jeg bruker rullestol og bor hjemme sammen med min kone, våre tre barn og hunden vår. Fritiden min liker jeg å bruke på trening, trilleturer med hunden, musikk og hyggelig samvær med familien.

Hvem ser jeg etter?

Jeg ønsker meg en assistent som kan jobbe i ukedagene eller annenhver helg, samt stille opp på kort varsel ved ferier eller sykdom.

Hvem er du?

  • Du er en person til å stole på, har godt humør og samarbeider godt.

  • Du trives i et livlig familiehjem og er komfortabel med hund.

  • Du har god tålmodighet, liker å lage mat og er gjerne litt sporty, da jeg ønsker assistanse i forbindelse med trening.

  • Du tar initiativ der det trengs og har mulighet til å trå til ekstra ved behov.

Krav til stillingen:

  • Du må ha gode norskkunnskaper (minimum B1-nivå). Dersom du også snakker polsk, er det et pluss!

  • Du må ikke være allergisk mot hund.

  • Førerkort klasse B er en fordel, men ikke et absolutt krav.

Hva innebærer jobben?

Arbeidsoppgavene vil variere og er knyttet til min hverdag:

  • Personlig hygiene

  • Praktisk bistand i hjemmet og rengjøring

  • Matlaging

  • Assistanse under trening og turer

  • Bisting i forbindelse med legeavtaler

  • Kjøring ved behov (dersom du har førerkort)

Om stillingen og arbeidstid

  • Stillingstyper: Fast helgestilling (annenhver helg) samt tilkallingsvikar.

  • Arbeidstid: Dagtid og kveldstid – dette gir deg stor fleksibilitet til å tilpasse arbeidstiden til din egen hverdag.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Send meg gjerne en søknad!


Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Tarifflønn, ansiennitetsregulert

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Veiledning og opplæring

  • Assistentkurs i regi av Humana Omsorg og Assistanse

  • Egen app for håndbøker og rutiner

  • Rabatter hos bl.a. SATS

  • Attraktive rabatter med fordelsprogrammet Visma LogBuy

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.title: Marketing Controller Lead
jobs.employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Marketing Controller Lead, you will play a key role in shaping how marketing investments drive business growth. You will lead the governance, performance tracking, and strategic steering of marketing investments across paid media, owned media, and content production, ensuring resources are allocated effectively to maximise business impact.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Leading the strategic planning, governance, and allocation of marketing investments across channels in line with business priorities and growth ambitions.
    Driving a holistic view of marketing performance, connecting channel performance with commercial outcomes and long-term business impact.
    Defining, implementing, and continuously improving KPI frameworks that enable consistent measurement, benchmarking, and optimisation across marketing functions.
    Consolidating performance insights into clear and actionable recommendations that support strategic decision-making.
    Partnering closely with Marketing Strategy & Steering, Finance, and the Head of Marketing Controlling to ensure alignment between investment decisions, business goals, and growth objectives.
    Driving cross-functional collaboration to strengthen transparency, accountability, and effectiveness across the marketing organisation.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You will be part of the Marketing Controlling organisation and collaborate with a broad range of stakeholders across Marketing, Finance, Strategy, and Business Steering functions. You will work closely with the Head of Marketing Controlling and partner with leaders across Paid Media, Owned Media, Content Production, and Marketing Strategy to ensure investments are generating measurable business value.

You will also lead and support a team of talented controllers, helping them grow while creating alignment across functions and markets.



WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for a strategic and analytical leader with a strong understanding of financial steering, marketing performance, and business impact.

You have:

    Several years of experience in controlling, finance, business performance management, or marketing controlling.
    Proven experience leading teams and developing high-performing talent.
    Strong knowledge of marketing investments, performance measurement, and business impact evaluation.
    Experience working with KPI frameworks, reporting structures, and performance governance models.
    The ability to translate complex financial and performance data into clear business recommendations.
    Strong stakeholder management skills and experience working across multiple functions and seniority levels.
    A collaborative mindset and the ability to build strong partnerships across an organisation.
    Excellent communication skills and confidence presenting insights to senior leaders.
    A degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Marketing, or a related field.

WHO WE ARE

At H&M Group, we are driven by our purpose to liberate fashion for the many. We believe in creating meaningful growth, empowering teams, and building a culture where everyone can contribute, learn, and develop. Together, we shape customer experiences that drive long-term business success while creating value for people and society.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we offer a collaborative and inclusive environment where you can make a real impact on business performance and strategic decision-making. You will have the opportunity to work with senior leaders across Marketing, Finance, and Strategy while shaping the future of marketing investment steering in one of the world's leading fashion companies.

We offer attractive benefits, extensive learning opportunities, and the freedom to grow your career in an international environment where innovation, curiosity, and continuous improvement are encouraged.

JOIN US

This is a full-time permanent position based at our Head Office in Stockholm.

    If you feel that your experience, skills, and ambitions are a match, we look forward to receiving your application. Together, we'll create meaningful growth and drive the future of marketing performance and business impact.

Har du erfaring med CNC-drejning – og lyst til at blive en del af en arbejdsplads med godt humør, samarbejde og fokus på kvalitet? Så kan du være den kollega, vi søger hos OJM A/S.

Vi arbejder med fokus på kvalitet, output, opstilling og løbende forbedringer – og du bliver en del af et team på 7-8 medarbejdere, hvor faglighed, god kommunikation og hjælpsomhed vægtes højt. Hos os er der plads til den enkelte, og vi prioriterer både faglig og personlig udvikling.

·         har relevant erfaring med CNC-bearbejdning

·         har erfaring med opstilling og løbende produktion – gerne på en eller flere af følgende maskintyper:

  • EMAG VL-6

  • Mazak Integrex 400

  • Mazak HQR 200

  • Mazak Multiplex W-200Y

  • erfaring med tegningslæsning, brug af div. måleudstyr mm.

  • besidder IT-færdigheder på brugerniveau

Derudover sætter vi pris på, at du:

·         har en analytisk tilgang til opgaverne og gerne bidrager med idéer til gode løsninger

·         trives med at arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig bidrager positivt til fællesskabet

·         møder hverdagen med en positiv og imødekommende tilgang

Hos os får du:

·         et spændende job med gode og selvstændige arbejdsvilkår

·         et godt arbejdsmiljø med en uformel, ordentlig og hjælpsom omgangstone

·         gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår aftales med udgangspunkt i dine kompetencer og erfaring.

  • Har solid erfaring med undervisning af unge og voksne.

  • Har erfaring med onlineundervisning og er fortrolig med digitale undervisningsplatforme.

  • Har gode danskkundskaber og kan anvende dansk som støttesprog ved behov.

  • Har forståelse for norsk kultur og hverdagskommunikation og kan inddrage dette naturligt i undervisningen.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og professionelt.

  • Er fleksibel, positiv og møder kursisterne i øjenhøjde.

  • En fleksibel freelanceopgave med mulighed for selv at planlægge din undervisningstid.

  • Online eneundervisning af unge og voksne kursister på forskellige niveauer.

  • Samarbejde med en landsdækkende og veletableret sprogkursusvirksomhed med fokus på kvalitet, høj faglighed og personlig kontakt.

  • Løbende freelanceopgaver efter behov.

jobs.title: PMO Coordinator – Fagersta
jobs.description:
PMO Coordinator – Fagersta

We are looking for an experienced PMO Coordinator for a consulting assignment within a large organization undergoing transformation. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a coordinating and supporting capacity and has solid experience in PMO, project coordination, and portfolio governance.

You will support leadership and initiative owners with governance, reporting, risk follow-up, and stakeholder communication. The position does not include personnel management, budget ownership, or strategic decision-making authority. The focus is on structure, coordination, reporting, and driving progress through effective follow-up.

🎯 About the Role

You will play an important role in an ongoing transformation, contributing to the continued development of PMO structures and ensuring consistent tracking and follow-up across projects and initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

    

Continue developing and implementing the existing PMO structure and risk model.

    

Support project follow-up routines and pilot testing across active initiatives.

    

Document lessons learned and identify opportunities for improvement.

    

Maintain and further develop processes, tools, and templates for project and portfolio governance.

    

Support structured initiative tracking, including RAG status, milestones, and status reporting.

    

Maintain and support established stakeholder and governance forums.

    

Coordinate communication and follow-up with initiative owners and leadership.

    

Prepare and maintain recurring portfolio updates and communication materials for relevant stakeholders.

    

Support meeting preparation, reporting, and follow-up to ensure continued progress across initiatives.

✅ Qualifications & Experience

We are looking for someone who has:

    

Proven experience in a PMO, project coordination, or portfolio governance role.

    

Demonstrated experience producing structured status reporting and leadership-facing communication materials, such as RAG/status dashboards or portfolio summaries.

    

Experience or solid knowledge of project/portfolio risk frameworks and follow-up routines.

    

Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365.

    

Experience working in a large, matrixed, multi-stakeholder organization undergoing transformation.

    

Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken.

Experience within manufacturing, industrial environments, or supply chain is highly relevant for this assignment.

⭐ Advantageous Experience

    

Experience with Workday or an equivalent HR/performance management system.

    

Experience from industrial or supply chain transformation programs.

    

Swedish language skills.

💡 To Succeed in the Role

You are highly structured, detail-oriented, and comfortable coordinating multiple activities simultaneously. You communicate effectively with stakeholders at different organizational levels and are able to create progress and accountability without formal managerial authority.

You should also be comfortable working with ambiguity and evolving scope in a fast-moving transformation environment.

📍 Assignment Details

Location: Fagersta, Sweden Period: September 28, 2026 – December 31, 2026 Scope: 40 hours per week Work model: Hybrid, approximately 25% remote work

Sway Sourcing är en innovativ rekryteringspartner som specialiserar sig på att matcha rätt talang med rätt företag – snabbt och effektivt. Vårt huvudfokus ligger inom Ekonomi, Administration, HR, Marknad och IT, men vi har även den breda expertis och flexibilitet som krävs för att leverera skräddarsydda rekryteringslösningar inom alla branscher.

Trots att vi är en relativt ny aktör har vi redan byggt förtroende hos många av Sveriges största företag och arbetar både nationellt och internationellt. Med baser i Sverige och Spanien erbjuder vi en unik kombination av lokal expertis och global räckvidd. Vårt starka nätverk och djupa branschinsikter gör oss till en självklar partner för företag som vill ligga steget före i sin rekrytering.

jobs.title: Controller Financial Planning and Analysis
jobs.description:
Company description:

At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.

Job description:

Support financial performance in a growing global business



Do you want to play a key role in supporting strategic decision-making and financial performance in a global organization contributing to the energy transition? As Controller Financial Planning and Analysis, you will join a Finance Controlling team in Karlskrona, supporting the global Grid Solutions business line.







This is an exciting opportunity to work close to management, contribute to business decisions through financial insights, and contribute to a growing international organization delivering solutions that enable the expansion of renewable energy infrastructure worldwide.







Support strategic decisions through financial insight



As Controller Financial Planning and Analysis, you will be part of a global FP & A team supporting financial planning, performance management and reporting across the Grid Solutions hubs. Working closely with management, Shared Service Center teams and stakeholders across the organization, you will provide financial transparency and valuable insights that support both strategic and operational decisions.







Key responsibilities include:




    Contribute to strategic and operational financial planning activities
    Forecasting, budgeting, month-end closing and reporting processes
    Analyze financial performance and provide recommendations to management
    Ensure compliance with IFRS, internal controls and group standards
    Support financial statements, audits and tax-related activities







The position is based in Karlskrona and is part of the FP & A and Finance Controlling organization supporting the global Grid Solutions business line. Collaboration with international stakeholders is an important part of the role.







Controller who brings a business perspective



You are a collaborative and structured professional who thrives in an international environment. Curious and engaged, you combine solid analytical and communication skills with a genuine interest in the business. You navigate complexity with ease, build trusted relationships and turn insights into practical improvements.







Key qualifications




    Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration or a related field
    Minimum five years of FP & A or controlling experience in a corporate environment
    Knowledge of planning, forecasting, budgeting and financial reporting processes
    Proficiency in SAP, OneStream, BI tools and advanced Excel
    Fluent Swedish and English skills, both written and spoken







Shape business performance in a global growth journey



NKT is committed to creating a diverse workplace and an environment where individuals from many backgrounds can thrive and bring their best work forward. We believe that a diverse organization enables sustainable performance, and that an inclusive and welcoming culture makes for a better place to work.





At NKT, you can advance your career in an international team-oriented environment where your efforts contribute to important outcomes. You will collaborate closely with business and finance leaders across several countries, gain wide-ranging exposure to strategic and operational finance, and expand your capabilities in financial planning, controlling, and business partnering. As part of a company supporting the expansion of renewable energy infrastructure, you will contribute to projects that help shape a more sustainable future.







"As a leader, I believe in empowering people through trust, collaboration and continuous development. In this role, you will have the opportunity to help shape important business decisions, work with skilled colleagues around the world and develop both professionally and personally," says Hiring Manager, Lotta Bergman.







Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!







We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 2026-10-13. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests might be included in the recruitment process.  







Be a Connector of the green tomorrow!

jobs.title: Støtte til en god hverdag. Din tid er mine krefter.
jobs.description:
Er du den rette assistenten for meg?

Jeg er en nordlending i slutten av 40-årene som bor på Klepp sammen med tenåringsdatteren min. Nå søker jeg flere gode assistenter. Min funksjonsnedsettelse gjør at jeg trenger at du blir mine armer og ben i hverdagen.

Som person er jeg inkluderende, kunnskapsrik og strukturert, og jeg setter pris på humor, kreativitet og miljøbevissthet. Jeg er glad i naturen, selv om jeg for tiden ikke har overskudd til å gå turer selv. Før jeg ble syk, brukte jeg mye tid på kreative aktiviteter som håndarbeid, tegning/maling og samisk håndtverk. Jeg elsker mennesker, språk og forskning. Jeg er også en stor tilhenger av gjenbruk og reparasjon fremfor å kjøpe nytt.

Med BPA får jeg muligheten til å leve et fritt og selvstendig liv. Siden jeg har et stort behov for hvile, er det viktig at assistansen frigjør tid og energi. Det gir meg bedre livskvalitet i form av overskudd til å pleie interesser, ha besøk eller bare slappe av – og ikke minst, være en god mor.

Hvordan vil din arbeidshverdag se ut?

Du vil være mine "armer og bein" i hverdagen og bistå med:

  • Husarbeid: Renhold, matlaging, rydding og organisering.

  • Personlig hygiene: Daglig bistand.

  • Praktiske oppgaver: Innkjøp og handling.

  • Administrativt: Innhente informasjon, som oftest digitalt.

  • Ledsaging: Følge til avtaler og behandling.

  • Fysisk velvære: Hjelp til øvelser som tøying og massasje.


Hva kreves av deg?

Sertifikat: Førerkort klasse B manuelt gir er et krav. Du må være komfortabel med å kjøre min bil.

Språk: Du må beherske norsk på minimum nivå B1.

Holdning: Du liker å lære nye ting, og er pålitelig, selvstendig og løsningsorientert.

 Som min BPA-assistent vil du hjelpe meg med de oppgavene jeg ikke har overskudd til selv, slik at jeg kan leve det livet jeg ønsker.

Arbeidstid og stillinger

Arbeidstid: Turnus med dag-, kvelds- og helgevakter.

Stillinger: Jeg har behov for både faste ansatte og tilkallingsvikarer.

Per nå er følgende ledig:

2 faste stillinger.

Tilkallingsvikarer (med mulighet for jobb i ferier)


Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Tarifflønn, ansiennitetsregulert

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Veiledning og opplæring

  • Assistentkurs i regi av Humana Omsorg og Assistanse

  • Egen app for håndbøker og rutiner

  • Rabatter hos bl.a. SATS

  • Attraktive rabatter med fordelsprogrammet Visma LogBuy

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.title: Säsonga på Grövelfjäll i vår skiduthyrning/receptionen!
jobs.description:
Vill du jobba med oss i skiduthyrningen/receptionen i vinter 2026/2027?

Att jobba på Grövelfjäll innebär en fin kombination av arbete i härlig fjällmiljö och en aktiv fritid med snön som grund.

Vi söker dig som gillar att vara ute, tycker om att ge service och uppmärksamhet till andra människor samt har en positiv inställning.

På Grövelfjäll jobbar vi i ett litet team, vi jobbar självständigt men ofta tillsammans med andra. Samarbete och respekt mot kollegor och gäster är en självklarhet.

Vi söker medarbetare, ung eller gammal, som kan jobba 50 - 100%.

Utbildning får du på plats.

Grövelfjäll är en skidanläggning i norra Dalarna, 4 mil norr om Idre. Här finns Sveriges sydligaste fjällnatur som erbjuder fantastiska vyer över både svenska och norska fjällen.

Här erbjuder vi:

- den sydligaste anläggningen som bara har natursnö i backarna

- en familjevänlig anläggning som trots sin litenhet erbjuder det mesta

- en personlig service som ger våra gäster en härlig familjär känsla

Vem är du som vill komma och jobba med oss?

Vi ser gärna att du har ett intresse för vinter och skidåkning och tycker om att arbeta med och för människor – både för våra gäster och med oss i personalen. Du är stresstålig, ställer upp när det behövs och gillar att ge service.

Har du någon form av skidlärarutbildning och/eller annan arbetslivserfarenhet är det meriterande. Givetvis värdesätter vi främst en positiv attityd och viljan att lära.

jobs.title: Ingénieur Commercial IT - Cloud, Infrastructure & Cybersécurité (H/F)
jobs.description:
Notre client est un acteur français reconnu des services IT à forte valeur ajoutée, spécialisé dans le cloud, l'hébergement, les infrastructures, les réseaux, la cybersécurité et les services managés.
Dans le cadre du développement de son activité en Île-de-France, il renforce son équipe commerciale et recherche 2 Ingénieurs Commerciaux B2B capables d'accélérer le développement de nouveaux comptes sur la région.
Vous rejoignez une structure à taille humaine, en croissance, qui s'appuie sur une expertise technique forte et sur une approche de proximité avec ses clients.


Le poste :

Rattaché(e) au Responsable commercial, vous êtes en charge du développement commercial de votre secteur en Île-de-France, avec un objectif clair : conquérir de nouveaux clients et construire des opportunités commerciales à fort potentiel.
À ce titre, vous :

- Développez votre portefeuille par une démarche active de prospection et de chasse B2B.
- Identifiez et qualifiez les enjeux IT de vos prospects.
- Développez des relations avec des interlocuteurs de haut niveau : DSI, CTO, RSSI, Directions Générales'
- Prenez en charge le cycle de vente complet, de la prospection jusqu'au closing.
- Construisez des propositions commerciales sur mesure avec les équipes avant-vente et techniques.
- Commercialisez des solutions autour du Cloud, de l'hébergement, des infrastructures, des réseaux, de la cybersécurité et des services managés.
- Négociez et concluez vos affaires.
- Développez progressivement votre portefeuille par l'upsell et le cross-sell.
- Assurez un suivi rigoureux de votre activité et de votre pipe commercial.

Le poste nécessite une véritable culture de la conquête : vous aimez ouvrir des portes, créer vos propres opportunités et transformer un prospect en client.


Profil recherché :

Profils particulièrement appréciés
Les expériences dans les environnements opérateurs télécoms, intégrateurs IT, hébergeurs, cloud providers, MSP, cybersécurité ou ESN seront particulièrement valorisées.
Une expérience de vente de solutions combinant plusieurs briques Cloud / Infrastructure / Réseaux / Télécoms / Cybersécurité constitue un réel avantage.
Attention : ce poste n'est pas destiné à un Account Manager exclusivement orienté gestion de portefeuille existant. La capacité à prospecter, chasser et générer son propre business est indispensable.

jobs.title: Consultant Senior Cybersecurity Governance - Cloud & IT Resilience (H/F)
jobs.description:
act digital est un groupe international de conseil et d'ingénierie qui accompagne ses clients dans leurs projets de transformation numérique.

Présent dans 12 pays et fort de plus de 5 600 collaborateurs, nous mettons nos expertises au service de leurs enjeux en développement logiciel, cybersécurité, data, cloud et IA.

Notre ambition : devenir le partenaire technologique de confiance des entreprises les plus innovantes, en concevant et sécurisant des systèmes qui renforcent leur performance et leur résilience.

Rejoindre act digital France, c'est intégrer une organisation agile et engagée, qui fait avancer les projets avec ses clients pour transformer les idées en résultats concrets, avec pragmatisme et exigence.

Le poste :

Vous intégrerez, au sein de notre Pôle Cybersécurité, une équipe dédiée à l'accompagnement de nos clients sur des missions de gouvernance, de gestion des risques et de définition de cadres de référence SSI. Vous serez détaché(e) auprès d'un acteur majeur du secteur bancaire, au sein d'une organisation internationale en charge de définir et de faire évoluer les exigences cybersécurité applicables aux différentes entités du Groupe. Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons un profil expérimenté en gouvernance cybersécurité, disposant de solides connaissances sur les sujets IT Continuity, IT Resilience, Backup & Restore et Cloud Security, capable de contribuer à la formalisation et à l'évolution des exigences et procédures Groupe.

Vos missions seront les suivantes :
- Contribuer à la rédaction, à la révision et à la structuration des exigences cybersécurité et procédures Groupe sur les sujets IT Continuity, IT Resilience, Backup & Restore et Cloud Security
- Accompagner les travaux de Cloud Security et contribuer à l'interprétation ainsi qu'à l'application des exigences de sécurité et de continuité dans les environnements Cloud
- Prendre en compte les différents modèles de services Cloud (IaaS, PaaS, CaaS et SaaS) ainsi que les modèles de responsabilités partagées entre le Groupe et les Cloud Service Providers
- Contribuer à la définition des exigences relatives aux enjeux de continuité, de résilience, de sauvegarde, de restauration, de due diligence et de réversibilité dans les environnements Cloud
- Participer aux travaux de gouvernance cybersécurité : analyse des besoins, formalisation des livrables, préparation des supports de décision et suivi des actions
- Animer et faciliter des workshops en anglais avec les différentes entités et fonctions du Groupe afin de cadrer les attendus, partager les livrables et recueillir les retours opérationnels
- Contribuer à l'alignement des exigences avec les cadres de référence cybersécurité, les bonnes pratiques de continuité et de résilience IT ainsi que les exigences réglementaires applicables

Profil recherché :

Quel profil pour ce poste :
- Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation Bac+5 (École d'ingénieur, Université ou équivalent) en informatique, cybersécurité ou gestion des risques
- Vous justifiez d'une expérience confirmée dans des fonctions de gouvernance cybersécurité, de définition d'exigences, de standards ou de procédures SSI
- Vous disposez d'une expérience significative sur les problématiques de continuité et de résilience des systèmes d'information, idéalement complétée par une connaissance des environnements Cloud
- Vous avez déjà évolué dans un environnement complexe et transverse, impliquant de nombreux interlocuteurs techniques, cybersécurité, risques et métiers
- Vous accordez de l'importance à la rigueur, à la qualité rédactionnelle et à la structuration des livrables
- Vous disposez d'une bonne capacité de synthèse, d'autonomie et êtes à l'aise dans l'animation de workshops avec des interlocuteurs internationaux

Quelles compétences/connaissances pour ce poste :
- Solides connaissances des problématiques IT Continuity, IT Resilience, PRA/PCA et des principes de continuité des systèmes d'information
- Bonne compréhension des stratégies de Backup & Restore, incluant les principes de sauvegarde, restauration, tests et exigences associées
- Connaissance des environnements Cloud et des modèles de services IaaS, PaaS, CaaS et SaaS
- Compréhension des modèles de responsabilités partagées entre les organisations et les Cloud Service Providers
- Expérience dans la rédaction d'exigences cybersécurité, standards, politiques et procédures SSI
- Connaissance des problématiques de sécurité, de continuité, de réversibilité et de gestion des risques dans les environnements Cloud
- Bonne compréhension des cadres de référence et bonnes pratiques cybersécurité
- Anglais courant impératif

jobs.title: Rengøringsplanlægger med stærke data- og analysekompetencer til Rigshospitalets Rengøringsafdeling
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at sikre datadrevet planlægning i en af Danmarks største og mest komplekse rengøringsorganisationer?

Rengøringsafdelingen på Rigshospitalet søger en engageret og analytisk stærk rengøringsplanlægger til en tidsbegrænset stilling frem til 31. december 2027.

Du får en central rolle i arbejdet med at kvalitetssikre og udvikle afdelingens planlægningsgrundlag gennem anvendelse af Data Know How (DKH). Dine analyser og planlægningsopgaver skal understøtte vigtige strategiske beslutninger om bemanding, økonomi og arbejdsmetoder i afdelingen.

Om stillingen

Som rengøringsplanlægger bliver du en vigtig del af afdelingens udviklingsarbejde. Du skal opbygge og vedligeholde rengøringsplaner og, i tæt samarbejde med dine kolleger, sikre valide data som bidrag til et solidt beslutningsgrundlag for ledelsen.

Du skal være opmærksom på at oprydning af eksisterende planer og i DKH, kan forekomme.

Stillingen har særlig betydning i forbindelse med:

  • Planlægning og prissætning af rengøringsopgaver
  • Sammenholde instruktioner med tider i DKH
  • Understøttelse af afdelingens økonomiske prioriteringer
  • Implementering og anvendelse af CSL
  • Medvirke til at CSL og DKH bygger på samme logikker
  • Udvikling af arbejdsplaner og normeringer i forbindelse med ændringer i hospitalets fysiske rammer og byggeprojekter, sammen med ledere og medarbejdere
Du refererer til Souschef Anette Melkjorsen og arbejder tæt sammen med afdelingens ledere og administrative medarbejdere på begge matrikler (Østerbro og Glostrup), og du vil primært have base på Østerbro.

Dine primære opgaver

  • Vedligeholde, analysere og kvalitetssikre data i DKH
  • Udarbejde og optimere rengøringsplaner og normeringer
  • Sikre sammenhæng mellem datagrundlag, normering og drift
  • Udarbejde analyser, rapporter og beslutningsoplæg til ledelsen
  • Bidrage til implementering af nye planlægningsværktøjer og arbejdsgange
  • Sparre med ledergruppen omkring opgaveplanlægning, normering og data fra DKH
  • Medvirke til udviklingsprojekter og organisationsforandringer
  • Oplære og vejlede ledere og medarbejdere i anvendelsen af planlægningsværktøjer
Vi søger dig, som

  • Har indgående kendskab til Data Know How (DKH)
  • Har erfaring med planlægning og ressourceoptimering
  • Har stærke analytiske kompetencer og arbejder datadrevet
  • Er fortrolig med Excel
  • Kan omsætte komplekse data til praktiske løsninger
  • Arbejder struktureret og har fokus på kvalitet og detaljer

jobs.title: Laboratory Technician at Oatly
jobs.description:
Hello potential future Oatly employee

Across the world people’s consumption habits and diets are evolving to be more plant-based. Enter Oatly, the #1 oat based dairy alternative producer in the world with products spanning multiple categories.

We’re determined on being part of the discussion on the long-term future of the food and beverage industry. To keep this movement going, we need more brilliant minds to come work with us to keep the momentum going and the Oatly flowing.

Our sole purpose as a company is to make it easy for people to eat better and live healthier lives without recklessly taxing the planet's resources in the process.

Sustainability, nutritional health and trust are at the heart of what we do. We are building a culture that constantly upgrades each other so we can upgrade the planet. This is a company that shows great respect and a fearless approach to make positive change. Does this feel exciting? Well, this is where you come in.

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO DO

As a Laboratory Technician, you work hands-on in the laboratory, performing daily analyses of products, packaging, media, and environmental samples.

You use your theoretical and practical laboratory experience to carry out accurate and reliable testing, contributing to the overall quality assurance process.

In your role, you interpret laboratory results and apply your judgement to assess outcomes, ensuring that results are meaningful and support informed decision-making. You also collaborate with key stakeholders such as process, filling, quality leaders and at times with global quality functions.

Here’s the main elements of the role...

    

Sampling in the current production operation.

    

Analyzing samples (water filtration, microbiological plating, ATP, pH, dry matter, viscosity and texture measurement).

    

Interpret laboratory results from micro- and chemical analysis.

    

Reporting results into LIMS system.

    

Reacting to deviations generated by laboratory.

    

Updating instructions when needed.

    

Actively participate in site driven programs (focus areas) within Oatly Class program. Be a leading example of Oatly Guiding principles.

But, you know. These are just the things we can think of right now! This might be the job today, but tomorrow brings more change, so being light on your feet and willing to embrace the unknown is a verrrrrry big help.

In this role, you will report into our Laboratory Manager and the location for this role is Landskrona.

This next section is for all the bullet point lovers out there...

WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE

We are looking for you who have at least 2 years of laboratory work – microbiological analysis.

Other key competencies & experiences:

    

You hold a degree in Biomedical Laboratory Science, Molecular Biology, Biotechnology, Engineering, or a related field, and have practical experience working in a laboratory environment.

    

Knowledge of laboratory equipment and safety procedures.

    

LIMS system.

    

Proficiency in both Swedish and English, verbal & writing.

WHO WE NEED YOU TO BEWe think your oatsomeness is built upon the following qualities:

    

You are a passionate advocate for sustainability who strives to create societal shifts and drive the plant-based revolution.

    

You have strong analytical skills and a keen attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and reliability in your work.

    

You manage your time effectively, prioritizing tasks to meet deadlines and maintain a smooth workflow.

    

You communicate clearly and confidently, adapting your message to different stakeholders when needed.

    

You are comfortable working both independently and as part of a team, knowing when to take ownership and when to collaborate.

To be the perfect fit for Oatly, we believe you have a thirst for knowledge and are a result-driven person with high integrity. You thrive with a hands-on approach, even in times of rapid change. Your social competence allows you to work effectively both independently and collaboratively.

Finally, we hope that you share our values and have a great interest to carry out our mission in order to make the world a little bit better. 

Another bulleted list felt redundant, so we made this page talking about all the benefits we offer to sweeten the deal of working with us before you apply – if you're curious, check out this fancy page right here!

YOUR APPLICATION

Phew! Well done if you’ve got this far. We’re glad we’ve still got your attention because we’ve got one last super important point to make.

As you can probably tell, we’re a norm-breaking company. For us, diversity and differences are an obvious asset. We know that amazing candidates can sometimes be put off applying for a job unless they can tick every box, and that makes us really sad. So please trust your gut and pop in your application if it’s feeling right. If you have the curiosity, passion, and collaborative spirit, let’s do this together! It will be fun!

Last day of application: XXX .

We treat all candidates equally: If you are interested, please apply through our application system - any correspondence should come from there. This will ensure that the candidate experience is smooth and fair to everyone!

Love Oatly XOXO

 #LI-TA1

jobs.title: HR Specialist
jobs.description:
Be part of Clavister’s journey to secure the digital world! We are looking for an HR Specialist who wants to take an active role across the employee lifecycle and help us deliver effective, people-focused and scalable HR practices.

We apply Agile HR principles, working closely with the organisation, learning through feedback and data, and continuously adapting our people practices as our needs evolve. This is a broad and hands-on HR role for someone who enjoys combining people interaction with structure, independent responsibility and continuous improvement.

About Clavister

Clavister is a leading European cybersecurity company founded in 1997, headquartered in Örnsköldsvik, offering a wide range of cybersecurity solutions, including network firewalls, identity management, cloud security, machine learning and AI.

Today, we focus on four main customer segments: the Public Sector, Critical Infrastructure, Defence and Telecommunications. Together with our partners and distributors, Clavister’s hardware and software are widely deployed and used by customers in more than 100 countries.

The Role

As HR Specialist, you will work closely with our Head of HR. You will independently manage and coordinate defined HR processes and support employees and leaders throughout the employee lifecycle.

You will have a broad role spanning recruitment, onboarding and offboarding, HR administration and data, work environment activities and day-to-day HR support. You will be responsible for ensuring that the processes within your area are well structured, professionally delivered and continuously improved.

This is a role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, creating structure and making sure things get done, while providing a professional and positive experience for candidates, employees and People Leads.

Key areas of responsibility

    

Manage recruitment processes, including candidate communication, interview coordination and recruitment administration

    

Coordinate and continuously improve onboarding and offboarding processes

    

Coordinate activities, documentation and follow-up related to Systematic Work Environment (SAM) Management and the Safety Committee

    

Maintain accurate employee information, HR systems, documentation and records

You will also contribute to

    

Provide HR support to employees and People Leads, handling routine matters and working together with the Head of HR on more complex questions

    

Prepare and validate employee and compensation data for reporting, analysis and recurring HR processes

    

Support recurring HR activities related to engagement, communication, performance and employee development

    

Support personnel security activities throughout the employee lifecycle

    

Work closely with employees and People Leads to understand needs, gather feedback and improve HR practices

Across all these areas, you will work with an Agile HR mindset, staying close to the organisation, learning from feedback and continuously improving our processes, tools and ways of working.

The person we are looking for

Trust is our foundation, and how you work with people matters to us. We are looking for someone who combines a genuine interest in people with the structure and drive to take ownership and get things done.

You have experience working with HR and independently managing defined HR activities or processes. You understand the employee lifecycle, are comfortable managing several priorities at once, and communicate confidently in both Swedish and English.

We believe you will thrive at Clavister if you:

    

Care about people and take pride in creating a positive and professional experience for others

    

Collaborate openly, build strong relationships and enjoy working closely with employees and leaders

    

Show bravery by taking initiative, asking questions and challenging ways of working when you see an opportunity to improve

    

Innovate by being curious and looking for smarter ways of working, including how technology can improve everyday HR

    

Keep growing by seeking feedback, learning and adapting as the needs of our people and organisation evolve

    

Take ownership of your work while having the judgement to recognise when something should be discussed or escalated

You are structured and reliable and comfortable working iteratively, learning from feedback and adjusting along the way. You understand when consistency and structure are important and when a simpler, more flexible approach creates greater value.

Extra points for

Experience in one or more of the following is an advantage:

    

Recruitment and onboarding

    

Swedish work environment processes and employment practices

    

HR systems, employee data or HR reporting

    

HR analytics

    

Agile HR or working in an agile organisation

    

Technology, international or regulated organisations

We will continuously review and interview qualified applicants.

jobs.description:
GULVLÆGGER SØGES – ER DU VORES NYE KOLLEGA?

Roed Gulve søger en dygtig gulvlægger, der sætter en ære i godt håndværk og et flot resultat.

Vi har travlt og søger derfor en gulvlægger til vores team. Du kommer til at arbejde med forskellige typer af gulvopgaver hos både private og erhvervskunder – og vi forventer, at du kan tage ansvar for dine egne opgaver fra start til slut.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

•            Har erfaring som gulvlægger og kan arbejde selvstændigt

•            Har sans for detaljen og leverer et resultat, du selv vil være bekendt

•            Er mødestabil og overholder dine aftaler

•            Kan planlægge og strukturere dine egne opgaver

•            Er serviceminded og ordentlig over for både kunder og kollegaer

•            Vådrumscertifikat er en fordel, men ikke et krav

•            Har kørekort

 


Hos Roed Gulve får du:

•            Gode løn- og arbejdsforhold

•            En hverdag med varierende opgaver

•            Frihed under ansvar

•            Gode kollegaer og en uformel omgangstone

jobs.title: Le Metier - Sous Chef to work in our new French Brasserie
jobs.description:
Le Metier is looking for a Sous Chef to work in our new French Brasserie

About the position

Le Metier is looking for a Sous Chef to join us and help take the next step in the development of our kitchen.

Le Metier is an independent restaurant located on Christianshavn, Copenhagen, built around the philosophy: good food, genuine hospitality, strong personalities and a restaurant that feel alive.

Le Métier is a new French restaurant on Strandgade 98 in Christianshavn, created by the people behind Lalala, Ma Cuisine and La Propina. The restaurant draws inspiration from the best classic French brasseries and restaurants and celebrates craftsmanship, technique, good ingredients and personal service. The expected opening is October/November 2026.

We are now looking for an ambitious Sous Chef who can work across both restaurants and become an important part of the next stage of our development.

The role

This position is about more than cooking good food. We are looking for someone who wants to help us build a stronger, more structured and more consistent kitchen while protecting the personality and energy of the restaurant.

Working closely with our head chef and management team, you will help us develop the way our kitchens operate every day.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Maintaining a consistently high standard of food and execution.

• Supporting and leading the kitchen teams during service.

• Making sure recipes, preparation and plating are clear and consistent.

• Improving mise en place, organisation and communication.

• Maintaining high standards of cleanliness, hygiene and kitchen maintenance.

• Supporting ordering, stock management and food-cost awareness.

• Training and developing younger members of the kitchen team.

• Helping create systems that make the kitchens more efficient and less dependent on individual people.

• Contributing ideas and feedback to the development of our menus.

• Creating a kitchen culture based on professionalism, respect, responsibility and pride in the craft.

Who we are looking for

• Has solid professional kitchen experience, ideally with experience in French and/or Mediterranean cuisine.

• Has strong technical foundations and genuinely cares about cooking.

• Understands that consistency is as important as creativity.

• Is organised and comfortable working with systems, recipes, prep lists and checklists.

• Can lead by example rather than simply giving instructions.

• Enjoys teaching and developing others.

• Takes responsibility for the kitchen, even when nobody is watching.

• Understands food cost, ordering, waste and the operational side of running a restaurant.

• Cares about cleanliness and organisation as much as what leaves the pass.

• Can remain calm, structured and positive during busy services.

• Wants to contribute ideas and challenge the way we currently work when something can be improved.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone with ambition and personality. We don’t want to create a kitchen without soul. We want a professional kitchen with strong systems behind it, giving talented people the freedom to focus on hospitality, creativity and great food.

What we offer

You will join a restaurant that are currently evolving and help professionalizing our operations. This means you will have the opportunity to make a real impact on how our kitchen is structured and how it will develop in the future.

• The opportunity to influence kitchen systems, organisation and culture.

• Space to contribute creatively to in the restaurant.

• A close relationship with the management and kitchen team.

• Opportunity to grow as the restaurant and our hospitality group develop.

• Salary based on experience and qualifications.

We believe great restaurants are built when good food, strong systems, genuine hospitality and great people work together. If you love your craft, enjoy responsibility and want to help us build something stronger, we would love to meet you.

jobs.title: PhD student in Arctic freshwater ecology
jobs.description:
Department of Aquatic Sciences and Assessment

Third-cycle subject area

Biology with specialisation in ecology

Description of the doctoral project





The overall aim of this PhD project is to understand the influence of climate-driven changes in vegetation cover and winter conditions on habitats and food webs of Arctic/alpine lakes. Climate change is promoting the expansion of terrestrial vegetation, which enhances nutrient sequestration in the Arctic/alpine landscapes and contributes to long-term declines in nutrient input to lakes (i.e., oligotrophication). Concurrently, changing winter conditions, including shorter ice-covered periods and increased snow cover, alter underwater light availability for primary production and oxygen availability for aquatic organisms during winter. This project will use a space-for-time field survey approach to (i) assess the effects of lake oligotrophication and changing winter conditions on benthic biofilm communities across different lake habitats; (ii) evaluate the consequences of biofilm compositional changes for the production and trophic transfer of health-promoting biomolecules (i.e., essential polyunsaturated fatty acids PUFA) versus harmful biomolecules (i.e., cyanotoxins) to higher trophic levels including fish; and (iii) quantify the extent to which oligotrophication and changing winter conditions alter Arctic/alpine lake food webs, including consumer diets, the relative importance of benthic versus pelagic energy pathways, and food-chain length.

About the position

The candidate will work with an international consortium involving collaborators from across the Nordic countries and North America. The project will use samples and data collected from Arctic/alpine lakes in Sweden and other circumpolar regions. Implementation methods will include:

    Seasonal sampling of food web components, from primary producers to fish, during open-water (summer) and under-ice (winter) conditions.
    Analysis of biomarkers (PUFA and cyanotoxins) in biological samples using chromatographic techniques.
    Integration and synthesis of previous data with newly collected data on fatty acids, cyanotoxins, and stable isotopes.
    Application of Bayesian mixing models to investigate consumer diets and food web pathways

Requirements

To meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).

Specific entry requirements for the third-cycle courses and study programme in Biology with specialisation in ecology. To meet the specific entry requirements, you must have least 90 HEC in biology-related subjects. This must include a degree project and at least 30 HEC must be at second-cycle level.

You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.

Your profile

Applicants should hold a degree in aquatic ecology, limnology, ecology, or equivalent. Experience in winter biological sampling at ice-covered lakes is highly meritorious. Strong skills in statistical analysis, experience in scientific publication, and fluency in written and oral Swedish are merits. Advantageous attributes include a working knowledge of aquatic food webs (e.g., algae, macroinvertebrates, zooplankton, fish), Arctic ecology, and/or biogeochemistry. Experience in relevant biological sampling techniques and in biomarker analysis is also advantageous. Emphasis will also be placed on personal qualities including the capability of critical thinking, problem‑solving skills, and the capacity to work independently and in a team. Strong written and spoken English skills, as well as a driver’s license valid for use in Sweden, are required.

About us

The Department of Aquatic Sciences and Assessment is working with applied environmental science, with a national responsibility for assessing the condition of Swedish surface waters with respect to water chemistry, pollution and aquatic biota. The research focuses on geochemical and hydrological processes, aquatic ecology and biodiversity, microbial ecology as well as on environmental chemistry and aquatic ecotoxicology. The department has about 150 employees, of which approximately half are researchers/doctoral students and the other half are technical and administrative staff.

For more information about the department visit: http://www.slu.se/aquatic-sciences

Read more about staff benefits and life as an SLU employee on https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/

Read more about third-cycle courses and study programmes on http://www.slu.se/utbildning/program-kurser/forskarutbildning/

jobs.title: Hyggelig deltidsjobb for deg som liker å hjelpe andre
jobs.employer: PRIMA ASSISTANSE AS AVD OSLO OG ROMERIKE
jobs.description:
Jeg er en omgjengelig kvinne i 50-årene som søker en hyggelig og pålitelig BPA-assistent til en liten stilling i Ås.

Stillingen er på 9,5 timer per uke, fordelt på tre vakter – helst på formiddager. Arbeidstidene er noe fleksible, og vi finner gjerne løsninger som passer for begge.

På grunn av en hode-/nakkeskade trenger jeg litt hjelp for å få hverdagen til å fungere. Jeg bor i ny og koselig leilighet, bare 10 minutters gange fra Ås sentrum. 

Arbeidsoppgaver kan være:

  • Litt husarbeid, rengjøring, handling og andre småærender
  • Bli med på korte gåturer, legebesøk, besøk og lignende
  • Hjelp til å legge til rette for besøk, hobbyer og sosiale aktiviteter
  • Litt småkjøring ved behov – gjerne en liten tur ut for å handle, gjøre et ærend eller komme meg dit jeg skal

Jeg er samfunnsengasjert, positiv og glad i gode samtaler. For meg er det viktig å ha en assistent som både kan hjelpe til praktisk og bidra til en hyggelig og avslappet hverdag.

Jeg ser etter deg som er:

  • Voksen, rolig og pålitelig
  • Selvstendig og ser hva som bør gjøres
  • Hyggelig og sosial, men samtidig komfortabel med rolige dager
  • Har førerkort klasse B og egen bil

Det er kun snakk om svært beskjeden småkjøring, ca. 5–10 km i uken, og du får selvfølgelig kilometergodtgjørelse.

Høres dette ut som en jobb som kunne passet deg? Da håper jeg å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. Nysgjerring på hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss? Les mer på vår karriereside: https://prima-assistanse.no/karriere/jobbe-som-bpa-assistent/

jobs.title: Handläggare med specialistkompetens inom läsnedsättning (vikariat)
jobs.description:
Vill du bidra till allas rätt att läsa på sina villkor? Nu har du chansen att bidra till vårt viktiga demokratiska uppdrag! Vi söker en handläggare med specialistkompetens som vill vara med och utveckla framtidens tillgängliga läsning.

Myndigheten för tillgängliga mediers (MTM) vision är ett samhälle där all läsning är tillgänglig. Vi ska arbeta för att alla ska ha tillgång till litteratur, nyheter och samhällsinformation utifrån vars och ens förutsättningar.

Om jobbet

Vi söker en handläggare med specialistkompetens inom läsnedsättning till teamet för handläggning av ansökningar om tillträde till Legimus. Legimus är MTM:s digitala bibliotekstjänst för personer som har en funktionsnedsättning som gör det svårt att läsa tryckt text.

I rollen kommer du att arbeta med att bedöma ansökningar och fatta beslut om tillträde till Legimus utifrån användarnas behov, gällande riktlinjer och tillgänglig information. I din roll kommer du att ha fokus på mer komplexa bedömningar där analys och avvägningar krävs.

Du ingår i ett team med gemensamt ansvar för en effektiv handläggning med krav på kvalitet och likvärdighet. Rollen innebär att vara teamets specialist på lässituationer och hur funktionsnedsättningar kan påverka läsningen.

Dina arbetsuppgifter:

    Bidra med fördjupad kompetens om funktionsnedsättningar och deras påverkan på läsning, med särskilt fokus på kognitiva läshinder.
    Handlägga ansökningar och kompletteringar i det löpande inflödet.
    Ansvara för bedömning i mer komplexa eller svårbedömda ärenden.
    Bidra med specialistkompetens i framtagandet av internt och externt stödmaterial.
    Stödja kollegor i frågor som rör tolkning och bedömning i relation till målgrupperna.
    Vid behov bidra med specialistkompetens i andra delar av myndigheten.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som har:

    högskoleutbildning inom logopedi, specialpedagogik, biblioteks- och informationsvetenskap eller annan högskoleutbildning som bedöms likvärdig
    aktuell erfarenhet av arbete med tillgängliga medier, alternativt erfarenhet av arbete med personer med läsnedsättning
    mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i svenska i tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du har:

    aktuell erfarenhet av arbete med ärendehandläggning
    aktuell erfarenhet av arbete med myndighetsutövning
    aktuell erfarenhet av att stödja kollegor i bedömningar
    god vana av att självständigt driva och koordinera arbetsuppgifter
    erfarenhet av arbete med att hantera inkommande frågor i mejl och telefon
    erfarenhet av arbete med medborgarservice och bemötandefrågor

Rollen ställer krav på att du är noggrann, strukturerad, pedagogisk och har god analytisk förmåga. Du kan göra välgrundade bedömningar även när underlaget är komplext. Du trivs i ett gemensamt uppdrag där ni tillsammans ansvarar för kvalitet och likvärdighet, och du bidrar aktivt till ett gott samarbete i teamet.

Om arbetsplatsen

MTM vill kunna erbjuda en attraktiv arbetsplats som är fri från diskriminering och ger lika möjligheter för alla. Vi strävar efter en god arbetsmiljö och tycker att det är viktigt att varje medarbetare har möjlighet att kombinera arbete och fritid. Vi erbjuder till exempel förmånliga semesteravtal, friskvård på arbetstid och friskvårdsbidrag. Vi erbjuder också möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån och stor frihet att påverka din egen arbetstid.

På MTM arbetar vi efter den statliga värdegrunden. Det innebär att du som arbetstagare vid MTM och i staten arbetar på medborgarnas uppdrag, ett viktigt och ansvarsfullt åtagande. Som anställd på MTM känner du till och följer de lagar och regler som gäller i verksamheten, agerar sakligt och opartiskt, respekterar öppenhet och yttrandefrihet, behandlar alla lika och med respekt samt förenar service med effektivitet. Som medarbetare på MTM förväntas att du är öppen för nya idéer och välkomnar samverkan med andra.

Om anställningen

Anställningen är ett vikariat på heltid med start den 1 januari 2027 till och med den 31 december 2027. MTM tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Vårt kontor finns i Malmö och det finns möjlighet till visst distansarbete.

Kontaktpersoner

Rekryterande chef: Emma Kindblom, mailto:emma.kindblom@mtm.se

Fackliga representanter: Martin Strandberg, SACO, mailto:martin.strandberg@mtm.se Meri Stakovska, ST, mailto:st@mtm.se

Ansökan

Du är välkommen att registrera din ansökan senast 11 oktober. Ange diarienummer MTM-P 2026/84 i din ansökan.

Besök gärna https://www.mtm.se för mer information om myndighetens verksamhet.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Payroll Manager
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Payroll Manager for a company in Stockholm. Start is ASAP, 6 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Stockholm.

﻿

Daily tasks﻿

• Ensure accurate, compliant and timely end-to-end payroll delivery within a large and complex Swedish payroll environment.

• Lead, support and set priorities for the payroll team, ensuring operational stability and clear ownership.

• Monitor payroll quality, controls, risks and service performance, taking action where issues arise.

• Drive process improvements, digitalisation and automation to reduce manual work and strengthen efficiency.

• Collaborate with HR, Finance, IT, Rewards, People Services and external providers on payroll-related matters.

• Translate operational needs into clear priorities for payroll systems, integrations and longer-term development.

﻿

Minimum technical skills

﻿

• Extensive hands-on knowledge of Swedish end-to-end payroll within a large or complex organisation.

• Strong knowledge of Swedish payroll legislation, compliance, controls, reporting and the annual payroll cycle.

• Swedish language a must.

• Experience managing payroll for multiple employee groups and collective agreements.

• Strong understanding of payroll systems, integrations, data flows, troubleshooting and external provider management.

• Experience of payroll transformation, process development, digitalisation or system-related change.

• Experience with SAP and HRM-related payroll flows is highly relevant.

• Confidence using payroll data and reporting to identify risks, support decision-making and drive improvements.

﻿

Leadership and experience level

• Senior Payroll Manager or equivalent leadership-level experience within a large and complex Swedish organisation.

• Proven experience leading experienced payroll specialists through operational complexity, change and improvement.

• Able to balance strategic direction with hands-on operational judgement and decisive issue resolution.

• Demonstrated ability to stabilise payroll delivery while building clear structures, governance, processes and longer-term development plans.

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust and align payroll priorities across senior stakeholders and specialist functions.

• Structured and pragmatic leadership style, with the ability to prioritise business-critical activities and create clarity in a changing environment



This role requires fluency in both Swedish and English.

This is a full-time consultant position in Stockholm through Incluso.  Start is ASAP, 6 months limited contract to begin with. This role is 100% onsite in Stockholm.

Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

jobs.title: Sprudlende og glad jente på 8 år søker personlige assistenter (BPA) i Sandvika
jobs.description:
Hvem er jeg?

Jeg er ei glad, nysgjerrig og sprudlende jente på 8 år som nå leter etter flere fine mennesker til mitt BPA-team. Jeg bor i et hjem fylt med varme og humor, sammen med familien min og to kosete katter – bare noen minutter fra Sandvika sentrum.

Jeg trenger hjelp i det meste jeg gjør i løpet av dagen, men humøret mitt er nesten alltid på topp. Jeg elsker å leke, tøyse, lage rare lyder og le masse – og jeg håper du vil være med på alt det morsomme og hyggelige som skjer i hverdagen min. Som assistent blir du en trygg voksen rundt meg, og du får være med på lek, turer og alle de små tingene som gjør dagen god.

Hvem er du?

Vi håper å finne deg som har lyst til å bli en viktig og varm person i hverdagen min. Kanskje har du mulighet til å jobbe 1–3 vakter i uka, både ettermiddager og enkelte helger? Innimellom kan det også være aktuelt med nattevakter og ekstra vakter ved sykdom og ferier. Det er en stor fordel om du kan være med på noen reiser sammen med familien min – for jeg liker å være på tur.

Arbeidstid:

  • Hverdager: 16:00–20:00

  • Helger og helligdager: 12:00–20:00 (Arbeidstiden kan endres litt ved behov)

Vi ser etter deg som møter barn med varme og tålmodighet. Du er leken, trygg og rolig, og du trives i rollen som en stødig voksen. Du tar ansvar, skaper god stemning og liker å få ting gjort. Om du har erfaring med barn, er det flott – men absolutt ikke et krav. Det viktigste er at du vil meg godt og ønsker å lære.

Du må også trives med enkle husarbeidsoppgaver som matlaging og rengjøring, da dette er en naturlig del av stillingen.

BPA er et ufaglært yrke, og du trenger ingen formell utdanning. Du får god opplæring i alt du skal gjøre.

Hva skal du gjøre?

Som min BPA vil du:
• være med på aktiviteter, lek, trening, turer og reiser
• hjelpe til med stell, skift og personlig hygiene
• gjøre litt husarbeid som matlaging og rengjøring
• assistere ved forflytning (opplæring og hjelpemidler finnes)
• hjelpe til med sondeernæring (du får god opplæring)
• følge treningsopplegg laget av fysioterapeut

Hva kreves av deg?

• Nordisk morsmål eller bestått norsk språkprøve B1
• Du må kunne kommunisere greit på engelsk
• Du må være komfortabel med katt
• På grunn av arbeidets art, oppfordres kvinner til å søke
• Førerkort klasse B er en fordel
• Det er en fordel om du kan være med på reiser
• Det er en fordel om du kan svømme

Hvis du kjenner at dette høres ut som en jobb du kunne trives i – og du ser for deg at du kan bli en trygg og god person i livet mitt – da håper vi virkelig å høre fra deg.


Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

Dette er noe av det du får ved å jobbe hos oss:

  • Tarifflønn, ansiennitetsregulert

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Veiledning og opplæring

  • Assistentkurs i regi av Humana Omsorg og Assistanse

  • Egen app for håndbøker og rutiner

  • Rabatter hos bl.a. SATS

  • Attraktive rabatter med fordelsprogrammet Visma LogBuy

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.
