jobs.title: Strategic Sourcing Manager
jobs.description:
At Berg Propulsion, we develop advanced propulsion solutions that contribute to a more sustainable and energy-efficient maritime industry. As part of our team, you will work closely with engineering, production, and commercial functions in an international environment where smart sourcing strategies and strong supplier partnerships are critical to success.

With over a century of maritime heritage combined with a forward-looking mindset, we offer a workplace where innovation, accountability, and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do. Here, you'll find short decision-making paths, deep technical expertise, and the opportunity to make a real impact on both our business and the future of shipping.

If you're looking for a role where you can drive change, influence strategic decisions, and help shape the next generation of marine technology, we'd love to hear from you.

The role

Do you thrive at the intersection of technology, business, and supplier collaboration? As Strategic Sourcing Manager for Electrical System Integration, you will lead the development and execution of sourcing strategies that enable innovation, strengthen supply chain resilience, and support business growth. You will work closely with internal stakeholders and external partners to identify the best suppliers, negotiate commercial agreements, and drive continuous supplier performance improvements. This is a highly cross-functional role where you will have a direct impact on product development, project execution, and long-term competitiveness. You will report to our Supply Chain Director and the location is Headquarters at Hönö Pinan.

Key Responsibilities

    

Develop and execute sourcing strategies for new products, projects, and technologies aligned with our business strategies

    

Identify, evaluate, and select suppliers to support product development, quality according to long-term business needs

    

Lead commercial negotiations and manage supplier agreements

    

Lead supplier development and drive continuous performance improvement

    

Lead commercial negotiations and manage supplier agreements

    

Manage supply chain risks

    

Facilitate collaboration between suppliers and internal stakeholders in projects and drive supplier participation in design reviews, cost workshops, and technical evaluations

About you

We believe you are an experienced sourcing professional who enjoys building strong supplier partnerships and creating long-term value for our business. You combine strategic thinking with a commercial mindset and thrive in an cross-functional collaborative environment in a global company. You have an interest and understanding of electrical systems and/or automation and a natural ability to solve problems along the way.



Qualifications & Experience

    

Master/Bachelor degree in Engineering or Business Administration

    

Strong technical knowledge, preferably from product development or product management, related to electrical systems and/or automation

    

Strong understanding of supplier selection, contract negotiations, and supply chain risk management

    

Experience of managing cross-functional projects and stakeholder engagement

    

Knowledge of cost analysis and contract management

    

Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken

What We Offer

With our location on Hönö and Öckerö, where our production facilities and offices are situated right by the water, we can offer a truly inspiring work environment. We know that people are at the heart of our business, which is why employee well-being is important to us. We place great value on teamwork, collaboration, and a strong sense of community.

In addition to joining a great team of colleagues from around the world, we also offer:

    

The opportunity to make a real impact on the global effort to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and help drive change within the industry.

    

Opportunities to learn, grow, and share knowledge and experiences.

    

Attractive employee benefits, including flexible working hours, competitive pension plans, health insurance, bike leasing, and more.

    

Last but not least, one of the most stunning workplace locations in the Gothenburg region, with the sea as your closest neighbour and views that are hard to beat.

For inquiries about the role contact the hiring manager: Helena Lennerstedt: helena.lennerstedt@bergpropulsion.com

jobs.title: Bid Manager
jobs.description:
At VARD, we create innovative and sustainable solutions for the global maritime industry. Combining engineering excellence, cutting-edge technology, and strong teamwork, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced vessels.

At the same time, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We foster an inclusive and supportive environment where talents can grow, ideas are valued, and individuals are empowered to make an impact.

Vard Interiors is a leading supplier of turnkey interior, insulation, piping, and HVAC-R solutions for the maritime industry. As part of the VARD value chain, we work closely with shipowners, designers, and shipyards to create functional, sustainable, and high-quality onboard environments. With a strong focus on innovation, craftsmanship, and customer value, we help bring some of the industry’s most advanced vessels to life.

We are currently looking for a Bid Manager to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities
  • Lead and coordinate the bid process for assigned sales projects.
  • Prepare and review cost calculations and commercial proposals.
  • Develop and review technical proposals for customers.
  • Maintain and improve cost estimation tools, routines and databases.
  • Conduct cost analyses and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
  • Perform risk assessments and maintain risk registers throughout the sales process.
  • Collaborate with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders to clarify project scope and requirements.
  • Facilitate project handover from Sales to Project Execution.
  • Support the continuous development of estimating methodologies and best practices
Qualifications

  • Good written and spoken English and Norwegian skills.
  • Knowledge of vessel interiors, HVAC and piping systems.
  • Understanding of shipbuilding processes and the maritime industry.
  • Experience with cost estimation, commercial analysis or bid management is an advantage.
  • Proven experience in securing contracts and delivering successful bids is considered a plus.

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills.
  • Commercially minded with a strong business understanding.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented, with excellent problem-solving abilities.
  • Proactive and solution-oriented in your approach to work.

Our commitment to you

jobs.title: Product Engineering Specialist
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to: IPU Manager.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the center of the action. You will work closely with teams across the organization, coordinating activities ranging from product introductions and phase-outs to continuous improvement projects and cost-saving initiatives. In this position, you will play a key role in ensuring that projects progress efficiently and deliver results.

You will join the Product Engineering team and report to the Product Engineering Manager, becoming part of the Smart Power organization in Västerås, Sweden. The unit is part of ABB Electrification and is responsible for developing, manufacturing, marketing, and selling low-voltage products for which ABB has global responsibility. These products include large contactors, soft starters, pilot devices, and safety products.

In this role, you will be responsible for the industrialization of products in accordance with technical specifications throughout both the product development phase and the active product lifecycle. You will support cross-functional teams, drive implementation activities, and contribute to the development and continuous improvement of processes and ways of working within the function.

Your role and responsibilities

    Coordinate and drive collaboration within the team, as well as with local and global stakeholders.
    Take ownership of Active Product Management (APM) activities, leading projects and initiatives throughout the product lifecycle, both before and after product release.
    Develop and continuously improve Product Engineering processes and ways of working, strengthening collaboration between agile development teams, manufacturing units, and manufacturing functions.
    Support R&D teams by ensuring manufacturability is considered throughout the product design and development process.

jobs.title: Quantitative Risk Analyst, Realized Loss Data and Estimation
jobs.employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
jobs.description:
Job ID: 5670



Do you want to play an important role in one of the largest model development programmes in Nordics? We are now looking for the Quantitative Risk Analyst to develop LGD (loss given default) data and models in Nordea.



The job provides an exciting mix of challenges such as data analysis, providing inputs to the development of statistical models, designing internal software libraries, working with big data, analysing economic behaviour, understanding and abiding to regulatory constraints.



About our team



Meet the Realised Loss Data and Estimation team in Risk Models Methodology & IRB Models in Nordea. Working with us, you will be a part of one of the most important programs for the bank, which consists in upscaling Nordea’s internal models for credit risk. The primary focus of this role is development of the target variable for Nordea’s Loss Given Default (LGD) models, but there would be opportunities to work other IRB parameters. As the Quantitative Risk Analyst you will develop your skills within advanced modelling - a field which is in high focus in Nordea. 



Being a part of the broader Group Risk organization, you'll help ensure that compliance underpins every decision we make and every action we take. By bringing your perspectives to the team and through your focus on quality and cooperation, you will be important.



Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.



What you’ll be doing



Main responsibilities in this role:

    Develop, test and maintain realised loss data for LGD models.
    Develop tools for data extraction for model development and other analysis.
    Work with internal business unit users of IRB LGD models and help integrate Continuously work on improving methodological choices for the models and be able to clearly communicate its rationale and impact to internal and external stakeholders.
    Join an open and inspiring atmosphere, where you will cooperate closely with your colleagues across the bank.
    Give input to senior management and business based on data analysis and previous experience.



Who you are



This is the right role for you if:

    Enjoy learning and are excited about bringing your ideas to the table.
    Take the ownership of the task, but enjoying collaboration with others.
    Have good communication skills to manage stakeholder interaction efficiently across the value chain.



Your background and skills include:

    Advanced degree in a quantitative field, including but not limited to economics, statistics, physics, mathematics, data science, computer science or similar.
    Experience in SQL, Python, SAS or similar.
    Understanding of statistical and machine learning methods.
    Experience in working with data and models.
    Knowledge of IRB models is an advantage.



It would be ideal if you also:

    Experience in driving deliveries with the tight deadlines.
    Knowledge of credit risk processes and bank products.
    Understanding of technologies and IT solutions used for data processing.



What we offer



People come here when they want to get somewhere. For some, it’s to take their career to the next level. For others, it’s to break new ground within their area of expertise – in other words, with us, you will always move forward.



A culture that fosters performance and growth in one of the largest Nordic banks, offering various opportunities to evolve, develop and learn from brilliant colleagues with diverse backgrounds in a vibrant working environment.



Hybrid working model – we believe in the value of bringing people together and at the same time we embrace the freedom of flexibility.



Diversity and inclusion are a natural part of our daily work. We know that an inclusive workplace is a sustainable one. We genuinely believe that our diverse backgrounds, experiences, characteristics and traits make us stronger together. Every day we strive to find new ways to improve diversity and inclusion within our community e.g. we have signed the European Diversity Charters in the countries where we operate to show our commitment and engage with others to continue learning and improving.



If this sounds like you, get in touch!



We enable dreams and aspirations for a greater good.



We build relationships. We add a personal touch to everything we do – when advising our customers, collaborating with colleagues, and meeting our potential candidates.



We learn and develop. We take pride in being experts and thinking ahead. We use our expertise to meet our customers’ needs, from the simplest to the most complex. We bring a growth mindset to our work that enables us to focus on a broader perspective in our daily challenges.



We lead change. We are responsible and aware of the impact of our decisions, both for our customers and for our local and global communities. Mindful of our responsibility towards current and future generations, we have made sustainability an integrated part of our business strategy.



We are Nordea. We have a 200-year history of supporting and growing the Nordic economies and our values are deeply rooted in these open, progressive and collaborative societies. As one of the biggest employers in the Nordics, Poland and Estonia, you have excellent opportunities to evolve, develop and move forward with us.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Advisor to Tech Strategy & Enablement
jobs.employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
jobs.description:
Job ID: 6459

We are looking for Senior Strategic Advisor to play a key role in shaping Nordea’s Technology strategy and AI. This is an opportunity to grow and learn in a fast-paced environment in the center of Nordea’s Technology development and implementation.

About our team

Group Technology Strategy and AI is responsible for development and execution of Nordea’s technology strategy, and is a Center of Excellence for AI Nordea’s AI value creation and execution.

In our team Tech Strategy & Enablement, we are looking for a highly motivated technology strategist who thrives in complexity, enjoys connecting the dots across a large organisation, and can translate long-term ambitions into practical outcomes. You will work across Group Technology, Architecture, Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, Data, Risk, Finance and business stakeholders to help shape Nordea’s technology strategy, support major transformation initiatives, provide strategic guidance on modernisation and investment decisions, assess emerging technology trends and regulatory developments, and produce executive-level material for senior leadership

What you’ll be doing:

    Shape and evolve Nordea’s technology strategy in collaboration with stakeholders across Group Technology and the wider organisation.
    Drive strategic initiatives and transformation programs across areas such as modernisation, cloud, engineering, resilience, cybersecurity and emerging technologies.
    Develop executive-level analyses, recommendations and decision material for senior leadership and governance forums.
    Provide strategic guidance and constructive challenge on technology investments to ensure alignment with Nordea’s long-term objectives.
    Monitor market, technology and regulatory developments, translating insights into actionable strategic recommendations.
    Build strong relationships across technology, architecture, finance, risk and business teams to drive alignment and execution.
    Help turn strategic ambitions into clear roadmaps, measurable outcomes and tangible business value.

You will work in an experienced and ambitious team with backgrounds from top-tier consultancies and leading Nordic corporates, providing exposure, mentorship, and the opportunity to grow rapidly as a professional. The preferred location for the role is Helsinki or Stockholm – and we like to go to the office 4 times a week. Or in Poland (Tri-City, Warsaw) where we follow 60 % onsite hybrid model of working.

Who you are

Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in how we work and how we make decisions – and that we imagine you share with us.

You combine strategic thinking with a practical understanding of technology and can operate confidently at the intersection of technology strategy and execution. You are not expected to be a developer, but you bring enough technical knowledge to engage with complex enterprise topics, ask the right questions, and turn big-picture thinking into clear direction and action.

    Ownership and independence: You are ready to take ownership of your work, operate independently across technology and business teams, and move priorities forward in a large, complex organisation.
    Strategic thinking: You can see the bigger picture, structure complex or ambiguous topics, define priorities, and translate analysis into clear recommendations and practical actions.
    You have experience working with technology strategy, transformation, or execution topics in a large enterprise, consultancy, technology company, financial institution, or multinational organisation.
    You understand technology fundamentals and can engage credibly in discussions on significant technology topics. You do not need to be a developer, but you can connect technical considerations with strategic and business priorities.
    You are organised and reliable, able to manage multiple workstreams, dependencies, and follow-ups in a matrix environment where ownership may be shared and authority indirect.
    Excellent communication and presentation skills: You can explain complex topics clearly, build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, and prepare concise, high-quality presentations and decision-support materials suitable for Group Leadership Team discussions.
    Collaborative approach: You work constructively with different personalities and perspectives, contribute both analytical thinking and hands-on support, and build effective partnerships across organisational boundaries.
    You communicate confidently and professionally in English, both in writing and in discussions.

It would be ideal if you also have:

    Exposure to AI-driven transformation: Experience working with AI topics, portfolios, or large-scale change programmes would be an advantage, but this can also be developed in the role.
    Previous experience from finance industry.
    Knowledge of another Nordic language: This is considered a plus but is not required.
    Relevant Master’s degree in Information Technology, IT project management, computer science or business.

What we offer

Why join Group Technology Strategy & AI?

    You have a front‑row seat to enterprise AI for real. Be in the room where decisions and delivery happen, shaping how AI powers the bank at scale.
    Work shoulder‑to‑shoulder with senior leaders. Partner with executives and cross‑functional teams on the topics that matter most for Nordea’s next chapter.
    A team you’ll be proud to grow with. Join a collaborative, high‑performing crew with diverse backgrounds and a strong mentoring culture.
    Build your career where strategy meets AI. Own work at the intersection of Technology/AI, strategy and transformation inside the leading Nordic bank.
    Steep learning curve, real impact. Move fast, learn fast, and see your work steer how we invest in AI.
    Go deep on the tech. Develop practical knowledge in AI technologies, architecture and implementation.

If this sounds like you, get in touch!

Next steps

Submit your application (in PDF format in English) no later than 13/10/2026. Please note that we will proceed with potential candidates already during the application period. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a call with their future team members. jobs.title: Data Scientist for Department of Biology
jobs.description:
We are Earth scientists who accumulate large data sets on the composition of sedimentary rocks in geologic time on modern sediments from throughout the world. Our ambition is to generate coupled interactive data sets, where data can be easily extracted, and compared with other literature data sets. What we need is a data scientist to help us organize and curate our data, to extract data from the literature and to generate computational platforms for data analysis. A GIS framework will be important for some of the data organization analyses.

Overall, we need someone who is motivated, with good ideas as to how data bases can be organized and manipulated and with skills using GIS. To be considered for this position the applicants should have a PhD degree. 

The data scientist will be part of the Nordcee research group and specifically the Canfield Villum group exploring the relationship between the evolution of the Earth’s
chemical environment and the evolution of life. The position is based at the Department of Biology.

The position will run from February 1 2027 until June 30, 2029.

Salary and employment terms
Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

Nous recherchons un(e) Architecte Cybersécurité Senior pour rejoindre le pôle Expertise de l'équipe Cybersécurité de la DSI. Le pôle accompagne les équipes internes sur les sujets d'architecture, d'innovation et de sécurisation du SI. La mission consiste à accompagner les équipes agiles dans l'atteinte d'un niveau élevé de sécurité, à définir les exigences et doctrines de sécurité, à challenger les solutions existantes et à contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la cybersécurité.
Missions principales :
-        Accompagner les équipes agiles dans l'intégration des exigences de sécurité et leur mise en conformité.
-        Définir et faire évoluer les doctrines et requis non fonctionnels de sécurité.
-        Réaliser des missions d'architecture de sécurité technique sur les applications, socles et environnements Cloud.
-        Accompagner les équipes sur les pratiques DevSecOps et la sécurisation du cycle de développement logiciel.
-        Challenger les solutions techniques existantes et assurer une veille technologique régulière.
-        Analyser et challenger les résultats d'audits offensifs (pentest, red teaming) et accompagner la remédiation des vulnérabilités.
-        Accompagner l'exploitation et l'acculturation autour de solutions de cybersécurité : DLP, CNAPP, SSE, VOC, DMARC, Cloud souverain, etc.
-        Accompagner la mise en œuvre de solutions de chiffrement à l'état de l'art, notamment dans le cadre de la transition post-quantique.
-        Valider la conformité cybersécurité des nouveaux socles et applications du SI.
-        Contribuer à la sécurisation des applications à l'aide de l'IA et aux nouveaux usages autour des LLM, MCP et de l'agentique.
-        Contribuer à la stratégie et à l'amélioration continue des activités de l'équipe Cybersécurité.
-        Participer ponctuellement à d'autres sujets transverses de cybersécurité selon l'actualité et les besoins de la DSI.
Livrables attendus :
-        Doctrines et exigences de sécurité applicables aux équipes agiles.
-        Analyses et recommandations d'architecture cybersécurité.
-        Avis et validations de conformité cyber des applications et socles.
-        Analyses et plans de remédiation issus des audits offensifs.
-        Recommandations d'amélioration DevSecOps et SSDLC.
-        Documents de veille, études et recommandations technologiques.
-        Accompagnement au déploiement et à l'adoption des solutions de cybersécurité.
-        Recommandations et dispositifs liés au chiffrement, à la PKI, aux certificats et à la transition post-quantique.
-        Contributions à la stratégie et aux plans d'amélioration continue de la cybersécurité.
Profil recherché :
-        Expérience significative en architecture cybersécurité et en sécurité technique.
-        Solides compétences en sécurité des applications, des API, du Web, des systèmes, des réseaux et du Cloud.
-        Expérience pratique en développement et en DevSecOps : SSDLC, SAST, DAST, SCA, CNAPP, CSPM, etc.
-        Expérience en sécurité offensive : pentest et/ou red teaming.
-        Certification sur un ou plusieurs Cloud Service Providers : AWS, Azure et/ou GCP.
-        Maîtrise des environnements Cloud et infrastructures : AWS, Azure, GCP, VMware, Kubernetes.
-        Bonnes connaissances en gestion des identités et des accès : OIDC, SAML, SCIM.
-        Connaissances des architectures réseau et sécurité : ADN, SASE.
-        Solides connaissances en cryptographie, certificats/CLM, PKI, KMS/HSM.
-        Connaissances des méthodologies d'évaluation des risques : ISO, NIST, etc.
-        Bonne compréhension des technologies IA : LLM, MCP, agentique, ainsi que des solutions telles que Dust, Mistral et Copilot.
-        Maîtrise des environnements Linux, Windows et macOS.
-        Expérience en environnement Agile/Scrum ; certification SAFe appréciée.

jobs.title: Vil du forme fremtidens grønne og levende arbeidsplasser på Sunnmøre?
jobs.description:
Er du en relasjonsbygger som motiveres av å skape visuelle endringer og bedre trivsel for ansatte?

 

Har du lyst til å selge et produkt alle vil ha, og som beviselig forbedrer arbeidsmiljøet? Safari Planter AS opplever solid vekst, og nå søker vi deg som vil ta eierskap til B2B-markedet vårt i Ålesund og omegn.

 

Hvorfor er dette en unik mulighet?

De fleste selger software, forsikring eller kaffemaskiner. Hos Safari Planter selger du en opplevelse, bedre inneklima og estetiske arbeidsplasser. Grønne vegger, spektakulære atriumløsninger og skreddersydd planteinteriør er i vinden som aldri før. Bedrifter investerer tungt i å få de ansatte tilbake til kontoret – og her sitter du med nøkkelen.

 

Som B2B-selger hos oss får du en sjelden kombinasjon av kreativ rådgivning og rendyrket business-to-business-salg. Du blir vårt ansikt utad mot regionens mest spennende bedrifter, eiendomsutviklere og arkitekter.

 

 

Hva vil hverdagen din bestå i?

Du vil ha stor frihet til å legge opp din egen arbeidsdag, med base fra vårt kontor i Ålesund. Hovedfokus er å fylle egen portefølje og skape grønnere rom for næringsliv og offentlig sektor:

 

  • Oppsøkende salg og relasjonsbygging: Du identifiserer muligheter, booker møter og bygger langsiktige partnerskap med beslutningstakere.
  • Kreativ rådgivning: Du lytter til kundens behov og tegner ut helhetlige løsninger i grensesnittet mellom interiør, arkitektur og biophilia (menneskets behov for natur).
  • Anbud og prosjekter: Du driver prosessene fra første kontakt og tilbudsskriving til forhandlinger og avtaleinngåelse – inkludert offentlige anskaffelser.

  • Nettverksbygging: Du representerer Safari Planter på messer, bransjetreff og i samarbeid med lokale arkitekter og interiørarkitekter.

     

 

Hvem er du?

Vi ser etter deg som trigges av å lukke avtaler, men som forstår at et godt salg starter med tillit. Du har gjerne erfaring fra prosjektsalg, kapitalvaresalg eller interiørløsninger mot bedriftsmarkedet

 

  • Du er en jeger med rådgiverhatt: Du trives med oppsøkende aktivitet, men fremstår som en profesjonell og lyttende sparringspartner for kunden.
  • Du har kommersiell teft: Du forstår B2B-markedet, hvordan offentlige innkjøp fungerer, og hvordan du posisjonerer Safari Planter som den foretrukne leverandøren.
  • Du har nettverk på Sunnmøre: Det er en stor fordel om du allerede kjenner det lokale næringslivet i regionen.
  • Språk og logistikk: Du kommuniserer flytende på norsk (skriftlig og muntlig), har gode engelskkunnskaper, og førerkort klasse B er et krav da du vil være mye på farten.

 

 

Hva kan vi tilby deg?
  • En attraktiv lønnsmodell: Konkurransedyktig fastlønn i bunn, kombinert med en provisjonsmodell som belønner gode resultater.
  • Høy påvirkningskraft: Vi er en fremoverlent organisasjon der veien fra idé til beslutning er kort. Du får være med på å forme våre fremtidige konsepter og salgsstrategier.
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø: Du blir en del av et uformelt, engasjert og faglig sterkt team som brenner for det de leverer.
  • Et takknemlig produkt: Du selger løsninger som bidrar direkte til økt trivsel, lavere sykefravær og flottere visuelle rammer hos kundene dine.

jobs.description:

Job Description

1\. Responsible for on-site debugging of the PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) program for the post-processing system and configuration of the upper computer system.

2\. Responsible for data integration and communication protocol matching between the control system provided by the vendor side and the factory level DCS (Distributed Control System) in Finland.

3\. Guide the wiring inspection and signal testing of on-site sensors, actuators, and electrical cabinets to ensure control accuracy.

3\. Possess 3 to 5 years of experience in automation debugging within the chemical or lithium battery materials industry, capable of independently resolving complex communication failures.

4\. Master the source code and debugging passwords of the proprietary control logic for this project, serving as a core member in the development of the metering system control program.

jobs.description:
Emploi Pédodontiste H/F - Vauréal 95
Nous recrutons un pédodontiste H/F en salariat pour intégrer une structure dentaire moderne située à Vauréal (Val-d'Oise).
Description et missions
Vous exercerez en tant que pédodontiste exclusif ou en bénéficiant d'une formation approfondie en orthodontie, selon votre projet professionnel. Vous rejoindrez un environnement favorisant une prise en charge optimale des jeunes patients, avec un support clinique et administratif complet : assistante dentaire dédiée au fauteuil et équipe de secrétaires assurant la gestion des rendez-vous et du suivi administratif. La structure garantit un flux constant de nouveaux patients, assurant un agenda bien rempli.
ADN de la structure
La clinique bénéficie d'infrastructures modernes, récemment rénovées, et dotées de technologies de pointe : Invisalign Diamond Provider, scanners de dernière génération, panoramique, cone beam et céphalométrie. L'équipe est composée de 10 assistantes dentaires et 5 secrétaires, assurant une gestion fluide et efficace. Les praticiens bénéficient également d'un accompagnement personnalisé pour leur installation et leur évolution professionnelle.
Rémunération
Cette opportunité vous permettra de percevoir une rémunération attractive, définie selon le profil du candidat.
Avantages
- Huit semaines de congés payés
- Week-end de trois jours
- Mutuelle et contrat de prévoyance de qualité
- Remboursement des frais de transport à hauteur de 50 %

Un de nos consultants vous aidera pour l'apprentissage de la langue, la mise en relation avec nos professeurs partenaires, l'inscription à l'ordre et votre recherche de logement.

jobs.title: Palvelupäällikkö taloushallinnon tiimiin Ouluun
jobs.description:
Johda tiimiä ja kehitä asiakkuuksia

Haluatko yhdistää tiimin ja asiakkuuksien johtamisen sekä kehittämistyön roolissa, jossa pääset oikeasti vaikuttamaan? Meillä pääset vetämään asiantuntevaa tiimiä ja rakentamaan sujuvaa arkea sekä asiakkaille että omalle porukallesi. Haemme taloushallinnon tiimiin palvelupäällikköä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen vahvistamaan ammattilaistemme joukkoa Oulussa ja lähipaikkakunnilla. Työntekopaikkana toimii Oulun seutu ja odotamme työskentelyä pääosin Oulun tai lähikuntien toimistollamme.



Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

- Tiimin toiminnan johtaminen annettujen tavoitteiden mukaisesti

- Töiden organisointi ja resursointi

- Asiakkuuksien johtaminen, kehittäminen ja asiakashuolenpito

- Asiantuntijoiden sparraus ja osaamisen kehittäminen

- Palvelun laadun varmistaminen

- Toimintatapojen ja palveluiden kehittäminen sekä muutosten jalkauttaminen omassa tiimissä



Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

- Vastuullisen ja monipuolisen roolin, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan

- Osaavan ja tukevan kollegaverkoston, esihenkilön ja hallinnon palvelutiimit

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää sekä omaa että tiimisi osaamista

- Kilpailukykyiset edut: laajennettu työterveys, suoritukseesi perustuva tulospalkkio sekä joustavat hyvinvointiedut (liikunta, kulttuuri, hyvinvointi, työmatkat...)



Tunnistatko itsesi tästä?

- Sinulla on kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ja asiakkuuksien johtamisesta

- Osaat organisoida, priorisoida ja delegoida

- Johdat mielelläsi esimerkillä ja innostat muita onnistumaan

- Viestit selkeästi ja rakennat sujuvaa yhteistyötä

- Haluat kehittää toimintaa ja viedä asioita eteenpäin



Meillä pääset osaksi yhteisöä, jossa

- yhdessä tekeminen näkyy arjessa

- tukea saa aina, ja ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava

- arvostamme kehittämishalua, vastuullisuutta ja aitoa kiinnostusta ihmisten johtamiseen



Toimimme Aallon arvojen mukaisesti: Osaan, Palvelen, Huolehdin, Kehityn. Yhdessä muodostamme tilitoimiston – monimuotoisen työyhteisön, työpaikan ja asiantuntijaorganisaation, jossa jokainen meistä voi työskennellä ylpeyttä, tyytyväisyyttä ja turvallisuutta tuntien. Yhteistyö kanssamme perustuu molemminpuoliseen kunnioitukseen, luottamukseen ja rehellisyyteen. Uskomme menestyksen kumpuavan tyytyväisistä asiantuntijoista, jotka mahdollistavat tyytyväiset asiakkaat. Strategiamme ydinajatus kulminoituu Aallon sloganiin Tilitoimistoni.

jobs.title: Wilderness Guide
jobs.description:
**Are you looking for meaningful work in the magical nature of Lapland? Do you want to provide guests with unforgettable experiences away from commercial mass tourism?**

**Flow Lapland Experiences Oy** is a Rovaniemi-based experience and activity service company offering high-quality, authentic, and personalized small-group tours. In our operations, we focus on high safety standards, genuine interactions, and unique nature experiences. We are now looking for a motivated and customer-oriented **Wilderness & Nature Guide**to join our team and create unforgettable moments for our international guests.

Your Versatile Responsibilities

As a guide, you will be the most important link between the customer and Laplands unique nature. Your workday will mainly consist of the following tasks:

- **Northern Lights Tours (Aurora Hunting):** Guiding groups and taking photography of the Northern Lights during evening and nighttime hours.

- **Winter Activities & Day Trips:** Leading diverse nature excursions, such as trips to the iconic Korouoma ice falls area and wildlife park visits.

- **Customer Service:** A warm, active, and attentive approach when interacting with guests from all over the world.

- **Responsibility & Safety:** Ensuring group safety, overall well-being, and tour schedules in arctic conditions.


What We Expect From You

**Requirements:**

- **Language Skills:** Excellent spoken English.

- **Driver's License:** A valid Category B driver's license and strong confidence driving in challenging arctic winter conditions.

- **Attitude:** A positive customer service mindset, flexibility, and strong teamwork skills.

- **Stress Tolerance:** Ability to act responsibly, calmly, and methodically, even in changing situations.


**Considered an Advantage:**

- Previous experience as a wilderness, nature, or activity guide.

- Valid first aid certification (e.g., EA1 / EA2 / Wilderness First Aid).

- Excellent photography skills (especially knowledge of Northern Lights and night photography).

- Proficiency in languages other than English.


What We Offer You

- **An Inspiring Work Community:** We are a close-knit and supportive team where we invest in everyones well-being through friendly competitions, social evenings, and team recreation days.

- **An Eventful Everyday Life:** A diverse and meaningful role in stunning surroundings—you get to experience Lapland's winter, snow-laden forests, and Northern Lights from the best seat in the house.

- **Training & Career Growth:** As a fresh and growing company, we aim to be an exemplary employer in the tourism industry. We offer comprehensive onboarding and genuine opportunities to develop and advance in your career.

- **Flat Hierarchy & Influence:** Our management is involved in daily operations, offering you the opportunity to significantly influence company development, participate in product development, and take on new responsibilities.

- **Remuneration:** We follow the collective agreement for the ski, tourism, restaurant, and leisure service sector (MaRaVa TES). Salary is determined according to the collective agreement or negotiable based on your experience.

jobs.title: ΒΟΗΘΟΣ ΚΑΛΟΥΠΣΗΣ
jobs.description: ΒΟΗΘΕΙΑ ΣΤΗΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΗ, ΣΥΝΑΡΜΟΛΟΓΗΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΤΟΠΟΘΕΤΗΣΗ ΚΑΛΟΥΠΙΩΝ ΓΙΑ ΣΚΥΡΟΔΕΤΗΣΕΙΣ. ΜΕΤΑΦΟΡΑ, ΠΡΟΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΤΑΚΤΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΕΞΟΠΛΙΣΜΟΥ. ΚΟΠΗ ΚΑΙ ΠΡΟΣΑΡΜΟΓΗ ΞΥΛΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΛΩΝ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ ΣΥΜΦΩΝΑ ΜΕ ΤΙΣ ΟΔΗΓΙΕΣ ΤΟΥ ΚΑΛΟΥΨΗ. ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΣΤΗΝ ΑΠΟΞΗΛΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΑΠΟΜΑΚΡΥΝΣΗ ΚΑΛΟΥΠΙΩΝ ΜΕΤΑ ΤΗΝ ΟΛΟΚΛΗΡΩΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΩΝ. ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ, ΕΚΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ. ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΤΑΞΗΣ ΣΤΟΝ ΧΩΡΟ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΚΑΝΟΝΩΝ ΥΓΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑΣ ΣΤΟ ΕΡΓΟΤΑΞΙΟ. ΕΚΤΕΛΕΣΗ ΑΛΛΩΝ ΣΥΝΑΦΩΝ ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΩΝ ΠΟΥ ΑΝΑΤΙΘΕΝΤΑΙ ΑΠΟ ΤΟΝ ΠΡΟΙΣΤΑΜΕΝΟ. , ΚΑΛΗ ΦΥΣΙΚΗ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΕΚΤΕΛΕΣΗΣ ΧΕΙΡΩΝΑΚΤΙΚΗΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ, ΣΥΝΕΠΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟ ΠΝΕΥΜΑ. ΔΙΑΘΕΣΗ ΓΙΑ ΜΑΘΗΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΚΠΑΙΔΕΥΣΗ ΣΤΙΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΚΑΛΟΥΠΙΩΝ. ΠΡΟΗΓΟΥΜΕΝΗ ΕΜΠΕΙΡΙΑ ΣΕ ΟΙΚΟΔΟΜΙΚΕΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΘΑ ΘΕΩΡΗΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΠΡΟΣΘΕΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ. , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.title: ΒΟΗΘΟΣ ΣΙΔΕΡΑΣ
jobs.description: ΥΠΟΒΟΗΘΗΣΗ ΣΤΗΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΗ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΑΡΜΟΛΟΓΗΣΗ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΩΝ. ΠΡΟΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΙΑ, ΚΟΠΗ, ΛΕΙΑΝΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΜΕΤΑΦΟΡΑ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΩΝ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ. ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΣΤΙΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΣΥΓΚΟΛΛΗΣΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΤΟΠΟΘΕΤΗΣΗΣ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΩΝ ΣΤΟΙΧΕΙΩΝ. ΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ, ΕΚΦΟΡΤΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΤΑΚΤΟΠΟΙΗΣΗ ΥΛΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΩΝ. ΧΡΗΣΗ ΧΕΙΡΟΚΙΝΗΤΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΙΚΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΩΝ ΣΥΜΦΩΝΑ ΜΕ ΤΙΣ ΟΔΗΓΙΕΣ ΤΟΥ ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΥ ΤΕΧΝΙΤΗ. ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΚΑΝΟΝΩΝ ΥΓΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑΣ ΣΤΟΝ ΧΩΡΟ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΟΡΓΑΝΩΣΗΣ ΤΟΥ ΕΡΓΑΣΤΗΡΙΟΥ Η ΤΟΥ ΕΡΓΟΤΑΞΙΟΥ. , ΚΑΛΗ ΦΥΣΙΚΗ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΔΥΝΑΤΟΤΗΤΑ ΧΕΙΡΩΝΑΚΤΙΚΗΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ. ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ, ΣΥΝΕΠΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΔΙΑΘΕΣΗ ΓΙΑ ΜΑΘΗΣΗ. ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΣΥΝΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ ΣΕ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟ ΠΕΡΙΒΑΛΛΟΝ. ΠΡΟΗΓΟΥΜΕΝΗ ΕΜΠΕΙΡΙΑ ΣΕ ΜΕΤΑΛΛΙΚΕΣ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΕΣ Η ΣΥΝΑΦΕΙΣ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΕΣ ΘΑ ΘΕΩΡΗΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΠΡΟΣΘΕΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ. , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.description: ΜΗΧΑΝΙΚΟΣ ΑΥΤΟΚΙΝΗΤΩΝ ΒΑΡΕΩΝ ΤΥΠΩΝ ΑΣΧΟΛΕΙΤΑΙ ΜΕ ΤΗ ΣΥΝΤΗΡΗΣΗ, ΔΙΑΓΝΩΣΗ ΚΑΙ ΕΠΙΣΚΕΥΗ ΜΕΓΑΛΩΝ ΟΧΗΜΑΤΩΝ ΟΠΩΣ ΦΟΡΤΗΓΑ, ΛΕΩΦΟΡΕΙΑ, ΕΚΣΚΑΦΕΙΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΛΑ ΒΑΡΕΑ ΜΗΧΑΝΗΜΑΤΑ.   , ΓΝΩΣΗ ΧΡΗΣΗΣ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΩΝ ΟΠΩΣ ΧΕΙΡΟΚΙΝΗΤΑ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΑ, ΑΝΥΨΩΤΙΚΑ ΜΗΧΑΝΗΜΑΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΝΙΚΟ ΔΙΑΓΝΩΣΤΙΚΟ ΕΞΟΠΛΙΣΜΟ ΕΛΕΓΧΟΣ ΟΤΙ ΟΙ ΕΠΙΣΚΕΥΕΣ ΕΧΟΥΝ ΟΛΟΚΛΗΡΩΘΕΙ ΣΩΣΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΟΤΙ ΤΑ ΟΧΗΜΑΤΑ ΕΙΝΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΗ ΓΙΑ ΧΡΗΣΗ ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΑΚΡΙΒΩΝ ΑΝΑΦΟΡΩΝ ΕΠΙΣΚΕΥΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΔΕΛΤΙΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑ , EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy

ΧΡΗΣΙΜΟΠΟΙΕΙ ΕΙΔΙΚΑ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΜΗΧΑΝΗΜΑΤΑ ΓΙΑ ΝΑ ΙΣΙΩΣΕΙ ΛΑΜΑΡΙΝΕΣ, ΝΑ ΔΙΟΡΘΩΣΕΙ ΤΟ ΠΛΑΙΣΙΟ ΚΑΙ ΝΑ ΠΡΟΕΤΟΙΜΑΣΕΙ ΤΗΝ ΕΠΙΦΑΝΕΙΑ ΓΙΑ ΒΑΦΗ, ΔΙΑΣΦΑΛΙΖΟΝΤΑΣ ΤΗΝ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑ ΚΑΙ ΤΗΝ ΑΙΣΘΗΤΙΚΗ ΤΟΥ ΟΧΗΜΑΤΟΣ. , ΓΝΩΡΙΖΕΙ ΝΑ ΧΡΗΣΙΜΟΠΟΙΕΙ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΑ ΟΠΩΣ ΧΕΙΡΟΚΙΝΗΤΑ ΕΡΓΑΛΕΙΑ, ΑΝΥΨΩΤΙΚΑ ΜΗΧΑΝΗΜΑΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΝΙΚΟ ΔΙΑΓΝΩΣΤΙΚΟ ΕΞΟΠΛΙΣΜΟ. ΕΠΑΛΗΘΕΥΕΙ ΟΤΙ ΟΙ ΕΠΙΣΚΕΥΕΣ ΕΧΟΥΝ ΟΛΟΚΛΗΡΩΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΤΥΧΩΣ ΚΑΙ ΟΤΙ ΤΑ ΟΧΗΜΑΤΑ ΕΙΝΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΗ ΓΙΑ ΧΡΗΣΗ.   , EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy

jobs.title: ΠΩΛΗΤΕΣ/ΠΩΛΗΤΡΙΕΣ
jobs.description: ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΑ: ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ, ΒΟΗΘΕΙΑ ΣΤΗΝ ΕΠΙΛΟΓΗ ΠΡΟΙΟΝΤΩΝ. ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑ ΣΤΟ ΤΑΜΕΙΟ. ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΤΑΞΗΣ ΣΤΟΝ ΧΩΡΟ ΤΟΥ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΗΜΑΤΟΣ. ΕΛΕΓΧΟΣ ΠΡΟΙΟΝΤΩΝ ΚΑΤΑ ΤΗΝ ΠΑΡΑΛΑΒΗ ΤΟΥΣ. ΤΑΚΤΙΚΗ ΑΝΑΠΛΗΡΩΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΠΡΟΙΟΝΤΩΝ ΣΤΑ ΡΑΦΙΑ. ΑΝΑΛΗΨΗ ΟΠΟΙΟΝΔΗΠΟΤΕ ΑΛΛΩΝ ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΩΝ ΚΑΘΟΡΙΣΤΟΥΝ ΑΠΟ ΤΟΝ/ΤΗΝ ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟ/Η ΤΟΥ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΗΜΑΤΟΣ.  , ΑΠΑΙΤΗΣΕΙΣ: ΑΡΙΣΤΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΓΓΛΙΚΗΣ ΓΛΩΣΣΑΣ. ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑΚΕΣ ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΕΣ, ΦΙΛΙΚΗ ΔΙΑΘΕΣΗ, ΠΡΟΣΟΧΗ ΣΤΗ ΛΕΠΤΟΜΕΡΕΙΑ. ΕΥΓΕΝΕΙΑ, ΠΡΟΘΥΜΙΑ, ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟ ΠΝΕΥΜΑ.  , Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.description: - ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΥΦΙΣΤΑΜΕΝΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΝΕΩΝ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ ΜΕΣΩ ΤΗΛΕΦΩΝΟΥ, ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΝΙΚΟΥ ΤΑΧΥΔΡΟΜΕΙΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΠΡΟΣΩΠΙΚΩΝ ΣΥΝΑΝΤΗΣΕΩΝ ΟΠΟΥ ΑΠΑΙΤΕΙΤΑΙ.   - ΑΝΑΠΤΥΞΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΟΛΟΓΙΟΥ, ΔΙΕΥΘΕΤΗΣΗ ΡΑΝΤΕΒΟΥ, ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΠΡΟΣΦΟΡΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑ ΜΕ ΠΕΛΑΤΕΣ.   - ΠΑΡΟΧΗ ΔΙΟΙΚΗΤΙΚΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΓΡΑΜΜΑΤΕΙΑΚΗΣ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗΣ, ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗ ΑΡΧΕΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΛΗΛΟΓΡΑΦΙΑΣ, ΟΡΓΑΝΩΣΗ ΠΡΟΓΡΑΜΜΑΤΟΣ ΠΡΟΣΩΠΙΚΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΕΡΓΕΙΩΝ, ΚΑΘΩΣ ΚΑΙ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΒΑΣΙΚΩΝ ΔΙΑΔΙΚΑΣΙΩΝ ΑΝΘΡΩΠΙΝΟΥ ΔΥΝΑΜΙΚΟΥ (HR).   - ΕΚΤΕΛΕΣΗ ΛΟΙΠΩΝ ΣΥΝΑΦΩΝ ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΩΝ ΠΟΥ ΣΧΕΤΙΖΟΝΤΑΙ ΜΕ ΤΗ ΘΕΣΗ. , ΟΡΓΑΝΩΤΙΚΟ ΚΑΙ ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑΚΟ ΑΤΟΜΟ ΜΕ ΑΡΙΣΤΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΑΓΓΛΙΚΩΝ, ΚΑΛΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ Η/Υ. ΕΜΠΕΙΡΙΑ ΣΕ ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ, ΠΩΛΗΣΕΙΣ Ή ΔΙΟΙΚΗΤΙΚΗ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΘΑ ΘΕΩΡΗΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΠΡΟΣΘΕΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ.  ΜΕ ΑΔΕΙΑ ΟΔΗΓΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΙΔΙΟΚΤΗΤΟ ΟΧΗΜΑ.  ΓΙΑ FULL-TIME + PART-T , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.description: ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΣΤΗΝ ΚΑΘΗΜΕΡΙΝΗ ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΑΣΤΙΚΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΤΗΣ ΛΕΙΤΟΥΡΓΙΑΣ ΤΟΥ ΕΡΓΟΤΑΞΙΟΥ. ΔΙΕΝΕΡΓΕΙΑ ΕΠΙΘΕΩΡΗΣΕΩΝ, ΕΝΤΟΠΙΣΜΟΣ ΚΑΙ ΚΑΤΑΓΡΑΦΗ ΚΑΚΟΤΕΧΝΙΩΝ, ΤΕΧΝΙΚΩΝ ΖΗΤΗΜΑΤΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΕΚΚΡΕΜΟΤΗΤΩΝ (SNAGGING) ΚΑΙ ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΑΠΟΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗΣ ΤΟΥΣ. ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΩΝ, ΕΠΙΣΚΕΥΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΠΡΟΟΔΟΥ ΕΡΓΟΛΑΒΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΥΠΕΡΓΟΛΑΒΩΝ. ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΣΤΙΣ ΕΠΙΘΕΩΡΗΣΕΙΣ ΚΑΙ ΠΑΡΑΔΟΣΕΙΣ ΑΚΙΝΗΤΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΣΤΗΝ ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΤΕΧΝΙΚΗΣ ΤΕΚΜΗΡΙΩΣΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΡΧΕΙΩΝ. ΑΝΑΦΟΡΑ ΘΕΜΑΤΩΝ ΠΟΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ, ΥΓΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑΣ, ΚΑΘΥΣΤΕΡΗΣΕΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΑΠΟΚΛΙΣΕΩΝ ΣΤΟΝ ΜΗΧΑΝΙΚΟ ΕΡΓΟΤΑΞΙΟΥ Η PROJECT MANAGER. ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΣΤΗ ΔΙΑΣΦΑΛΙΣΗ ΣΥΜΜΟΡΦΩΣΗΣ ΜΕ ΤΙΣ ΔΙΑΔΙΚΑΣΙΕΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΠΑΙΤΗΣΕΙΣ ΤΟΥ ΕΡΓΟΥ. , ΤΕΧΝΙΚΟ ΔΙΠΛΩΜΑ/ΠΙΣΤΟΠΟΙΗΤΙΚΟ Η ΣΧΕΤΙΚΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ. ΠΡΑΚΤΙΚΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΑΣΤΙΚΩΝ/ΟΙΚΟΔΟΜΙΚΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΩΝ. ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΕΝΤΟΠΙΣΜΟΥ ΤΕΧΝΙΚΩΝ ΖΗΤΗΜΑΤΩΝ. ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑΚΕΣ ΚΑΙ ΟΡΓΑΝΩΤΙΚΕΣ ΔΕΞΙΟΤΗΤΕΣ. ΒΑΣΙΚΕΣ ΓΝΩΣΕΙΣ Η/Υ ΚΑΙ ΑΔΕΙΑ ΟΔΗΓΗΣΗΣ. , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , MARIA PITSILLIDOU , mpitsillidou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer, remote work
jobs.description:
About the role

As a Senior Fullstack Developer, you will lead the modernization of our client's ERP system, transitioning legacy Java/GWT interfaces into modern React applications. Operating in a tight-knit, two-person team, you will leverage advanced agent-driven development tools.

You are offered
the opportunity to work 100% remotely on a long-term, stable project. You will have the creative freedom to pioneer agent-based AI development workflows and play a key role in modernizing a business-critical system.

Work tasks

Modernizing a legacy ERP system by transitioning it to a React and Java-based architecture, utilizing agent-based development methods to implement views, design APIs, and build supporting developer tools.
- Build and modernize ERP views, including search interfaces, editors, and dialogs using React
- Design and implement robust REST APIs to support the new frontend architecture
- Refactor legacy Java/GWT user interfaces into a modern React-based application
- Develop tools and validation checks to keep agent-driven development processes on track

We are looking for

- Advanced knowledge of TypeScript and React
- Practical experience working daily with agentic development methods like Claude Code
- Proven ability to read, refactor, and navigate large legacy codebases
- Strong eye for UI/UX design with the ability to identify and fix visual inconsistencies
- Professional proficiency in English

It is meritorious if you have
- Good knowledge of Java and REST APIs
- Experience with Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or spatial data analysis
- Experience with cloud services, specifically AWS
- Professional proficiency in Finnish
- Experience building business-critical ERP systems

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Machinist, Bluefors Oy
jobs.description:
Bluefors Oy is a Finnish high-tech company based in Helsinki, working at the absolute frontier of quantum technology. They design and manufacture some of the world's most precise cryogenic measurement systems - the kind of equipment that pushes the boundaries of what science can do. When you work here, your machining skills directly support cutting-edge research used by leading institutions and companies around the world.

As a Machinist at Bluefors, you'll be working with a 5-axis DMG Mori milling machine, producing precision parts from materials like copper, aluminium, brass, stainless steel, and POM. The work is varied - small series, tight tolerances where it counts, and surface finishes that matter. You'll have real influence over your work, not just push a button and repeat.

YOUR TASKS

You'll be working as a Machinist in Bluefors' production team, operating a 5-axis DMG Mori milling machine to manufacture precision components for quantum technology systems.

- Setting up and operating 5-axis DMG Mori milling machines using Heidenhain controls
- Machining parts from copper, AISI 316 stainless steel, brass, aluminium, and POM
- Working with part sizes ranging from 5 to 360 mm in diameter
- Producing small series (typically under 10 pieces) with accuracy and consistency
- Maintaining tight tolerances and high surface quality standards where required
- Reading and interpreting technical drawings and machining programs
- Carrying out quality checks and ensuring finished parts meet specifications
- Contributing to a clean, organized, and safe workshop environment

REQUIREMENTS

- Solid experience setting up and operating CNC milling machines
- Hands-on experience with 5-axis machining
- Familiarity with Heidenhain controls
- Ability to read technical drawings and apply tolerances accurately
- Attention to surface quality and detail
- Good communication skills in Finnish or English

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with Mastercam or other CAM software
- Background machining copper, brass, or other non-ferrous materials
- Experience in small-series precision manufacturing
- Prior work in a high-tech or engineering environment

Chosen applicants will be employed with Barona Teollisuus Oy with fixed-term contract until 31.12.2026, with possibility for extension.

This is full-time position from Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week with 2-shift rotation on a 3-week cycle: 2 weeks on a day shift (Monday to Friday) and 1 week on evening shift (Monday to Thursday from 14.00 to 00.00, Fridays off).

If this sounds like you and you're the machinist were looking for, submit your application today using the link provided. For more information, contact Ari Kumlander at Barona by email at
. Please note that, due to data privacy regulations, we cannot accept applications submitted via email.

jobs.title: Full-time Driver Lier
jobs.employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD OSLO DISTRIBUSJON
jobs.description:
We’re looking for Full-Time Drivers to join Oda!

At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective grocery system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and everyone’s opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistical problems, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact. Read on to find out what part you could play in our story.

We are hiring for both morning and evening shifts. Please specify what shift you're applying for in your application.


What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Report directly to our Driver Operating Managers and Team Leaders at your site as an essential part of our dedicated delivery team.

  • Be a Customer Hero: You’ll be on the road bringing groceries and smiles directly to our customers, ensuring a top-notch "Oda experience" at every doorstep.

  • Keep the wheels turning: You’ll handle loading and unloading with speed and care, ensuring every box arrives in perfect condition.

  • Own your ride: You’ll take pride in your van, keeping it clean, presentable, and ready for the road.

  • Pay it forward: You’ll help onboard and train new colleagues, sharing your best tips and tricks from the road.

  • Make us better: We value your brain as much as your driving! You’ll contribute your ideas to help us improve our routines and ways of working.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • A valid driving license (Class B): You have held your license for at least 2 years from the date of issue and feel confident and safe behind the wheel.

  • Good communication skills: Comfortable in speaking and writing English. If you also know Norwegian or another Nordic language, that’s a big plus!


What would be nice to have 💡

  • Enjoy being active and thrive in a physically demanding job

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team

  • A strong work ethic and a "can-do" mindset

  • Service-minded and always looking for the best solutions

  • A genuine desire to make our customers happy

  • Responsible and always prioritize safety in traffic


What we offer 🚀

  • A chance to make a real impact as a Full-Time Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love-while shaking up the grocery industry.

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop-less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • A chance to shape the future of grocery shopping while building a company that’s here to stay.


Practical information

  • Application deadline: We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process once the right candidates are found. We encourage you to apply as early as possible.

  • Start date: We're looking for our next great team members to join us this November, with planned start dates in weeks 45-47.

  • The position is based on a rotational shift schedule (35,5 h), working one weekend per month.

  • Working Hours:

    • Morning shifts: starts between 04:15 and 06:00

    • Evening shift: starts between 12:45 and 14:30

  • Position: 100% Full-time

  • Location: Drammensveien 189, 3420 Lierskogen


A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium.


We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡


To ensure a fair and efficient process for everyone, we use Hubert, our virtual assistant, to help us with the first selection. 🤖 Keep an eye on your inbox – shortly after applying, you’ll receive an email with an invite to a chat-based interview. Just make sure your email address is correct so the invite finds its way to you!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

jobs.title: Hands-On Facility Manager for a Growing Property Portfolio
jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Facility Manager to ensure smooth daily operations, high cleaning standards, and well-maintained properties across our portfolio. You will coordinate staff, linen logistics, maintenance, and property quality.

Hva vi ser etter Qualifications:

  • Experience from cleaning, property management, hospitality, or similar operational work is an advantage

  • Structured, reliable, and comfortable taking responsibility

  • Hands-on and solution-oriented, with an eye for quality and detail

  • Comfortable coordinating people, schedules, and day-to-day operations

  • Comfortable using digital tools and documentation

  • Flexible and available during the day, including weekends when needed

  • Able to communicate well in Norwegian or English

  • A valid driver's licence

Arbeidsoppgaver

As Facility Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring smooth daily operations, high cleaning standards, and well-maintained properties across our portfolio.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Planning staff schedules, managing labour-hour budgets, and following up on actual hours worked.

  • Managing linen logistics, including distribution, stock levels, ordering, returns, and collection.

  • Identifying and following up on property issues, defects, and maintenance needs, including coordinating repairs, contractors, and suppliers.

  • Ensuring high cleaning standards through training, quality control, and regular inspections of the cleaning team.

  • Carrying out regular property inspections, including checks of appliances, lighting, heaters, smoke detectors, and other equipment.

  • Documenting and managing guest-related damages and compensation claims, including photos, estimates, invoices, and supporting documentation for Airbnb, Booking.com, insurance providers, or property owners.

  • Taking an active part in daily cleaning operations to lead by example and maintain a strong understanding of day-to-day operations.

Vi tilbyr We offer:

  • A key operational role with responsibility and freedom to make decisions

  • Competitive pay

  • Independent and varied work across our growing property portfolio

  • The opportunity to shape routines, standards, and daily operations

  • A friendly, fast-paced work environment with good support

📍 Location: Tromsø and surrounding area

📅 Start date: By agreement

Send a short application to post@tromsofremleie.no or contact us at +47 456 97 800 if you have any questions. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis!

Our team works hands-on across cleaning, maintenance, logistics, and daily property operations. We value people who take responsibility, solve problems, and contribute to high standards across our portfolio.

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.

Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.

At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.

Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Správcovia objektov
jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

jobs.title: Správcovia systémov

Podpora používateľov pri práci s Microsoft 365 a štandardnými kancelárskymi aplikáciami. Správa používateľských účtov, hesiel a prístupových oprávnení podľa interných postupov. Evidencia a aktualizácia inventára IT hardvéru a softvéru. Spolupráca pri nákupe, príprave a vydávaní IT techniky novým zamestnancom. Základná správa tlačového prostredia vrátane riešenia bežných problémov s tlačiarňami a skenermi. Podpora výrobných pracovísk pri riešení základných IT problémov ovplyvňujúcich výrobnú prevádzku. Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. Dodržiavanie pravidiel informačnej bezpečnosti a podieľanie sa na ochrane firemných dát a IT prostriedkov. jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

- Implement and communicate global procurement strategies, category plans, and strategic priorities within assigned markets and categories

Ingka Procurement is part of Ingka Group. Together, we bring IKEA to millions of customers in more than 30 countries around the world.

Our mission is to secure a high-performing supplier base that supports long-term business goals and contributes to a stronger, more efficient value chain. By combining commercial focus with sustainability and collaboration, we aim to create meaningful and better procurement for the many people.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist
